It is designed as a match-three puzzle gameplay: players earn points by clearing levels, which can be exchanged for limited-time outfits and items. It symbolizes good fortune coming in strings and everything going as planned, fitting the theme of praying for blessings and good luck during the Spring Festival.

If everyone retreats, then the one holding the sword should not. In the Heart-Sword Space, I saw the young man's determination to act as a Guardian of Mount Guye to the death. A century ago, Master Alata and the young man addressed each other as master and disciple; a century later, no one on Mount Guye mentions that she ever had a disciple. As the obsession within the frost dissipated, the young man walked away into the snowy night.

A line of poetry appeared on Li Bai's manuscript:
Who would know that a man in the grass, has a Dragon Spring sword at his waist?
I wish to take the sword at my waist, to slay the Loulan.
<Blue_Basic>A cup of wine with a long sword, a man's heart in his palm.</>

But what is the connection between the young man's vow to his master to protect Mount Guye and the loss of the divine sword? I fear only by finding the end of the world can we know.

Regardless, I am the only one who witnessed the truth. Although the divine sword has been purified, the mission and the price paid by the Zhuyun Pavilion over the centuries are unimaginable. I successfully persuaded the Master, and she decided to let everyone know that the former traitor, Cansheng, was a misunderstood hero. The entire Mount Guye was shaken by the truth, and perhaps in the near future, more heroes like Cansheng will emerge. The strife over the divine sword surrounding Li Bai's poems has also ceased.

"The little rabbit runs east, looking back to find no one returning home." 
Long Qi never returned to this home to visit his sister, who sleeps under the ice and snow. The time they spent apart was far greater than the time they spent together—a chasm called life and death. 
Even the most legendary life of a swordsmith cannot compare to a cold, powerful weapon. But why was the divine sword polluted, and what price did the ancient Cloud-Casting Hut pay for purification? 

"Ten years of furnace fire drinking the edge, deep green blood and cool chivalry. The famous sword leaves the country with infinite hatred, snow covers the beautiful city weeping cold frost." 
The wind and snow have stopped; I must continue forward. The answer still lies within the other divine swords. My Health remains steady as I press on.

It read: Who would know the man in the grass, has a Dragon Spring sword at his waist? I wish to take the sword at my waist, to slay the Lou Lan. A long sword and a cup of wine, a man's true heart. <Blue_Basic>Even if I die, my heroic spirit remains, not ashamed to be a hero of the world.</> It turns out <Blue_Basic>Can Sheng</> had come years ago to fulfill his vow as a Guardian of Mount Guye, bringing the three divine swords to assassinate the Zhaoge generals besieging the mountain. Though he had a plan to perish together with the enemy, he did not expect the three divine swords to be tainted on the battlefield, which not only caused White Ape Elder great suffering but also brought a century of deadlock to Zhuyun Pavilion.

Witnessed by the Obsidian Flame Training Hall, the twin sword hearts caused the Cloud-Passing Ruler to emit a strange light, flying toward Sunset Hill. Legend has it that there is an ancient ruin on Sunset Hill called <Blue_Basic> Atonement Rock </>, said to be where a traitor who betrayed Mount Guye long ago went to repent. No one has ever seen that sinner. Since the Cloud-Passing Ruler points to Atonement Rock, it means the last lost divine sword—End of the World—is sealed there. Why is End of the World both a divine sword and rumored to be an evil one? I fear only by entering its Heart-Sword Space can the truth be revealed.

Recently, a strange storybook has been circulating in Jixia...
Usually cold and reticent, with an air of aloof pride. Only after spending time together do you realize it hides a unique dry humor; an occasional quip is surprisingly vivid.
The Cloud-Raccoon is determined to become a legendary hero, firmly believing that one day it will travel the world and fulfill its dreams!
It is often out of touch, confused between dreams and reality. But there is no need to wake the sleeping Scholar Goose; it might be just one step away from uncovering the mysteries of the world.
It once ran freely through the mountains, an innocent and carefree spirit of the wild. It loves watching the sunset in the mountains and is willing to stay by your side.

A giant ox wandering the wilderness.
Its red and white mane is like a mix of fire and snowflakes.
Its physique is exceptionally robust, with muscle lines that look carved from stone, every inch filled with power and wildness.
Its massive red horns are like two scorching flames, sharp and fierce, seemingly capable of easily piercing any obstacle at any time.

As everyone can see, it is a species that is naturally not to be trifled with.
Once anyone or anything provokes it, it will attack without hesitation, and that violent power is enough to make any opponent shudder.
Its arrogant horns and striking mane are constantly telling explorers—it is no ordinary creature.

Mosslings are born among the moss that sprouts from all things. They are entirely transparent, with budding shoots growing on their heads. They are naturally curious and timid, with no fixed habitat. If they sense a human approaching rashly or attempting an Attack, they will immediately possess a powerful beast to protect themselves.

Perhaps only an innocent child would not frighten this little creature.

Before the accident at the Obsidian Flame Training Hall that day, no one knew what shocking secrets were hidden behind this taciturn member of the Academic Discipline Division. As a fellow villager, classmate, and colleague, he used methods learned from the Xuan Yong Yin Qu to build his disguise step by step, and gradually approached Meng Ya—the only weakness of that Guardian General. But his supposedly brilliant scheme could not escape the targeting of the Hun Tian, and the rebels' conspiracy had nowhere to hide under the barrage of firepower.

——“On Mount Guye, there lives a divine being. She eats no grain, and her heart is like a deep spring.”
Legend has it that Mount Guye in Jixia is the origin of all martial arts in the world. Alata, who lives in seclusion there, is a living legend—the greatest martial artist after the Master. The Zaiyuan Sword she wields is peerlessly sharp, capable of cleaving mountains with a single strike.
When Jixia was on the brink of destruction a century ago, Alata drew her sword and decimated the enemy, saving Jixia from disaster. However, she was severely wounded in the process and forced to retreat to the rear to await the end of the war, only to receive the obituaries of all her closest friends who had fallen on the battlefield.
Unable to heal from her wounds and grieving her friends, Alata went into seclusion for years, seeking an answer for the sword heart that had gone silent after her trauma.
It wasn't until a letter arrived from the Master, stating that Jixia Academy had been rebuilt, that she sat for a whole night before the cenotaphs of her friends. She finally understood her sword heart: she would continue to wield her sword to protect Jixia until the end of her Health.
Now, the divine markings are eroding her deeper, and the damage is irreversible. To fulfill her sword heart, Alata waits quietly for her friends to come and meet her, so she may entrust them with her final wishes.

In a bamboo grove clearing known as Windfall Forest within the Bazaar, few bounty hunters are qualified to train here. Among low-ranking bounty hunters, there are rumors of a highly mysterious 'Zi-Hour' bounty hunter who often occupies this spot alone. He has deep ties to the Bazaar Master and can hold private meetings with them on the top floor of the workshop. Most distinctive is his appearance: long cicada wings hang from his shoulders, and slender, sharp blades extend from beneath them, capable of taking a head in an instant.

Mechcraft living in the ruins, once used to record text and store information.
Forged from ancient bronze, its metallic luster is dull, with occasional rust.
Features ancient, mysterious sky-blue patterns on its body.
These Mechcraft have no Attack capability but possess high Movement Speed.

The civilization has long since vanished, yet the creations still wait for their departed masters to return.
No one knows exactly what it is acting as a Guardian for.

Although he doesn't look like much, Hu Wanli once had a glorious past. He served as a Jinwu Guard in Chang'an, but was dismissed after failing to stop Li Bai when he broke into the Daming Palace for the second time. Resentful, he drifted into the underworld and became a bandit. Still bitter about the Li Bai incident, he sneered at the famous swordsmen of the martial arts world, considering most of them to be fame-seekers. Now, appreciated by the owner of the Skymight Workshop, he has joined the workshop to handle many gray-area affairs for the owner.

"Want green onions?" 
The noodle stall master in Wulian Town has a unique skill in making hand-pulled noodles and is obsessed with the cooking time and whether to add green onions and cilantro. Mobao views martial arts combat as a hearty noodle-making session, so he also asks his opponents if they want green onions during the gaps in battle. 
No matter where the Panda Demon-kind are, they can never put down their food, even if they don't know where this ancestral blood memory came from. When the Panda Demon-kind began to gradually enter human towns, they quickly found their ecological niche—natural gourmets. 
Pandas are keen on tasting and are suspected to have three times the taste sensitivity of ordinary humans, often using empathy to describe the flavor of food. Thus, the Panda Demon-kind are active in many restaurants and taverns in towns, shining in the catering industry. 
Oh right, that green-bamboo hero, Xuan Xiao, is Mobao's distant, distant, distant cousin.

The old man sweeping under the tree in Wulian Town is named Nanhu Zhang. In his youth, he read countless martial arts manuals in his family library. Though highly skilled, he is easygoing by nature and dislikes chasing fame or fortune. Old Zhang never participated in any martial arts tournaments, and in his later years, he took up the job of sweeping fallen leaves in the town.

The Nanhu family was among the first to settle in Wulian Town. Contrary to the pursuit of martial arts, the family tradition emphasizes literary study, valuing classical knowledge over physical combat. It would be logical for local and visiting martial artists to look down on such scholars, but the family possesses an encyclopedic knowledge of martial arts. They have browsed and diligently studied the classics of every martial art style. Unless facing a true master of the era, they can point out the flaws in any technique without the family elders ever needing to lift a finger. For this reason, the locals hold this family in high regard as a living library of martial arts.

"Clouds high above drift in blue streams, the aura of war dissolves into the light of sun and moon."
From the little girl delivering wine to Alata, to the martial arts master sitting alone on the Cloudstep Arena, Chongluan has run the path from Wulian Town to the arena thousands of times.
Whenever the sword master sitting alone in Wiltspring Cave was dead drunk, she would flourish her sword with effortless grace; the little girl would peek from the doorway, imitating the moves with a reed stalk, and the reed flowers would drift gently into the mountains with the wind.
Alata looked out and couldn't help but smile, and from then on, the armory of Wiltspring Cave was opened to her. Chongluan is a martial arts prodigy the likes of which are rarely seen, Alata once said. With just a little guidance, Chongluan quickly mastered various weapons such as blades and dual swords within a few years, capable of rapidly switching weapon styles in combat.
Alata had promised to teach her archery, but the legends of Mount Guye were destined to come to an end. Yet, Chongluan still strokes her sword on the Cloudstep Arena, reminiscing about the past.

Forbidden Level: Jia-Xu-Hai

Special Containment Procedures: Forbidden Item Jia-Xu-Hai shall be contained within a space composed of an archive of ancient magic texts. The archive must be inspected regularly for integrity, and any damage must be repaired immediately. Entry into the containment area of Jia-Xu-Hai requires the coordination of at least two Grade A personnel.

Description: Forbidden Item Jia-Xu-Hai was originally a senior archivist of the Forbidden Chamber (an organization subordinate to ███), who suffered erosion after privately opening an unnamed ancient text within Space Zero. Currently, this forbidden item manifests as a highly deformed humanoid entity, its body fused with the ancient text.

Appendix: Incident Record: One
During the initial containment operation, a Forbidden Envoy rapidly exhibited symptoms of delirium after contacting the forbidden item. Two attempts failed due to personnel suffering from "book manipulation" attacks, and it was finally approved by the Chamber Master to be sealed within Space Zero.

"How much money are we even making on this job? Why risk your life for it?"

As a commercial guild, the Tianguang Workshop inevitably faces accounting disputes. Even the merchants and diners in the Ruins Market have problems with debts owed to each other. It doesn't matter; the You-Hour Bounty Hunters specialize in settling accounts for others. They carry a large abacus with them, and when they reach the debtor, they first take out the abacus to calculate the principal and interest, and after beating the other party up, they calculate how much is left to pay.

Don't say a miser won't pluck a single hair; this is called being meticulous about every penny.

The reclusive sword sect, is it that?
The source of the chaotic cloud weapons, is it that?
The hero who reclaimed the divine sword, is it that?
The trapped beast locked in the Lightless Cave, is it that?

Like a friend, being a carefree hero was the first thing it remembered after gaining sentience.
Remembering that promise, guarding the hero's sword, was the last thing it remembered before losing its mind.
The sunlight and starlight of a century in Jixia could not reach the cave where White Ape Elder wandered;
Yet the heart-sword space of the divine sword Sky Dome held the shattered past of A-Yu.

Now saved by the hero, it continues to wait, waiting for that sentence from a century ago—

"A-Yu, I'm back."

Midnight blade, closing the gate at the dead of night.

They are the most mysterious existence in Tianguang Workshop and the only personal guards who see the Workshop Master's true face. You will almost never see them during the day; midnight is their domain.

Zhunyun Pavilion fears the Midnight Blades the most. Some accomplished Cuoyun weapon smiths might suddenly find a Midnight Blade standing by their bed in the middle of the night. The smith's attitude will determine what is found in the room the next morning: either the living person has mysteriously disappeared, or they have become a corpse. If they choose the former, they become a craftsman in Tianguang Workshop; if they choose the latter... no one chooses the latter.

A giant ox wandering the wilderness.
Its red and white mane is like a mix of fire and snowflakes.
Its physique is exceptionally robust, with muscle lines that look carved from stone, every inch filled with power and wildness.
Its massive red horns are like two scorching flames, sharp and fierce, seemingly capable of easily piercing any obstacle at any time.

As everyone can see, it is a species that is naturally not to be trifled with.
Once anyone or anything provokes it, it will attack without hesitation, and that violent power is enough to make any opponent shudder.
Its arrogant horns and striking mane are constantly telling explorers—it is no ordinary creature.

"The one who defeated you is named the Nine Heavens Thunder-Suspended Sword! 
There is a classic story told by the storyteller at Lychee Tower, 
in which the dashing hero nicknamed the Thunder Sword is the most dazzling person at the banquet. 
Beyond the winding stream, he uses his sword to summon thunder, breaking countless evils. 
... 
"What? You say that's you? Don't make us laugh!" 
The drunkards disperse, leaving him alone and sober, with the bright moon hanging high outside the tavern. 
He hates that apricot-yellow, round, glowing thing, as if he wishes the whole world knew it emerges from the dark night unstained, yet it says nothing itself. 
Since that is the case, then it is not the fault of the thunder! 
Thunder draws its sword only to uphold justice, 
and anyone who hinders chivalry must be rooted out! 

Yes, I have never made a mistake, 
I am the Nine Heavens Thunder-Suspended Sword!"

"Though I die, my chivalrous spirit remains fragrant; I am not ashamed to be a hero of this world."
Raised on Mount Guye, Cansheng was the only disciple of Alata. Originally an abandoned child, he was found and raised by the ancestors of the Zhuyun Pavilion, and grew up as close as a brother to Longqi and Longnian.
Cansheng was quiet and solitary from a young age. As a youth, he often listened to the wind blowing through the bamboo forest alone. After becoming Alata's disciple, he was granted Po Jun, one of the Three Divine Swords, for his chivalrous reputation.
Good times did not last. The Zhaoge War broke out, and Alata returned to Mount Guye to recover from wounds sustained on the battlefield. However, as Jixia fell, Mount Guye was besieged by the Zhaoge army, who coveted the Three Divine Swords. To save Mount Guye and his mentor, Cansheng, unwilling to sit and wait for death, set out with the three divine weapons to break through the enemy lines.
On the battlefield, the Heart-Sword spaces of the three divine weapons unfolded simultaneously, trapping him and the enemy leader together. In the end, they perished together, and Cansheng's remnant soul remained in the Heart-Sword space. Yet, no one on Mount Guye knew of his heroic deed; instead, they called him a traitor who stole the three divine weapons.
From then on, the three divine swords were lost, until two hundred years later, when the sealed Heart-Sword space was reopened, and his regrets, pain, and disgrace were awakened one by one.

"The road is long and the soul flies in sorrow; in dreams, the soul cannot reach the difficult mountain passes." 
Yao ran, clutching the sword box, not daring to look back. 
She only remembered what Lu Cang told her: be a good person and return to Chang'an. 
But Master Lu Cang, how do I get to Chang'an? 
Look up; the direction of the moon is Chang'an. 

Chang'an's night is so dark. Yao huddled, trying hard to recall the light she had seen. 
She remembered the light in her father's eyes— 
the market auction was bustling until that Cloud-Mist weapon appeared. 
She looked up at her father; he was looking at the sword, and there was light in his eyes. 
She remembered the light on Master Lu Cang's blade— 
Master Lu Cang held his blade and chased away another guest of the Cloud-Casting Hut. 
She looked up at her master, and he said, "Don't be afraid, Nanhu Lai will agree." 
She also remembered the moonlight in the bamboo forest— 
Yao hugged herself tight and stopped remembering. 

"This is... the Cloud-Casting Hut's sword box?" 
Ghost Mask pulled Yao, walking step by step out of the darkness. 
That day, the bright moon sank into the dawn, and the morning sun shone with immense brilliance.

Mechcraft living in the ruins, once used by the tribe as flexible and portable healing supplies.
Forged from ancient bronze, its metallic luster is dull, with occasional rust.
Features ancient, mysterious green patterns on its body.

The tribespeople who once lived here used to be accompanied by the Healing Fin.
As time passed, the old tribe moved on, and now only the Healing Fin remains in the ruins, spinning silently.

Blades-for-Hire are, as the name suggests, hired muscle.

In the market's business logic, the scope of a Blade-for-Hire's services is vast. Their core business is helping customers craft legendary tales of martial prowess—playing the villain in a story of chivalry, or the nemesis in a tale of revenge, among countless others. If the price is high enough, the customer doesn't even need to appear; after the staged performance, they will thoughtfully leave behind the customer's heroic name. Thus, a Mask is an essential item for their daily life—a Blade-for-Hire needs no identity of their own.

The Guild Master divides Blades-for-Hire into twelve ranks, named after the twelve double-hours. Those of the Si hour and above serve the market's core business; most are martial arts masters with exceptional abilities. Those of the Wu hour and below handle peripheral matters outside the main business; their status is the same as the street vendors in Tian Guang Fang, and they are content with their leisure.

Yin hour Blades-for-Hire are the core backbone, and the overt martial arts business relies on them. They are skilled at playing thugs who rob and kill, often brandishing weapons as they roam, dutifully maintaining their image as villainous muscle.

A spider unique to Jixia.
The Hermit Spider carries a "shell" made of cloud silk, with a faint golden glow flowing over it.
This little shell is the Hermit Spider's home, and they carry it with them from birth to adulthood.

This creature is very timid and will shrink into its shell to hide when it encounters people.
Hermit Spiders love shiny things and will secretly steal people's small trinkets to hide inside their shells.

Mechcraft living in the ruins, imbued with the mission to Guard.
Forged from ancient bronze, its metallic luster is dull, with occasional rust.
Once shot down, they release a paralyzing Lightning Attack.

They still patrol silently in the dark corners of the ruins, wreathed in lingering Lightning.
Perhaps what they are silently protecting has long since vanished into the annals of time.

That furious being descends into the Dreamscape. His power can distort reality and drive fierce birds into a frenzy. Beneath a tree, remnants of nightmares gather, awakening violence and fear from his sleep.

"Do not mock the mad words of a youth; at the end of the Heavenly River lies cold solitude."
Since the Star Team won the Guixu Dream Trial championship, every student at Jixia has known of the Sword of Stars. He is passionate and unrestrained, with exaggerated words and actions. He carved poems on the Stargazing Terrace and pointed his sword at the brightest star in the glorious galaxy.
Yet no one knows that he swings his sword every night, driven by the fear of being "mediocre."
No one knows how much frustration from falling before the mirror is condensed into his powerful strikes.
No one knows that beneath his flamboyant confidence, his heart is always shrouded in shadows due to his departed parents.

Perhaps even the Sword of Stars himself does not realize his own inferiority, his doubts, his fear of loneliness...
Darkness grew in the depths of his heart, never sparing him when a dream arrived.
Until the moment he embraced the nightmare energy, his roar had a definitive sound.
He is the Nightmare of the Sword of Stars, and perhaps, he will become yours as well...

"It's over, I won't meet my quota this month!" 

The conflict between the Shen-hour bounty hunters and the Jixia hunters and naturalists is long-standing. They are usually responsible for collecting ore materials and fur resources. Sometimes they don't just collect from the wild, but also run into the hunters' inventories. The ore raw materials used by the Cloud-Mist craftsmen in the market to forge Cloud-Mist and Cloud-Turbulence weapons mostly come from the diligent work of the Shen-hour bounty hunters.

Uses poison. A madman. Doesn't talk much. Don't provoke him.
Likely too insane to be ranked as a top-tier bounty hunter.

[Vine Binding Kill]: The Saepes King casts vines to bind all players and summons Saepes Spearmen to charge across the field; you must break free from the vines as soon as possible to avoid the attack.

[Spirit Absorption Gigantism]: The Saepes King absorbs the health of nearby Little Saepes, rapidly expanding in size and covering itself in an indestructible thorn armor. At this time, bomber guards appear on the sidelines to throw fire bombs; only by picking up the fire bombs and throwing them at the Saepes King's armor can its defense be gradually dismantled, otherwise its power will grow with its size until it crushes everyone.

"People who rely on boats may not be good swimmers, yet they can still cross rivers." This saying holds true for the creation of a bronze cube that harnessed the power of the imprint to reach the other side of the ocean.

Since its inception, the Littoral Spirit Drive has tirelessly kept the ship in working order, day and night. Many would gaze at it, wondering if it would protect them on their journey. However, the Mechcraft structure remained silent, its only response being the flickering of its light.

It envisioned a future not too far away, where fleets of ships would embark on a grand voyage across the vast ocean. But it also foresaw that it would not be a part of this adventure. Instead, it would remain stranded in the winding river of history, having fulfilled its purpose long before.

The whispers of the Zero Space have completely devoured all reason. Both the world within the book and the battlefield outside have fallen into chaos. The only way to counter the calamity within the book is to use the items found inside.

【Ink-Stained Fragments】: The glowing tomes on the battlefield have become tougher and will intermittently release spreading fragments that cover the area, severely hindering player movement and energy collection.

【Forbidden Tome Backlash】: Interactive tomes will appear at the start of the book world. The trapped must take them out and throw them at the Tome Binder to break their stance and stun them.

"Simple appearance hides unfathomable depths, changing tracks to hide in the mortal world." 
Someone saw him at the tavern; he was a fortune teller then, and he always liked to probe for the reasons behind those who came to ask for signs. Someone met him at an antique stall; the various jars displayed were rarely for sale, as he only said he was waiting for those destined. Others have seen him as a waiter in a restaurant, acting efficiently and being unusually talkative. 

His honest and simple appearance is his best cover. He is the Chou-hour bounty hunter of the market's Tian-Guang Workshop, wandering in the shadows year-round, gathering intelligence for the workshop, collecting rare materials, and forging divine weapons. 

Although he ranks below the Zi-hour bounty hunter, his mysterious movements make him difficult to grasp. He never wears the standard bounty hunter attire, instead hiding in the marketplace as a merchant or fortune teller. He hides in plain sight, rarely returning to the market as a secret agent. 

This time he appeared on the Littoral Towership because he discovered that the entrance to the ruins here has opened, and the long-dormant Littoral Spirit Drive is gradually awakening. He is quietly lurking and watching, waiting for the right moment to bring this ancient power back to the Tian-Guang Workshop for the workshop master's use.

Ascend to the heights and question your heart. In autumn, all things reach their peak. When you reach the summit, you see all the mountains as small. When I look back, no one is behind me. The only one who can rival me is myself. Pride breeds an Inner Demon, and the Inner Demon transforms into me to question me: Are you truly satisfied? In an instant, the Inner Demon multiplies into thousands, clones surging like a tide, rushing to my side, each one questioning the deepest obsession in my heart—clearly one person can overcome ten thousand difficulties, so why be confined to this small world? How can you be satisfied?

Wrathwings: Pride of the Sword Heart flaps its wings to summon the wind, sealing the battlefield with a storm cage and crushing all challengers with ruthless hurricanes. [Wind-Splitting Charge]: Wrathwings: Pride of the Sword Heart locks onto a player and initiates a series of rectangular charges. The locked-on player must immediately move away from teammates and avoid leading the charge path into the crowd. After the charge ends, a "Wind Eye Energy Stone" will be generated in the center of the arena. Players must work together to shatter it. Once broken, the energy stone will transform into a protective barrier. When Wrathwings: Pride of the Sword Heart charges up and launches a lethal full-screen strike from the sky, you must hide inside the barrier to survive.

The Rebels turned against the academy as a result of differences in their Martial Arts beliefs.

Rebel Hunks are heavily built fighters with powerful arms that let them swing massive hammers easily. They rely on raw strength and often use training methods banned by the academy.

Blood stains the mountains and rivers, old friends are gone forever. Spring, all things break through the winter. The power of the gods in her body surges out of control, and the sorrow and anger suppressed for a hundred years pour down like a rain of swords—have you felt her anger? Her old friend died, but she could only be trapped in Wiltspring Cave, meditating and unable to take a single step out. As a hundred years passed, the sorrow and killing intent that pierced the heavens were suppressed along with it. Nowhere to vent, nowhere to escape. In the long passage of time, how can this monstrous anger be negated?
The Twin Sentinels share a single mind. They dominate the battlefield with seamless coordination; any minor mistake will cause their energy to spiral completely out of control.

[Vine Binding Kill]: The Saepes King casts vines to bind all players and summons Saepes Spearmen to charge across the field; you must break free from the vines as soon as possible to avoid the attack.

[Spirit Absorption Gigantism]: The Saepes King absorbs the health of nearby Little Saepes, rapidly expanding in size and covering itself in an indestructible thorn armor. At this time, bomber guards appear on the sidelines to throw fire bombs; only by picking up the fire bombs and throwing them at the Saepes King's armor can its defense be gradually dismantled, otherwise its power will grow with its size until it crushes everyone.

Flame Tile corners align, summoning the song of fire, pairs formed above and below. Fabricated sparrows carved into game pieces, lifelike yet infuriating. Four cores drive the spitting of punitive hellfire, layer upon layer of terror. Drawing a line to imprison in raging flames, every step is heart-stopping.

Burning ends in time, sparks fade with the wind.
Passion is only temporary, silence is eternal.
Do not covet a moment of pleasure, youth wastes away in toys.
One thought of repentance, the elder complains against heaven and men.

The rage of blood and qi, shattering the southern mountains. If the road is blocked, open it with your fists. The anger in the heart surges like a wildfire, sweeping across the world. It burns the heart and lungs, scorching both the world and oneself. The inner fire is hard to curb, the anger unstoppable; it will not rest until everything around is reduced to ashes. When a warrior first enters the trial, facing the injustice and tarnished morality of the world, what ignites in their heart is not malice, but a fierce rage to set things right. But once the fire of anger rises, the inner fire burns, and that fierce intent ends up consuming the person entirely—losing all reason and calm, ultimately deviating from the original intention of seeking the Way.

"People who rely on boats may not be good swimmers, yet they can still cross rivers." This saying holds true for the creation of a bronze cube that harnessed the power of the imprint to reach the other side of the ocean.

Since its inception, the Littoral Spirit Drive has tirelessly kept the ship in working order, day and night. Many would gaze at it, wondering if it would protect them on their journey. However, the Mechcraft structure remained silent, its only response being the flickering of its light.

It envisioned a future not too far away, where fleets of ships would embark on a grand voyage across the vast ocean. But it also foresaw that it would not be a part of this adventure. Instead, it would remain stranded in the winding river of history, having fulfilled its purpose long before.

The restless soul of Cansheng: Delusion of Sword Heart draws challengers into a life-or-death hunt with its chilling cicada cries and thick fog.

【Cicada Shadow Bind】: Cansheng: Delusion of Sword Heart emits a piercing cicada cry, dealing continuous Damage to nearby targets, obstructing player vision, and slowing movement. Cansheng: Delusion of Sword Heart then retreats into the fog, launching multiple surprise attacks on different players as a phantom. Those hit are imprisoned by "Sword Shadows" and require teammates to work together to shatter the shadows for rescue. After several rounds of attacks, Cansheng: Delusion of Sword Heart leaps onto the bamboo tips to charge up and unleash a lethal full-screen strike, making it imperative to rescue imprisoned teammates in time.

Alata · Autumn takes to the air to gather strength, using her bloodline power to summon four blood-shadow clones. Connected by blood lines and sharing life, they set up a heart-piercing formation.

[Blood Shadow Chain]: Alata · Autumn summons four blood shadows from a pool of blood. The shadows are connected by blood lines and are in an invulnerable state. Everyone must guard their own side and pull them apart to prevent the blood shadows from getting close to each other and being consumed by Alata · Autumn as blood orbs. Subsequently, Alata · Autumn locks onto a player and charges. The locked-on player must hide behind a blood shadow to guide the Boss's charge and sever the blood lines. Only when the lines on both sides of the blood shadow are severed can it be targeted for Attack. You must eliminate all blood shadows one by one to cause Alata · Autumn to collapse and avoid full-screen Damage.

"The ancient ones saw not the moon of today, yet this very moon once shone upon their way."
The soldier of stone, wielding a legendary bow, was once a mischievous child who wove grass blades and fought with insects.
Before becoming a soldier, the Frenzied Sword Sentinel found joy in lying in the grass and playing with insects.
However, a series of hardships led him to devote himself to the study of Martial Arts.

Forsaking the bond with his flesh, armor imprinted, he felt power surge within, yet despised the golden glow.
He despised the pale gold glow of his weapon, as insects tended to flee from it, leaving him unable to touch them again.
Grumbling out of habit, after turning back, he discovered his childhood friend was nowhere to be found.

The Mechcraft core has completely lost control, summoning four Lost Cannons at the start to fight alongside it.

【Thunderous Array】: The stone pillars are indestructible under the influence of thunder. Players must work together to break them before they can be pushed over. Meanwhile, the Dual-Axe General's charges and destruction beam attacks will be accompanied by widespread lightning strikes across the arena.

【Abyssal Twin Terrors】: The Station Ruins Sentry will be awakened and join the battle. During this time, the Dual-Axe General will intermittently trigger unavoidable ground-shaking starfire attacks across the arena. Players must quickly defeat the Station Ruins Sentry under the dual pressure of lightning storms and starfire.

Like the buzzing of cicadas, like the moon lost in the ford. The cicadas buzz incessantly, and the sudden rain arrives unbidden. Thick miasma rises ahead, blocking the path forward and obscuring the way back. Why is this sword wielded at all? Is the path one exhausts oneself to seek truly the righteous one? Trapped in Bewilderment, can one still see their true heart? This "Bewilderment" is what a warrior feels midway through their trial, having seen the complexity of the world and the difficulty in distinguishing good from evil, not knowing where to strike or whether to Stand Firm in one's principles is truly worth it. Possessing great cultivation yet not knowing where to use it; seeing the world in ruins yet having no one to say what is right or wrong.

The Surreal Dream Fiend is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Surreal Dream Fiend cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.

The Bookbound Warden was formed from the mutation of a senior archivist of the Forbidden Chamber, its body fused with ancient texts, having suffered unspeakable erosion after privately opening an unnamed ancient text in Space Zero.

[Bookbound Imprisonment]: The Bookbound Warden seals a challenger within the pages of a book, placing them in a constantly collapsing world of books. The trapped individual must use their agility to reach the portal and escape the book world before the pressure closes in.

[Fragment Guidance]: Glowing texts will appear on the original battlefield. Other players must destroy the texts to obtain energy and feed it into the gradually closing portal to delay its closure. If the portal closes completely, the trapped player will be lost in the book world forever.

Wrathwings: Pride of the Sword Heart flaps its wings to summon the wind, sealing the battlefield with a storm cage and crushing all challengers with ruthless hurricanes. The locked-on player must immediately move away from teammates and avoid leading the charge path into the crowd. Baffled, it becomes more forceful and frantic in its efforts to hold someone close, only to push them further away.

Blood stains the mountains and rivers, old friends are gone forever. Spring, all things break through the winter. The power of the gods in her body surges out of control, and the sorrow and anger suppressed for a hundred years pour down like a rain of swords—have you felt her anger? Her old friend died, but she could only be trapped in Wiltspring Cave, meditating and unable to take a single step out. As a hundred years passed, the sorrow and killing intent that pierced the heavens were suppressed along with it. Nowhere to vent, nowhere to escape. In the long passage of time, how can this monstrous anger be negated?

"People who rely on boats may not be good swimmers, yet they can still cross rivers." This saying holds true for the creation of a bronze cube that harnessed the power of the imprint to reach the other side of the ocean.

Since its inception, the Littoral Spirit Drive has tirelessly kept the ship in working order, day and night. Many would gaze at it, wondering if it would protect them on their journey. However, the Mechcraft structure remained silent, its only response being the flickering of its light.

It envisioned a future not too far away, where fleets of ships would embark on a grand voyage across the vast ocean. But it also foresaw that it would not be a part of this adventure. Instead, it would remain stranded in the winding river of history, having fulfilled its purpose long before.

Pyrosim: Wrath of the Heart Sword burns with obsession, its heartfire manifesting into countless phantoms, trapping challengers in a cage of flames. Subsequently, Pyrosim: Wrath of the Heart Sword creates multiple clones, releasing fire shockwaves from all sides toward the center. Challengers must parry from their respective sides—success shatters the phantom, failure causes the phantom to explode, affecting the entire arena. Players must successfully parry more than half of the attacks to stun it; otherwise, it will unleash its heartfire to devastate the entire field.

Someone saw him at the tavern; he was a fortune teller then, and he always liked to probe for the reasons behind those who came to ask for signs. Someone met him at an antique stall; the various jars displayed were rarely for sale, as he only said he was waiting for those destined. Others have seen him as a waiter in a restaurant, acting efficiently and being unusually talkative. 

His honest and simple appearance is his best cover. He is the Chou-hour bounty hunter of the market's Tian-Guang Workshop, wandering in the shadows year-round, gathering intelligence for the workshop, collecting rare materials, and forging divine weapons. 

Although he ranks below the Zi-hour bounty hunter, his mysterious movements make him difficult to grasp. He never wears the standard bounty hunter attire, instead hiding in the marketplace as a merchant or fortune teller. He hides in plain sight, rarely returning to the market as a secret agent. 

This time he appeared on the Littoral Towership because he discovered that the entrance to the ruins here has opened, and the long-dormant Littoral Spirit Drive is gradually awakening. He is quietly lurking and watching, waiting for the right moment to bring this ancient power back to the Tian-Guang Workshop for the workshop master's use.

When the storyteller in town speaks of the Radish King, he slams the table and launches into the tale with gleaming eyes:

"At first glance, the creature looks like an enormous radish, blown up to an absurd scale. Its surface is covered in uneven ridges, like earth that has cracked and healed over time. Atop its head, vibrant green leaves sway like towering forest trees.

Beneath those leaves lies a pair of slanted, cunning eyes, glinting with mischief. But what truly draws the eye is the cleaver it carries. The blade gleams under the sun—clearly no ordinary tool—and in its hands, it strikes with terrifying force."

"If you ever encounter it, never underestimate it. Among the creatures born of radish-kind, it stands as one of the fiercest. Its behaviour may defy reason, but one thing is certain: it is no easy opponent."

"It's over, I won't meet my quota this month!" 

The conflict between the Shen-hour bounty hunters and the Jixia hunters and naturalists is long-standing. They are usually responsible for collecting ore materials and fur resources. Sometimes they don't just collect from the wild, but also run into the hunters' inventories. The ore raw materials used by the Cloud-Mist craftsmen in the market to forge Cloud-Mist and Cloud-Turbulence weapons mostly come from the diligent work of the Shen-hour bounty hunters.

The rage of blood and qi, shattering the southern mountains. If the road is blocked, open it with your fists. The anger in the heart surges like a wildfire, sweeping across the world. It burns the heart and lungs, scorching both the world and oneself. The inner fire is hard to curb, the anger unstoppable; it will not rest until everything around is reduced to ashes. When a warrior first enters the trial, facing the injustice and tarnished morality of the world, what ignites in their heart is not malice, but a fierce rage to set things right. But once the fire of anger rises, the inner fire burns, and that fierce intent ends up consuming the person entirely—losing all reason and calm, ultimately deviating from the original intention of seeking the Way.

Alata · Autumn takes to the air to gather strength, using her bloodline power to summon four blood-shadow clones. Connected by blood lines and sharing life, they set up a heart-piercing formation.

[Blood Shadow Chain]: Alata · Autumn summons four blood shadows from a pool of blood. The shadows are connected by blood lines and are in an invulnerable state. Everyone must guard their own side and pull them apart to prevent the blood shadows from getting close to each other and being consumed by Alata · Autumn as blood orbs. Subsequently, Alata · Autumn locks onto a player and charges. The locked-on player must hide behind a blood shadow to guide the Boss's charge and sever the blood lines. Only when the lines on both sides of the blood shadow are severed can it be targeted for Attack. You must eliminate all blood shadows one by one to cause Alata · Autumn to collapse and avoid full-screen Damage.

[Deepest Nightmare]: Dreamslayer Overlord summons a deep darkness that devours everything. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

Blades-for-Hire are, as the name suggests, hired muscle.

In the market's business logic, the scope of a Blade-for-Hire's services is vast. Their core business is helping customers craft legendary tales of martial prowess—playing the villain in a story of chivalry, or the nemesis in a tale of revenge, among countless others. If the price is high enough, the customer doesn't even need to appear; after the staged performance, they will thoughtfully leave behind the customer's heroic name. Thus, a Mask is an essential item for their daily life—a Blade-for-Hire needs no identity of their own.

The Guild Master divides Blades-for-Hire into twelve ranks, named after the twelve double-hours. Those of the Si hour and above serve the market's core business; most are martial arts masters with exceptional abilities. Those of the Wu hour and below handle peripheral matters outside the main business; their status is the same as the street vendors in Tian Guang Fang, and they are content with their leisure.

Yin hour Blades-for-Hire are the core backbone, and the overt martial arts business relies on them. They are skilled at playing thugs who rob and kill, often brandishing weapons as they roam, dutifully maintaining their image as villainous muscle.

"Dark wings cry low, disaster looms; shadows sweep through gold and silver light."

Black feathers drift down, and calamity follows. This is the first impression people have of Wrathwings: ominous, dangerous... Pair after pair of uneasy eyes watch him, but Wrathwings never cares.
To Wrathwings, only two things matter: first, flashy moves; second, shiny Ringild. Everything else is trivial and unworthy of mention.

Time long past is buried beneath the yellow sand. Now, Wrathwings works as a treasure hunter, his mission to acquire more Ringild.
Wherever there are Ringild or treasures, Wrathwings will find his way there.
And for the right price, his martial arts and the hook-swords in his hands can be yours to command.

A dark, nightmarish figure, a Nightmare made manifest.
A chilling, slender Twinblade Dreamslayer hides in the Shadow and dreams, waiting for the right moment to strike.
The Shadow beneath its purple feathers is the last memory of its prey, and the moon blades it wields are the pride of a lone hunter.
The Twinblade Dreamslayer is born of dreams, one with everything around it.
It glides through the air, its gorgeous slashes like phantoms.

It tears through one dream after another, traversing fantasy after fantasy.
The dark gait is merely an interlude to the Hunting; the dreams of the mediocre are its sustenance.

It lurks in the Nightmare of students,
absorbing the obsessions and darkness in people's hearts to reshape itself.
From the bite of a Feralwolf to the pounce of a giant bear,
it gradually condenses the power of destruction within endless bestiality.
This shadow born of dreams attempts to break the boundary between reality and illusion, using sharp blades to tear the present world apart.

"The more awake you are in a dream, the more trapped you are in reality."
The awakened shadow projects the despair and darkness from the depths of the soul into people's dreams,
and thus the dream twists into this dark incarnation of disaster.

Ascend to the heights and question your heart. In autumn, all things reach their peak. When you reach the summit, you see all the mountains as small. When I look back, no one is behind me. The only one who can rival me is myself. Pride breeds an Inner Demon, and the Inner Demon transforms into me to question me: Are you truly satisfied? In an instant, the Inner Demon multiplies into thousands, clones surging like a tide, rushing to my side, each one questioning the deepest obsession in my heart—clearly one person can overcome ten thousand difficulties, so why be confined to this small world? How can you be satisfied?

"Simple appearance hides unfathomable depths, changing tracks to hide in the mortal world." 
Someone saw him at the tavern; he was a fortune teller then, and he always liked to probe for the reasons behind those who came to ask for signs. Someone met him at an antique stall; the various jars displayed were rarely for sale, as he only said he was waiting for those destined. Others have seen him as a waiter in a restaurant, acting efficiently and being unusually talkative. 

His honest and simple appearance is his best cover. He is the Chou-hour bounty hunter of the market's Tian-Guang Workshop, wandering in the shadows year-round, gathering intelligence for the workshop, collecting rare materials, and forging divine weapons. 

Although he ranks below the Zi-hour bounty hunter, his mysterious movements make him difficult to grasp. He never wears the standard bounty hunter attire, instead hiding in the marketplace as a merchant or fortune teller. He hides in plain sight, rarely returning to the market as a secret agent. 

This time he appeared on the Littoral Towership because he discovered that the entrance to the ruins here has opened, and the long-dormant Littoral Spirit Drive is gradually awakening. He is quietly lurking and watching, waiting for the right moment to bring this ancient power back to the Tian-Guang Workshop for the workshop master's use.

This ancient tree on the banks of Tunyun Lake has long since mutated into a Greed predator, caught between decay and vitality. Anyone who steps into its territory becomes nourishment for its roots.

[Poison Spore Exhale]: Moonelia Sprout summons multiple Vine. Breaking them grants spherical shields of different colors. The flower bud then exhales multi-colored poison spores that fall slowly. When the spores land or touch a player, they create a toxic miasma zone. Only players with a matching shield color can safely rupture the spores upon contact and restore Health.


[Forest Strangling]: While Negate the poison spores, players must also do their best to sever the Vine. If all Vine are not cleared within a certain time, Moonelia Sprout will launch a map-wide devastating Attack.

"People who rely on boats may not be good swimmers, yet they can still cross rivers." This saying holds true for the creation of a bronze cube that harnessed the power of the imprint to reach the other side of the ocean.

Since its inception, the Littoral Spirit Drive has tirelessly kept the ship in working order, day and night. Many would gaze at it, wondering if it would protect them on their journey. However, the Mechcraft structure remained silent, its only response being the flickering of its light.

It envisioned a future not too far away, where fleets of ships would embark on a grand voyage across the vast ocean. But it also foresaw that it would not be a part of this adventure. Instead, it would remain stranded in the winding river of history, having fulfilled its purpose long before.

The most unpredictable bounty hunter of the Bazaar's Sky-Light Workshop has finally shed his disguise to reveal his fangs, vowing to plunder the newly awakened Littoral Spirit Drive.

[Earth-Shattering Rock]: Black Claw uses his arm guards to gather rocks and hurl them into the arena. The rocks cause large-scale explosions upon landing. Players can guide the location of the falling rocks to leave a safe zone. The debris scattered after the explosion can be picked up by players.

[Rock-Gathering Armor Break]: Black Claw leaps into mid-air, his arm guards at full power, creating a strong suction force that pulls players toward him. Players must throw the debris at the weak points on his arm guards to interrupt his attack.

The Spirit-Drive's Mechcraft core is overloading, the onslaught of lava and lasers is multiplying, and the pressure from the giant bronze casket above makes the footing precarious.

[Lava Frenzy]: The frequency of falling lava pillars has increased significantly, causing more dense damage to the arena.

[Falling Giant Casket]: After the lava pillars end, a giant bronze casket will spawn above players, falling after a warning to deal Damage and cause the floor to collapse. Players must dodge, or they will easily fall into the abyss.

Alata · Spring's inner divine power surges out of control. A century of suppressed sorrow and rage pours down as a rain of swords, dragging challengers into a fight to the death.

[Sword Guidance to Break Barriers]: Alata · Spring protects herself with the Barrier of the Decaying Spring, making her immune to normal skill Damage. After locking onto a player for a charge, a sword formation descends, and multiple flying swords shoot out. The locked-on player can guide one of the flying swords to shatter the Barrier of the Decaying Spring. Other flying swords will fly straight through and must be dodged to avoid explosive Damage. The charge and sword formation repeat for several rounds; successfully guiding the flying swords to break the barrier four times will cause Alata · Spring to collapse. If the attack fails for too long, her Damage will overwhelm the entire arena.

[Spring Umbrella Shelter]: Alata · Spring summons four closed spring umbrellas around the arena. Players must strike the umbrellas to open them. When the channeling ends, Alata · Spring will absorb any remaining closed umbrellas, gaining a layer of power boost for each one absorbed, before unleashing a torrential downpour. Only by hiding under an opened umbrella can players avoid the rain and take no Damage.

"How much money are we even making on this job? Why risk your life for it?"

As a commercial guild, the Tianguang Workshop inevitably faces accounting disputes. Even the merchants and diners in the Ruins Market have problems with debts owed to each other. It doesn't matter; the You-Hour Bounty Hunters specialize in settling accounts for others. They carry a large abacus with them, and when they reach the debtor, they first take out the abacus to calculate the principal and interest, and after beating the other party up, they calculate how much is left to pay.

Don't say a miser won't pluck a single hair; this is called being meticulous about every penny.

The Littoral Spirit Drive turns the towership's final will into a suffocating, desperate blockade. Lightning weaves into a cage, and giant chests fall like a collapsing mountain.

[Cross-Light Prison]: The Littoral Spirit Drive's Laser Attack summons four light walls that separate players into different areas, severely limiting movement and regrouping.

[Sea-Covering Abyss]: The frequency of lava pillars and Lasers will increase once more, eventually generating giant chests that fall from the sky. You must move precisely to find a sliver of hope.

Embermane no longer underestimates its opponent and will unleash its true royal flames. The power of the sea of fire is enough to incinerate everything, compressing the prey's living space to the limit.

The Moonelia Sprout pushes the binding power of its roots to the limit, weaving toxic miasma and sap into a deadly cage. Any hesitation means death.

[Sap Imprisonment]: The Moonelia Sprout fires sap bullets to trap players and will always extend branches to grab a member to drain their energy. The trapped player must be rescued by teammates breaking the sap in time, or they will perish and grant the Spirit Wood a buff. Meanwhile, other players will be hindered by Vines and must break free quickly to assist.

[Toxic Spore Shower]: The drop frequency of toxic spores increases significantly, the interval shortens, and they no longer provide healing, drastically increasing survival pressure.

All sounds fade, and the world loses its color. Only black and white remain in the world. Winter, all things shed their vanity. Having walked through the growth of spring, the entanglement of summer, and the accumulation of autumn, one finally merges completely with their sword, their path, and their true heart in the silence of winter. This is the end of the trial. Its spring is like angry thunder, its summer like misty bewilderment, its autumn like a wild gale, and its winter snow illuminates the undying sword heart. Everything returns to peace, to the origin, to the initial sword heart.

"Stone relics fade with time, as the years deepen around the empty hall."

It has remained in a deep slumber since its creation, awakening only a handful of times. Before it stood a white-bearded elder with hands clasped behind his back, followed by diligent youths in training.

As the stars shifted and the world transformed, the pillars supporting the heavens collapsed and the earth cracked. The Dual-Axe General awoke amidst the ruins. It knew not where the bustle of the past had vanished, but it remembered the mission forged into its bronze body: to serve as a Guardian, to protect until the enemy armies retreated, and until all could dream without concern.

Alata · Summer takes to the air, the power of the gods surging like uncontrollable summer thunder. She carves a judgment formation with a giant thunder sword, forcing challengers to complete a life-or-death formation before the thunder penalty descends.

[Thunder Formation]: A giant sword falls in the center of the arena, periodically releasing thunder shockwaves. Additionally, eight formation eyes are generated. Alata · Summer will rain down swords upon players; shattering these swords turns them into formation flags. Players must place the flags into the eight formation eyes to activate a protective barrier and withstand the falling thunder penalty.

Alata · Winter drags the battlefield into an Eternal Night of total extinction. Only by igniting the spark of life amidst absolute death can one tear through this endless winter.

[Seasonal Cycle]: Alata · Winter hovers in the air, and the world fades to black and white. A "Void Star Vortex" opens in the center of the arena; players must keep moving to break free from its gravity. Three seasonal beacons appear on the field. The team must split into three groups—Spring, Summer, and Autumn—and head to their respective beacons: specific players interact with the beacons while their companions defend them. Once all three beacons are activated, three-colored light beams strike the Void Star Vortex, restoring color to the world.

[Passing the Torch]: Alata · Winter turns into an Eternal Night, plunging the battlefield into absolute darkness that continuously drains player Health and summons endless monsters. Everyone must cooperate to reactivate the three beacons and summon the "Flame of Life"—the only place where one is immune to the darkness. The Flame of Life gradually weakens, and a player must sacrifice their life to keep it burning. Other players must defeat monsters, collect the dropped "Embers," and recharge the "Flame of Life." Once the light of the Flame of Life illuminates the entire arena, it becomes the perfect opportunity to defeat Alata · Winter.

The gambling tools engraved by Du Zhuan Yaoque are lifelike, with a four-core drive spitting out punitive hellfire, trapping intruders in a fiery chess game.

[Tile Mountain Siege]: Firebringer leaps off the field, and a large number of 'One-Tong' bullets are fired from all directions like shuffling cards, followed by four crumbling mahjong walls that slam down, building a mountain of tiles that blocks the path.

[Deadly Tile Push]: A full row of mahjong tiles descends continuously from a single direction, pushing forward after landing, leaving only a single gap for one to pass through. Players must observe and dash into the gap several times to dodge.

[Deadlock Crush]: After the mechanism ends, Firebringer appears in the center of the field to charge up and cover itself with a Shield, while the two opposite walls slowly crush toward the center. You must break the Shield before being crushed for the walls to dissipate; if you fail to break the Shield in time, all members will suffer devastating crushing Damage.

A bronze mechcraft infused with lightning, larger than the average Lost Constructor.
Purple electricity overflows between its giant pincers, and the crackling noise is a clear sign of danger.
The sound emitted before unleashing a thunder strike gradually grows louder; this is the only time enemies have a brief window to react.

It is speculated that in addition to maintenance work, the Lost Thunder Bringer also serves as an energy supplier within the ruins.
Jixia mechcrafters are trying to figure out the secret to their durability.

The rules of the Flame Chess match remain unchanged, but the karmic fire summoned by the Firebringer is more solid, testing the challenger's focus and patience with every flame. [Initial Blazing Intent]: The overall mechanics remain consistent with the normal challenge, with no additional changes.

Reaching the summit, arrogance is born. When wings flap, the wind rises; when wings fold, the clouds gather. In this vast world, how could those common birds trapped in crags and fighting over carrion be worthy of perching on high cliffs with him? His wings are like blades, his roar like the sky collapsing. With every span of his wings, the mountains and rivers change color. There is no part of the vast sky he cannot measure. Looking at the beings below the mountain, he feels they are all mediocre people trapped in anger and lost in confusion, unworthy of discussing swordsmanship with him. Looking at the sword in his hand, he feels nothing in the world can block its edge, and he gradually forgets that "the sword is for protecting the path".

Black Claw's latent instincts make its attacks more cunning, with falling rocks and self-destructing devices intertwined, testing the team's adaptability and execution.

[Rockfall Frenzy]: Black Claw pushes its arm guard power to the limit, increasing the number of falling rocks. Players need to throw more debris to destroy the arm guards.

[Mechcraft Traps]: Black Claw will summon additional small self-destructing robots. Though small, these devices can interfere with Black Claw's arm guards, so keep an eye on their movements.

When the storyteller in town speaks of the Radish King, he slams the table and launches into the tale with gleaming eyes:

"At first glance, the creature looks like an enormous radish, blown up to an absurd scale. Its surface is covered in uneven ridges, like earth that has cracked and healed over time. Atop its head, vibrant green leaves sway like towering forest trees.

Beneath those leaves lies a pair of slanted, cunning eyes, glinting with mischief. But what truly draws the eye is the cleaver it carries. The blade gleams under the sun—clearly no ordinary tool—and in its hands, it strikes with terrifying force."

"If you ever encounter it, never underestimate it. Among the creatures born of radish-kind, it stands as one of the fiercest. Its behaviour may defy reason, but one thing is certain: it is no easy opponent."

Black Claw pushes its traps to the limit, extending the threat of falling rocks indefinitely. Any negligence could lead to destruction.

[Ember Spread]: After the falling rocks explode, they leave behind burning ember zones that persist for a significantly longer time, putting the team's positioning to the test.

A rare Henggong fish with stiff fins. It excels at fighting in rapids and resembles a beast with a red face, green whiskers, and exposed fangs.
A common grouper with emerald-like markings on its back. It often lies still near mossy stones by the stream to remain Veiled.
A common loach, as soft as a willow and as thin as silk. They swim in groups through mountain streams, like willow branches brushing the water, swaying gracefully.
A rare grouper that is no longer satisfied with crossing the ocean, so it has swum into the boundless dream.
