The biggest difference between a human and a Mechcraft Puppet is that a human has a heart capable of empathizing with the world. While this heart can be imitated in form, it cannot be made to resonate with the things of this world. Of course, this is just a shackle that predecessors could not break. For Luban, what he wanted was something transcendent. So even though Luban No. 7 was just a mechanical being, he still wanted to use his own power to warm this heart that should have been cold. 'Papa...' the little mechanical being spoke for the first time. Fortunately, miracles do not fail those who are prepared.

She still dreams of the fire that consumed the Thousand Caves. Amidst the sea of sparks from the burning scrolls, everything she once cherished turned to nothing. Bewilderment, pain, regret... If that resentment was the boulder dragging her into the abyss, then the vow to rebuild the Thousand Caves was the candle lighting her path. It is her responsibility and her wish. She will surely do her utmost to recover the lost scrolls page by page, and the vast library of the Thousand Caves will eventually reappear in the world.

For the Shye of the past, treasure hunting was merely a final straw to escape debt. People always said there was no treasure Shye couldn't find, but in truth, the crushing weight of her past left her no room to rest. Yet, she eventually broke free from her shackles. The little girl from the Southlands grew up, stumbling along the way, but finally able to smile from the heart. The Yiguang Treasure Hunting Group pursues more than just treasures; they pursue unbridled freedom.

A Roving Star wanders through the galaxy, casting its dazzling light wherever it reaches. Yet, occasionally, it wonders why it is always alone. Fortunately, a burning conviction will always attract fellow stars. In the star cluster known as the Star Team, they live and train together, traversing the heavens and the seas, and even becoming the champions of the Dream of Return. The Sword of Stars finally found his peace in Jixia. The trajectory of stars is always hard to discern; perhaps they will shine individually in the future, but the bond of their journey through the star sea will never be forgotten.

Some say revenge is a fool's game. The flames that scorch the heart and lungs use hatred as fuel, driving the avenger to pick up a blade and plunge into an endless, cruel Infinite. Kai looks at the girl and glimpses a soul that, though still young, has been forged into the shape of blood and fire. So, he teaches her the blade—not to sway cause and effect, but simply to give the rage in her chest a path to pour out. Revenge is a fool's game, but wise men are rare in this world.

The desert winds are biting, and so the people there are honed to be as tough as stubborn stones.
Even so, Kai still couldn't fathom why he was being pestered by this Tigerhead demon-kind; he had only given the guy a good thrashing, after all.
He kept shouting about wanting to learn martial arts—surely he just wanted to use it to pick fights, right?
He quickened his pace, turning left and right, but that large tiger head with its honest smile always seemed to appear right in front of him, as if it were his shadow.
He didn't seem like a bad person, though.
He expressionlessly raised the blade in his hand, watching as that tiger face panicked and crouched down, shielding its head. The corner of his mouth curled into an almost imperceptible arc.
"Pick up the sword."
"Huh?"
"Pick up the sword. I'll teach you."

The scenery of Jixia is far too gentle compared to the Wolf Banner. Princess Frost dares not go into the crowds, fearing that the cold power within her will destroy the hard-won peace and beauty here. However, even Jixia has been scorched by the flames of war. To meet with weapons and fight to the death—is this the eternal fate that mortals cannot escape? Her worries lingered for a long time until she met that straightforward girl, whose beautiful and pure emotions moved even the power of frost. The war is over, and she should look forward.

The young man stepping onto Jixia soil for the first time had no heart for the scenery. His resentment and anger drove him forward: to go to that legendary academy and find enough reasons to refute his father's stubborn philosophy.
Young hotheads always take a hard fall. Little did he know, the fatherly military tactics he looked down upon actually had such practical value. Knowing how to rebel is a good thing, but learning from the wisdom of predecessors is the smart way.
Opening the military manual again with an objective mind, and having a serious conversation with his father... This time, the young man crossed the threshold known as rebellion.

She has loved reading since she could remember. The scent of paper, the sound of turning pages, and those exquisite words... she was deeply fascinated by them all. Of course, even works that others considered incoherent had their own unique merits in her eyes. For example, sentences with little embellishment but sincere emotion, or bizarre and whimsical metaphors. She smiled and gently tucked the popular novel in her hand into the bookshelf.

Everyone knows that Xingmang has poor eyesight due to an eye condition. Even so, people still hold him in high regard. Not only because of his outstanding talent, but also because he once used his inventions to resolve a crisis at the academy. Whenever students mention this, he just laughs and says his current fireworks research is even more worth looking forward to. Few people know that beneath his explosive personality lies a gentle and soft soul.

The turning points of destiny are always sudden. Especially for Sun Bin, the rotating gate of time and space took away not only his legs but also his closest friend. A moment of despair imprisoned him in a deep valley. Looking at the long road ahead, he couldn't even walk on his own, let alone make a comeback. Fortunately, he is not alone; his companions from the Star Team will pierce the darkness of the night sky, light up hope for him, and protect him. So, facing the place where he once fell again, Sun Bin believes that finding his confidence back is just a matter of time.

People often ask, what are the recruitment standards for the Great Wall Safeguard? Is it unmatched strength? Or extraordinary martial arts? In truth, in this remote borderland far from the civilized world, there is little room to be picky. A healthy body and a burning heart are enough. The desert winds will temper everyone on the Great Wall into a resilient warrior.

To Yao, Jing seems like a distant horizon he can never reach. Obtaining the power of the stars is a glorious moment that belongs entirely to her. Only through day-and-night training and gritted-teeth perseverance can he stand by her side and share the burden. However, his time studying alone at Jixia was long—so long that Yao finally realized through repeated failures that everything requires progress. The power of the stars is already an affirmation of him. Before catching up to his sister, the first thing he must do is acknowledge that he, too, is a shining star.

Li Bai has traveled to many places, seen the flowers of Chang'an, and the snow of the Great Wall.
He remembers the wild peach tree deep in the mountain temple that no one cared for; when the spring breeze came, it shed petals onto his shoulders. He remembers the cold snow of the frontier, falling in a flurry, dyeing the world in a vast, desolate white. He also remembers the year he entered Chang'an with sword in hand, the blades and fire before his eyes, and the bright moon hanging high in the night sky.
Wind, flowers, snow, and moon—it is a lingering poem, a cold sword shadow.
With sword in hand, reciting poems, drinking wine, he continues on his way.

Senior Yao is famous at the academy for his flamboyant speaking style and flashy swordsmanship; his presence is like that uncontrollable star power, always sparking something different at the academy. If his brilliance and playfulness are Yao's surface, then the figure working hard at sword practice on the Stargazing Terrace in the dead of night is rarely seen, and the solemn promise behind his jokes is unknown to most. The real Yao might have many other sides...

This flower is so beautiful it puts others to shame; it belongs in the Jade Pool. Memories of the past are mostly like the coarse gravel of the Southlands, carrying a gray, bitter taste. Deceived and framed, her small body remained tense, unable to sleep through any night. It wasn't until she arrived in Jixia that the coarse gravel finally softened, turning into a lotus flower with a hint of fragrance. Yes, Jixia is like a lotus—pure, beautiful, and carrying a fresh scent. The lotus-like magical light blooming in her hands is her soft and affectionate expectation for her new home, Jixia.

Few people know that the palms of every Great Wall Safeguard soldier are covered in rough calluses. The iron sword hilt is hard and heavy, cold as ice in winter and hot as iron in midsummer. Day after day, she taught those maneuvering techniques by example. Only after countless springs and autumns of tempering were those fleeting, stunning shadows on the battlefield forged. No martial art can be mastered overnight; in this world, there are rarely shortcuts.

Lychill's reclusive nature often makes her seem aloof, but she actually hides a touch of imperceptible tenderness. Perhaps because she was once pulled from the abyss, she doesn't blame her shy admirers, but guides them patiently. She also shows unprecedented respect and care for the seniors who have helped her. As she says, she has likely fallen in love with life in Jixia, and is no longer obsessed with the past. Whenever she gazes at the sunset, the afterglow of Jixia fills her with hope. It's good this way.

Shye once felt her world was very small, only big enough to hold her treasures. She guarded against those who approached her like a wary little beast, ready to dive into the woods and disappear at the slightest sign of trouble.
Shye no longer remembers how she changed. Perhaps it was that noisy genius; perhaps it was that girl who loved to slack off; or perhaps... Jixia is truly too soft, and no matter how hard the shell, it will eventually melt away.
Now, Shye feels her world is vast, capable of holding not just her treasures, but all of Jixia.

Long ago, Sun Bin placed shackles upon his own heart. He only dared to sniff out from the cracks, helplessly receiving the emotions transmitted from those around him. As a child so gentle and delicate, he was naturally filled with a bit of unease and curiosity when interacting with others. Fortunately, he met those warm-hearted people. The kindness from others planted seeds that took root, sprouted, and finally grew into a towering tree. The empathetic youth unlocked his shackles and radiated a gentle light toward the world.

After becoming the Princess Frost revered by the Wolf Banner tribe, Princess Frost often missed the carefree days spent playing with a few friends before she left her homeland. Gentleness and mercy are her true nature; she loves her people unconditionally, but no one knows how much she longs for companionship. Later, the winds of Jixia stirred her sweet, girlish fantasies, and the curious approach of a River Spirit shattered her cold, silent loneliness. From then on, the hope sleeping in her heart began to awaken...

For Xingmang, losing things is as common as a gunpowder explosion. Yet, the students working with him always complain that their teacher's carelessness is a headache. Especially after hearing that his "most dangerous weapon" has vanished, everyone except Xingmang becomes incredibly nervous. But in the process of searching for the lost item, some have noticed that Teacher Xingmang seems to have an unknown past...

The path of the Mechcraft master is long and arduous, and the road to becoming a master is a lonely one. Following in the footsteps of predecessors might make the journey easier, but for Luban, achieving and surpassing himself is his lifelong pursuit.
So he rejected all offers and resolutely stayed at the school to conduct research, just to forge a path uniquely his own.
Not attaching his name to anyone else's, he named his latest creation after himself—Luban No. 7.

Predators always walk alone; only cattle and sheep flock together. At least that's what Lady Sun told herself when she was at the noble girls' academy. Ever since she picked up that heavy cannon, her passion has been firmly linked to it. Lady Sun is no longer a little girl who needs to be carefully looked after by her brothers! Inner loneliness? Strange looks? In the face of the young lady's super firepower, none of that matters!

Li Bai never considered himself an elegant man. He traveled the world, drawing his sword against injustice, and somehow earned the nickname "Sword Immortal." He carried a wine gourd at his waist, drinking until he was intoxicated whenever the mood struck, and caused quite a few jokes in his drunken state. Sword in hand and gourd at his side—he was always unrestrained, far removed from the word "elegant." But what of it? Whether elegant or bohemian, let the world judge as it will; my heart is content.

I didn't come to Jixia to make friends! The young man, with his fiery hairstyle and a cold, defiant look, made countless students shy away. However, in the dead of night, recalling his bold words from the day, his heart felt a sting of bitterness, and the seed of loneliness had taken root. Fortunately, those weirdos who called themselves the Star Team broke into his life. They would praise the power of his Mechcraft cannons and show Insight into the soft heart beneath his cold words. Shedding his thorns and softening his edges, he realized that making friends wasn't so hard after all.

Kai once believed he was destined to walk alone.
He was never used to having company; he was like the sword in his hand—sharp, fierce, and relentless, leaving others behind in the blink of an eye.
Of course, that was before he was found by that spirited general.
In fact, there was no ice that those eccentric yet warm and lively folks couldn't melt. Delicious meals, various firearms, and that pair of sharp light and heavy swords... his once empty world was quickly filled to the brim.
For Kai, the once unreachable home finally became clear upon this Great Wall.

What should an ideal friend be like?
Gentle, humorous, incredibly powerful, and someone you can be weird with...
What would it be like if all these fantasies and expectations were blended together?
Lady Sun held her massive firearm and laughed carefreely.
"My firearm is my best friend!"
She probably never expected that in distant Jixia, she would meet a girl from the Southlands and become fast friends.

There are many drugs for healing, and what Lychill wants to refine is the most difficult one to succeed among them.
Others are puzzled; this medicine requires a divine beast as a catalyst, which is too extravagant for healing. Moreover, this medicine is unbearable for ordinary people; even in Jixia, it is very difficult to find someone to test it.
Facing these questions, Lychill's hand refining the medicine paused for a moment, and under her lightly brushed words was a face without a smile.
She lied; this medicine was indeed made for Jixia students, but what she hoped most was that someone could use it and return to how they once were.

She thought she had long since grown accustomed to loneliness. It was nothing more than dancing with a sword alone, warming wine alone; having watched the clouds and mist of Mount Guye for so long, she had forgotten the passage of time. Yet, for some reason, she would still find herself lost in thought, recalling the way the old man taught her to practice swordsmanship many years ago. He was always smiling, his white eyebrows and beard bunched together, looking both comical and kind. Is teaching students really that happy? As her gaze fell on the small figure struggling to dance with a sword not far away, she suddenly found the answer in her heart.
The Bearing of an Old Friend

Meeting an old friend in a strange land is always a wonderful thing. Familiar names and unfamiliar faces—such combinations are always amusing. Not to mention the hilarious or heartwarming stories shared when meeting them. Li Bai has already prepared the wine, just waiting for the day he returns to Chang'an to have a good chat with those "old friends" about what he saw and heard on Mount Guye this time.

Since she could remember, her father always loved telling her interesting stories from all over the world. The brilliant, bright lights of Chang'an like daylight, the starlight reflecting on the endless blue waves of the Sea Metropolis, and the passing of the torch amidst the clouds of Jixia. Even after that monstrous fire swallowed the Thousand Caves, these stories remained treasured in her heart. Because what they told was the unfading love from her father.

Don't provoke Dr. Lychill—this is a well-known truth at the academy. It is said that her identity is mysterious, her medical methods are unconventional, and there are tales of wailing in the infirmary at midnight, mysterious liquids in the medicine furnace, and requests to test medicine that always offer rich rewards but have serious consequences... But even so, people still flock to her for treatment; her brilliant medical skills make people forgive all the little jokes she plays. Moreover, she is also an academy senior who will earnestly remind you of recovery details after the jokes, a good doctor belonging to Jixia.

Beneath the Great Wall that never falls, countless bones are buried deep. Whenever she stands upon this ancient, magnificent wall, and the dust-scented wind brushes her cheek, she feels a momentary trance, as if she has returned to that battlefield of flashing swords and shadows. She clearly remembers every vivid face—those beside her, those who left, and... those who have already fallen into eternal sleep. She will stand guard here firmly, watching this flower of peace she planted with her own hands take root and sprout.

Becoming the master of icy power is not easy; it can even be an unbearable burden. At first, she tremblingly restrained her instincts, walking on thin ice, fearing that the power within her would bring disaster to others. But now, she can control frost with ease, and can even casually make a silly wooden-fence ice sculpture for the cute children she meets on the road. The cold ice did not change her; the cold ice grew with her. One day, that biting wind and snow will also be dyed with the resilient and romantic colors that define her.

If not for the Master's reminder, Sun Bin would likely never have discovered that besides Mechcraft, he possessed another unique talent—extraordinary sincerity and enthusiasm. It is precisely this trait that allows him to handle his new identity with such Deftness. Especially when helping others, his inherent shyness and fragility transform into humility and emotional stability. Perhaps recognition became his motivation. Looking back at the path he has traveled, Sun Bin realizes he is no longer that weak crybaby, but a great tree capable of standing on his own and shielding others from the wind and rain.

She seems like the most "unreliable" visitor to Jixia Academy: reckless, obsessed with agricultural Mechcraft, and well-versed in market prices. Is she really a princess of Jiang Prefecture?
However, after casually resolving a spy incident, she condensed her observations from Jixia—ranging from law and agriculture to commerce—into a blueprint for reform. That focus and capability are another side of her vibrant soul.
Born in the fires of war and raised in chaotic times, she was never destined to be a delicate flower. She will, in her own way, join her brother in carrying Jiang Prefecture toward the future.

Mayene is a very special childhood friend to Meng Ya. All the slacking techniques and mischief-making methods he knows come from this short girl who always calls herself "Big Sister." With just a collision of ideas or a glance, they can cook up brilliant pranks. Although the boy who left home often feels a bit melancholy, especially since they both have somewhat unreliable fathers, who cares? There's nothing a cannon can't solve.

Luban's meticulous care and silent support for his juniors keep the children of the Star Team under his protection. Even if everything happens quietly, the unspoken understanding unique to the Star Team is always at work. Especially on his birthday—the mountain of gifts and the empty courtyard are exactly the kind of peace he loves, delivered by everyone on the Star Team.

When dusk falls over the Great Wall, one can always see a flash of crimson sweeping up the beacon tower. The blade in her hand hums like a feather, while her heavy sword remains dormant like a mountain. As the "Big Sister" trusted by the border guards, she cast aside prejudices of origin, gathered talents, and built a city of faith to serve as a Guardian on the barren frontier. Facing the undercurrents at the border, she left the battlefield at Su Lie's suggestion to serve as an examiner for new recruits at Jixia. Decisive and sharp on the selection field, she uncovers a long-buried secret while visiting an old friend, unfolding another legend of destiny and choice beyond the clash of steel...

Tick, tock. The hands of the stopped clock have yet to move, but Sun Bin has already risen to move forward. At Jixia Academy, if anyone mentions a gentle, shy, and helpful senior, nine times out of ten they are referring to the brilliant mechcraft genius, Sun Bin. Young students admire his illustrious record and the light flowing from his fingertips, yet few know he was once harmed by conspiracy and jealousy, losing both his legs and his dearest friend. Fate brought a turning point through tears. During the Great Mirage, he met his companions from the 'Star Team,' opening his closed heart. From then on, fragmentation and rebirth intertwined into a legend. As his mechanical wings flap, it is as if the stopped clock has begun to chime again, pointing toward hope.

If you're looking for the brightest star among the Jixia students, look no further than Novar.
This self-proclaimed "genius" is always brimming with energy, often blurting out passionate declarations like "Starlight ripples across the universe!" Beneath his seemingly flamboyant personality lies an extreme pursuit of swordsmanship and a complex emotional knot regarding his sister, Jing. His self-invented Star Swordplay is both his claim to fame and a silent declaration of war against her.
He once led the Star Team to a comeback in the Dream of Return, but it came at the cost of overdrawing his star power... Now that they have reassembled, can they fulfill their vow to "carve the Star Team's name on every monument of glory"?
One of the Five Sanctified Generals

As war raged and the people were displaced, the princess sent to marry for peace shed her fine robes, sealed the spring of her homeland into a plum branch gifted by her sister, and rode a plain carriage to the Northlands. The plum branch did not survive the first blizzard, yet she tempered her frost-soul in the Sea of Eternal Winter. When the arrows of her homeland tore through the dawn of the Northlands, Princess Frost awakened from the ancient glaciers. Thousands of ice plum blossoms bloomed on the battlefield, and the thunderous war drums fell silent. The stagnant years began to flow again, and the flower branch she kept close had long since faded, save for when the full moon reflected the frost, revealing those tearful eyes filled with longing before her departure. Now, smoke rises from the ice plains, and the southern lands see the flowers bloom again; it is time to keep a long-awaited promise.

He awoke in the desert, his past memories scattered like shifting sands. Now, he goes by the name 'Kai,' fighting alongside the Great Wall Guard, building a Guardian barrier amidst the smoke of war. The bonfire at the victory banquet is always searingly warm; he sits quietly to the side, watching his comrades sing and dance in their drunken state, yet he dares not let his guard down for a moment. The curse of Fate has never vanished; the Demonic Armor lurking deep within his bloodline constantly seeks to crush his will and push him into the abyss of slaughter. But whenever he teeters on the edge, a youthful voice always pierces the chaos, awakening him. Is Fate truly inescapable? Who is the owner of that voice? The answer remains as elusive as the moon in the mist, deeply shrouded in mystery.

The name of the 'Fiery Cannons' kid is as thunderous as the explosions he creates all over Jixia. Rather than using his mouth, this hot-tempered member of the Star Team prefers to reason with the firepower of his 'Huntian' cannon, acting like a little beast that's always bristling with rage. The word 'rules' seems absent from Meng Ya's dictionary; only 'thrill' is repeatedly circled in red ink. Even with the title of Disciplinary Committee member, he can't be tamed. If you've ever noticed the weekly disciplinary list posted at the academy, you'd find a name that has been quietly scorched away—don't doubt it, that must have been ignited by the boy's passion.

The Qiang flute plays softly, its melody piercing through the layers of gravel outside the City of a Thousand Caves; fragments of ancient scrolls awaken the myriad caves deep within the ruins. After that great fire, the City of a Thousand Caves fell. Garo inherited her father's will, searching for the scattered books to rebuild the city. Restoring a city of scholars is no easy task, but both Garo and the people of the Thousand Caves firmly believe: civilization is a fire that must be passed on. Even if the caves weather away and the ancient texts are lost, what civilization carries will never fade. They will uncover the secrets of history and act as the Guardian of the flame of civilization. "Does civilization exist only in stone caves?" Garo draws her longbow and aims into the distance. This arrow is her vow; civilization will live on in the trajectory of her arrow—for generations to come.

People say that the Mechcraft being that would hold hot tea and call out 'Papa' was a miracle, but no one expected that the miracle would suddenly disappear from Luban's life.
From then on, Luban locked himself in his laboratory. He was unwilling to research new Mechcraft creations, and only his past experimental records and manuscripts accompanied him day after day.
Years later, a misunderstanding linked Luban with a group of youths, forming a team that seemed like child's play but eventually became the champions of the Dream of Return—the 'Star Team'.
The 'Star Team' became another emotional anchor for Luban, and his connection to the world slowly rebuilt itself through the nourishment of friendship...

For every Jixia student afraid of visiting the infirmary, there is another looking forward to falling ill. The reason for this is the Jixia Academy school doctor, Lychill. If you follow her medical advice, she is the most gentle and considerate doctor. But if you don't take your medicine and offend her, there is no telling how many strange potions you will be forced to drink. Few know that while Dr. Lychill appears calm and free-spirited, shadows from her past follow her bloodline, refusing to let go. Fortunately, for those born in the dark, the sun of Jixia is far too dazzling. There is no difference between the potions she brews for patients and enemies; a little danger makes for the perfect seasoning.

The girl with silk wrapped around her wrists hid her real name, looked back, and took the direction of her hometown as her new surname. The gentle monsoon by Pearlized Lake smoothed out the edges of the girl who had been tempered by the Southlands, and the phantom silk strung together the laughter of the Star Team, turning it into the most priceless treasure in her heart. Jixia is now Shye's home, but in the gaps between the relaxed daily life and thrilling treasure hunts, she still often thinks of that dream in quiet moments, beside the shattered statue in the old ancestral hall, clutching the silk clothes soaked in night rain. She seems to see that peaceful old village again, and hears the call from behind coming along the stream, "Yiguang, don't look back, walk the path you want to walk."

Indulging in poetry and wine, enjoying the carefree life of the pugilistic world, entering Chang'an three times, his sword strikes like a startled swan—this is Li Bai, the world's greatest sword immortal known to all. Yet no one knows that his sword once lost its luster and his heart grew lost. With his homeland fallen and his dearest friend unjustly killed, he charged into the Daming Palace with his sword to demand an explanation from the Empress, only to fall into an even deeper trap. One man and one sword cannot settle all the injustices in the world; where should the sword of the immortal Li Bai point? But this momentary frustration could not suppress the edge of the Azure Lotus Sword. He learned to let go of his ethereal regrets—there are countless injustices in the world, but why not start by striking for justice in every matter before one's eyes? His sword heart was cleansed, and the Azure Lotus Sword regained its edge.

Xingmang knows the taste of fame at a young age. It is the burning gaze, the tidal applause, and the youthful spirit held aloft. However, the storms of fate will eventually swallow that spirit. After that accident, the red flames in his eyes were suddenly extinguished—a man born for firearms, blocked by permanently blurred vision, no longer able to study the finest details. The fireworks flashing in the night sky became the only brilliance he could capture; he squinted his eyes, chasing the afterimages of gunpowder explosions. Xingmang had long known his destination. If the road ahead is destined to be annihilated, let these embers turn into light to illuminate those who follow.

——“On Mount Guye, there lives a divine being. She eats no grain, and her heart is like a deep spring.”
Legend has it that Mount Guye in Jixia is the origin of all martial arts in the world. Alata, who lives in seclusion there, is a living legend—the greatest martial artist after the Master. The Zaiyuan Sword she wields is peerlessly sharp, capable of cleaving mountains with a single strike.
When Jixia was on the brink of destruction a century ago, Alata drew her sword and decimated the enemy, saving Jixia from disaster. However, she was severely wounded in the process and forced to retreat to the rear to await the end of the war, only to receive the obituaries of all her closest friends who had fallen on the battlefield.
Unable to heal from her wounds and grieving her friends, Alata went into seclusion for years, seeking an answer for the sword heart that had gone silent after her trauma.
It wasn't until a letter arrived from the Master, stating that Jixia Academy had been rebuilt, that she sat for a whole night before the cenotaphs of her friends. She finally understood her sword heart: she would continue to wield her sword to protect Jixia until the end of her Health.

The current master of the Cloud-Casting Hut on Mount Guye and Minka's senior fellow apprentice. Known as "Jade-Rinsing Snow-Quenching" for her unique quenching ability and mastery of the core techniques for forging cloud-mist weapons. She is currently holding up the beleaguered Cloud-Casting Hut and engaging in a battle of wits against the Tian-Guang Workshop, which peddles evil weapons.

Known as Shisanglang, he is a well-known broker for the Tian-Guang Workshop in Mount Guye. His rhetoric is often very clever, yet he leaves behind subtle, imperceptible flaws. He is a swindler, a performer, and the best clerk the Tian-Guang Workshop has. He is inconspicuous, but he is the only one who can complete the Workshop Master's tasks every time.

Plant a hope in the blue sky and white clouds, and what you harvest is endless clarity.

Atop the mountain peak, amidst the clouds and sunset, dancing with a close friend with long swords. Both swords emerge together, following like shadows. As sleeves flutter, the two long swords rise and fall in unison, as if their hearts are connected, inseparable.

Looking down from the air, the town lights are right below. With a close friend and a neon kite, we overlook Wulian Town. The plank road hangs over the green cliffs, and the houses are scattered among the mountains. Though I am a traveler, my heart has already returned to the mountains.

The mountain wind blows, carrying the scent of pine resin and wild grass. Taking off into the air with a close friend on the Neon Kite, the treetops fade away beneath your feet, and the sea of forest seems to spread out from both sides, drifting amidst the lush greenery.

Sitting side by side on the Blue Stone Cliff, watching the clouds roll and unfurl, the light and shadow move slowly along the ridge. Watching the birds disappear with a close friend, the mountain colors divided equally, enjoying the clouds rising over Fengchuan together.

With towering ancient trees and intertwined branches, under the dappled light and shadows, enjoy the scenery before the river with a close friend, listen to the waterfall plunging from the heights into the deep pool, and watch the vastness of the world together.

The sound of pine waves, the babbling of flowing water, divining fate with a dear friend, asking the heavens and earth—all things resonate in harmony. As the breeze passes through the forest, it feels as if all of heaven and earth have given their response in this very moment.

Dragon Valley holds many secrets. Legend has it that when lightning strikes the dragon bones, it signifies that another brilliant talent is about to emerge. Dr Bian once found a young man here who was paralyzed in both legs and injured by lightning. After checking his pulse, Dr Bian took out some Thread-Silk Ginseng, added the Butterfly-Trace Qian Wood and Qiao-Yao Wood he carried with him, ground them into a paste, and refined it with magic. In the polar night of the Northlands, there is no sun or moon. The ancestors cut frozen wood into clappers, striking them during night patrols to mark the time and drive away wild beasts.

After ten thousand years of wind and snow, a piece of clapper wood sank into the ice abyss, repeatedly soaked by the pulse of the earth. The wood gradually turned bone-like, its hollow cavity filled with frost patterns. When the staff gently taps the frozen earth, the sound of the clapper slowly returns from the depths of the ground—like the echo of distant mountains, like the relaying voices of generations of ancestors. When the wind passes through the staff's cavity, it wails like the whistle of a night watchman, lingering endlessly.

Every prayer of the Northlands ancestors faded into silence in the cold wind. All spirits were silent, until now, when there is finally an echo.

Secret Anecdote I
Master Alata was physically weak in his youth but quite competitive. Whether practicing swordplay, memorizing books, jumping over walls, or breaking stones, he would always challenge others.
The Master would guide him patiently: "If the sword's edge is pointed only for the sake of personal victory, its reach is limited. In this vast world, the responsibility of the strong lies in supporting rather than suppressing, and in protecting rather than seizing."

Secret Anecdote II
Master Alata focused heavily on practical combat in his youth, often sneaking into the mountains to fight monsters, standing his ground even when surrounded by enemies.
Thus, the Master planted maple trees by the river behind Jixia. Whenever Alata was injured, he would consume the fruit from the trees, and the healing effect was immediate.
Alata studied under the Master for many years, and the two often talked under the maple trees. Over time, the trees became imbued with spiritual energy.
After the Great War, Alata was injured and in seclusion, unable to leave the Mount Guye area. The Master noticed this and transplanted the maple trees to Mount Guye.
At first, the maple trees became ill due to the unfamiliar soil and water, but they recovered thanks to Alata's care.
Sometimes Alata would walk over to sit under the sick trees, saying open-mindedly, "A sick tree for a sick bird, how fitting." After saying this, he would drink a few cups of 'Heaven and Earth Brew' and find much comfort.

Collecting anecdotes and city rumors, penning them down into letters.

This sword does not seek to please with ornamentation, nor does it intimidate with a cold glare. Its body is entirely gray-black, like the surface of an ancient rock—rough, heavy, and solid. Only a bone-white ridge runs through the spine of the blade, like the peak of a solitary mountain, eternal and unmoving.

It does not ring softly. Once unsheathed, the sound of the blade is like tearing silk—an echo of iron and stone striking the heavens. It is a reflection of its master, who has weathered the world without changing their resolve: true grandeur lies in the bone, not the appearance.
Crimson Ember of a Thousand Rivers

Mechcraft wings decorated with metal clocks.
Clocks with different time scales are set on the casing, moving steadily at their own speeds.
Listen closely, and you can hear the ticking of the hands.
Flowing with time and returning to silence is merely a lie and a delusion belonging only to it.
It seems everything is an ancient dream that cannot be pursued once you turn your head.

The sword body is covered with a layer of deep blue frost patterns, cold to the touch. It is said that only weapons forged and quenched on the night of a full moon possess such a trait.

A martial artist from Mount Guye was once lucky enough to obtain one, and swinging it seemed to make moonlight flow, hence it was named Flowing Frost.

The sword body is slender, forged from cold iron through thousands of hammerings. Facing the sun, it reflects a cyan light.

Although this sword is not a divine weapon, it has earned the trust of blade-for-hire warriors due to its lightweight feel and durability.

A sword that once shone through the annals of history.
Like a dragon veiled in the clouds. The day it descends upon the world is the day the winds and clouds shift.
As the dragon dances in the nine heavens, its endless power flows like a reversed celestial river, cleansing the world of all evil and washing away mortal suffering.
With thunder like a prison and storms like boulders, after the heavens collapsed, that pure light of salvation finally swayed and fell into the mortal realm.

In the polar night of the Northlands, there is no sun or moon. The ancestors cut frozen wood into clappers, striking them during night patrols to mark the time and drive away wild beasts.

After ten thousand years of wind and snow, a piece of clapper wood sank into the ice abyss, repeatedly soaked by the pulse of the earth. The wood gradually turned bone-like, its hollow cavity filled with frost patterns. When the staff gently taps the frozen earth, the sound of the clapper slowly returns from the depths of the ground—like the echo of distant mountains, like the relaying voices of generations of ancestors. When the wind passes through the staff's cavity, it wails like the whistle of a night watchman, lingering endlessly.

Every prayer of the Northlands ancestors faded into silence in the cold wind. All spirits were silent, until now, when there is finally an echo.

Heaven and earth as the furnace, creation as the forge. Its quality bears the weight of the profound heavenly order, and its momentum holds the power of molten earth-fire. Legend says that when it moves, wind and thunder follow, and all things resonate with it; when still, it acts as a pivot, drawing all energy from the eight directions. On the ancient, heavy hammer handle, a line of inscription has weathered time, saying, "None but those with the power to turn the tides of the universe may lift this hammer; none but those who bear the ambition to reshape creation may withstand this blade."

A sword from the heavens, exiled to the mortal realm.

The origin of this sword is unknown. Some say that one night, when all the stars dimmed, a trace of pure light fell from the Ziwei Enclosure and transformed into this blade. When the sword was forged, there was no thunder to quench it, nor dragon blood to sharpen its edge; the blade simply emanated a cold radiance, like a lonely moon hanging in the sky, so cold and clear it could not be looked upon directly.

Its form is simple, requiring no embellishment; it does not dazzle with carvings or stun with exotic colors. When unsheathed, it casts a clear radiance like the morning moon in a frosty sky, leaving all things silent; when sheathed, its brilliance is fully contained, like a deep, cold pool, leaving no trace behind.

He who wields this sword does not control it with force, but with spirit. The sword's intent lies not in slaughter, but in a pure, unyielding spirit that has been cast down into the mortal world.

To enable the frame to withstand exceptionally massive impact, the gauntlet frame and Material Type have been specially reinforced. Therefore, it can use gunpowder several times more Fury than usual.

When fired, the gauntlet vibrates and hums, like a beast that cannot suppress its temper. When the cannon fires, the roar of the beast can be heard from dozens of miles away.

A simple, ancient longsword. Its design is not exquisite; the blade is rough and covered in scratches. It may not be the best choice for combat, but it is the starting point for countless martial artists.

This sword no longer seeks form on the outside, but turns inward to seek the soul. The blade seems cast from ancient ink, entirely mysterious black, with only the edge shimmering with a dark light in the play of shadow and light. Ink flows at the guard, like wild cursive script written with a suspended wrist—free and unconstrained.

It is a heavy sword without an edge, great skill that requires no artifice. When swung, it carries the scent of ink, as if it intends to use the world as paper to rewrite the path of chivalry.

A jet-black Mechcraft arm forged by the hands of a god-imitator. It is a miracle achieved through Mechcraft, an act of defiance by mortals against the supreme existence. This massive Mechcraft arm seeks to lay claim to powers beyond the mortal realm.
All things in the world shall turn to dust in its grasp, and all things shall be reshaped anew by its caress.
He wakes from his dream, the myth has quietly faded, but the ambition to usurp the gods is already branded upon his heart.
Without looking back, he moves forward, walking into the vast wilderness of history.

This sword is long, slender, and straight, with a deep blue-gray hue throughout. At first glance, it appears plain, but as you slowly turn the blade in the light, you can see the dark patterns naturally formed during forging.

Because it was forged from a rare, exotic iron found at the bottom of a hundred-fathom deep pool, the sword feels incredibly light—so light that it feels like holding a gust of wind. The sound of the blade is neither sharp nor dull, but a long, low hum, like the sound of wind sweeping through the depths of distant mountains.

Birds are not tied to ropes, and the long wind is not tied to objects; this sword is not tied to obsession. It is just a sword, and therefore, it is free of all burdens. This sword is unbridled, traveling only with the long wind.

A narrow blade forged from silver stardust, thin as a cicada's wing and light as a feather. The edge has been tempered by starlight, revealing a winding band of galactic light.

The entire blade flows with clear starlight, and the hilt is hollowed out from meteorite iron, resembling a glowing blue bird ready to cross the galaxy.

That lightness perfectly echoes the celestial river flowing within the blade. Blade inscription: "Become a roving star, shatter the galaxy."

Dual blades of light and heavy weight forged from mithril unearthed from the depths of the desert, with blades as bright as a new moon.
Wielding these sharp blades is like wielding silver light; they are invisible, unstoppable, and strike silently in an instant.
Nothing cannot be cut, nothing cannot be broken. When these swords are raised on the battlefield, the resounding war cry boils like fire.
It is an insurmountable boundary marker, the tenacity of a hundred battles, and an immortal vow to guard the desert forever.

Scrap iron once abandoned in the mountains, picked up by a boy by chance. With a longing and admiration for heroes, the boy polished it by the stream for three years, finally giving it the shape of a sword.

This sword is not meant to sever all things, but to question one's own heart.

Legend has it that when these gauntlets were being test-fired after completion, they were caught in a thunderstorm. A bolt of lightning struck the house and landed right on the gauntlets. Among the wreckage, the gauntlets were not destroyed but gained several lightning patterns.

By such chance, a bolt of "lightning" was sealed within the gauntlets. When the wearer swings them, faint lightning crackles around them, possessing immense power. When the gunpowder ignites, the power of lightning is added to it.

A primitive gauntlet with a molten iron-colored surface, it has weathered the years without gathering dust, its dark red surface seemingly never having cooled down. How it was forged is now a mystery; it is only known that its Mechcraft core is far from ordinary. Its temperature is scorching, capable of emitting high heat for hundreds of years without fading.

During close-quarters combat, the knuckles emit a very low hum as they brush against the air—the sound of metal vibrating slightly under constant high heat. After being fired, the projectile self-ignites in mid-air, dragging a persistent tail flame like a meteor in the white night.

Engraved on the back of the gauntlet is a small inscription: This heart is like iron, burning as it was at the start.

Curved blades of black and white, their edges chilling to the bone.
The black parts are forged from meteorite iron, dark as the midnight sky, while the white parts are forged from mithril, bright as the lonely moon. The two materials complement each other's weaknesses.
When the twin blades dance, their beauty and illusion are like flickering light and shadows, leaving no one able to discern their form.
The blades are inscribed with the words "Kiss of the Light-Stealer".

The sword body is narrow and thin, its luster restrained, almost non-existent. Looking at it is like looking at mountains through fog, or looking at the moon in water; the sword shadow is elusive. Its edge is hidden, and its intent is deep and profound. There is no need for a starting move to draw the sword, and no destination to sheath it.

Legend has it that this sword was forged by a swordsmith on Mount Guye after years of facing a pool of water, suddenly realizing the 'vast Swordheart, the mystery within, not falling into words,' and then returning to the forge to create this sword.

A lotus-shaped magical artifact, its center suffused with a bright, emerald hue. The wild, growing light of Health will burst forth during battle, sending thousands of brilliant fireflies circling between heaven and earth to cleanse the world of all evil. New emerald sprouts awaken in the cracks of decay, wandering through withered fissures, finally blooming into the long-awaited lushness. Life has always been this way—forever tenacious, forever vibrant, endlessly cycling through birth and death.

A rough, experimental gauntlet with exposed joint mechanisms, still bearing scorch marks from its first test fire. Every shot releases only scattered sparks and gunpowder smoke; though unremarkable, it is the first declaration of an indomitable fighting spirit.

A rare sword rumored to be found in Mount Guye. Its craftsmanship is exceptional, and it requires nourishment from righteous energy. Few are worthy of wielding it.

The blade has faint purple cloud patterns. When drawn, the sound of the sword carries the roar of wind and thunder, exuding a majestic righteousness that repels all evil.

Legend has it that these gauntlets were forged by a Mechcraft artisan at midnight. The chamber of the gauntlets has no firing pin. The firing mechanism was replaced by a special flint, which sparks when the fist is clenched, like striking a match in the dark.

When the shell is fired, a firework explodes into a sky full of golden-red fire rain, tearing the night into pieces before falling down. The momentary brilliance is so dazzling that one might mistake the night for being set ablaze.

A slender staff carved from translucent beast bone, as clear and crystalline as frozen snow.
The handle is carved into a beast's head, and the tip is ground into sharp claws. When swung, it tears through the wilderness, and ice, wind, and frost swallow time.
The giant beast roams the extreme cold, and the biting snow sweeps the world. Wrapped in robes of snow and mist, she walks into the fantasies of all living things.
The girl returns from the clouds as an envoy of ice and snow, with an icy blue giant beast as her mount;
She is the Queen of the North, the master of ice and frost. With a gentle exhale, a frozen kingdom rises here.

The sword body is as clear as ice, and the guard is carved in the shape of a white egret folding its wings, elegant and cold. The patterns are drawn in frost silver, like ripples created when a white egret wades through water, cold and restrained.

Forged by the side of a quiet, cold pool, it moves silently, leaving only a clear white light, making one involuntarily think of the legendary martial arts master of Mount Guye, with a temperament that is independent and aloof from the world.

A white jade-textured burst core encased in metal. Its round appearance resembles a heavy hammer. Its manic intent transforms into a scorching metal storm, tearing through any villain in its path and reducing evil to ashes amidst a deafening roar. Deep within this chilling war machine lies not cold machinery, but the spirit of a youth tempered into steel by gunfire, vowing to cleanse evil with the fury of thunder.

The knuckles are fitted with a five-port flame-breathing mechanism. When the gunpowder detonates, the force blooms like an exotic flower, and the scorching waves rush forward. The missile drags a bright red flame tail, like a burst of fire, unmasked, ready to blast through the enemy formation in one go.

The gauntlet features a triple-pressurized chamber. A single punch releases waves of force, like a Great Axe splitting a mountain. It is not just a weapon; it is a burst of unshaped fire, a ringing cry of defiance against being mere common iron.

A giant blade forged in volcanic lava, presenting a cracked black rock texture due to extreme heat.
It is said that on the day this blade was forged, the smith saw a grinning Yama demon amidst the flames within the rippling spine of the blade.
This blade is meant to purge all evil spirits from the world.
Retaining the coarse nature of volcanic rock, viscous scarlet magma flows endlessly through the cracks.
Flames erupt, the Yama laughs, and where the blade passes, nothing remains.

The sword body is like a pool of spring water, thin and translucent, with bamboo-like textures faintly visible growing from the spine. When swung, the wind passes over the blade, and the sound is like fingers tapping lightly on green bamboo, ethereal and distant.

There was once a swordsman who realized the sword in a bamboo forest on a rainy night, listening to the rustling of ten thousand stalks, and suddenly had an inspiration, so he integrated the sound of that night's wind and rain into the sword.

The sword is long and slender, like a reed bent by dew. The blade is frost-white, with a touch of fresh green blooming from the guard, like ink on rice paper, blossoming in spring waters.

It is agile, yet not fragile; it appears bent, but it possesses true Stance. A youth wielding a sword in the jianghu is like this green reed, their character beginning to shine.

The sword body is as crimson as wine, with a crescent moon at the guard. This sword was forged by a swordsmith who drank all day. After spending a day together, a swordsman came to invite him for a drink, and the two fought with wine for several days until they were completely drunk. Days later, the swordsman bid farewell, and the swordsmith forged this sword in his drunken state.

According to him, this sword was not forged from ordinary iron. It was forged after he and the swordsman, in their drunken state, accidentally entered the Heavenly River, using moonlight as a furnace and stars as charcoal, quenching nine-day mysterious iron with Jade Pool nectar, and it took three thousand years to complete. On the day the sword was completed, red clouds descended from the sky and ten thousand swords sang in unison; it is truly the first sword of the ages.

The heavy crossbow used by the Jiang County heiress during the Battle of the Three Kingdoms. The angry flames that streaked across the night sky burned the thousands of ships spanning the river into ashes.

When its arrow left the string, there was no sound of wind breaking, only a trail of burning sky piercing the firmament, turning everything it touched into ashes. It was not imitating a myth, but recreating that ultimate strike that caused the scorching sun to fall and changed the course of time.

The descendants of the fierce tiger acted as the vanguard in the war, breaking through camps and formations, invincible.

A longbow forged from ore that glimmers beneath the morning star. Its body is formed from pure light, as light as a feather. When the string is drawn, starlight falls to form the arrowhead, surrounded by flowing light that gathers into fletching. Upon release, the stars compete with the night, and the sky clears. Darkness retreats, and the realm of clarity descends.

Deep within the permafrost of the Far North lies a shard of ice that has never melted in ten thousand years. Embedded in its cross-section is an ancient seal—its patterns like frost-flower rifts, bone-chilling to the touch.

If one covers the seal with their palm, the frost lines will trace along their veins and transform into a long staff, forever sharing the warmth of the palm. Each time one draws upon the Ice Crystal to charge, the seal lights up one by one, and the shattered crystals condense into a semi-transparent frost shield that encircles the body, while the chill is hidden deep within the seal, layered onto the next strike.

That seal came from the icy cold of the Far North; it does not forget the past, and it remembers every shattering and reunion of the ice crystals and frozen earth.

Secret Anecdote I
Master Alata was physically weak in his youth but quite competitive. Whether practicing swordplay, memorizing books, jumping over walls, or breaking stones, he would always challenge others.
The Master would guide him patiently: "If the sword's edge is pointed only for the sake of personal victory, its reach is limited. In this vast world, the responsibility of the strong lies in supporting rather than suppressing, and in protecting rather than seizing."

Secret Anecdote II
Master Alata focused heavily on practical combat in his youth, often sneaking into the mountains to fight monsters, standing his ground even when surrounded by enemies.
Thus, the Master planted maple trees by the river behind Jixia. Whenever Alata was injured, he would consume the fruit from the trees, and the healing effect was immediate.
Alata studied under the Master for many years, and the two often talked under the maple trees. Over time, the trees became imbued with spiritual energy.
After the Great War, Alata was injured and in seclusion, unable to leave the Mount Guye area. The Master noticed this and transplanted the maple trees to Mount Guye.
At first, the maple trees became ill due to the unfamiliar soil and water, but they recovered thanks to Alata's care.
Sometimes Alata would walk over to sit under the sick trees, saying open-mindedly, "A sick tree for a sick bird, how fitting." After saying this, he would drink a few cups of 'Heaven and Earth Brew' and find much comfort.

Secret Anecdote III
Master Alata enjoys fine wine and is quite knowledgeable about cuisine. He once compiled the 'Jixia Martial Arts Diet,' which requires martial artists to strictly follow the recipes to strengthen their bodies.

A final letter written in blood. The affair began at the Cloud-Casting Hut, and the vengeance ended there. The swordsman's life fell like the rain on Mount Guye, unable to wash away the soil stained red by "vengeance."

<span size="26">Overview</>
Guan Dan is a four-player game played in pairs. You and your partner form one team, while the players to your left and right form the opposing team.

<span size="26">Turn Order</>
In the first round, the system randomly selects a player to lead. In subsequent rounds, the lead is granted to the player who finished first in the previous round.
Players take turns in a counter-clockwise direction. When following a lead, a player must play a higher-ranking hand of the same type or a higher-ranking bomb for Suppression.
If no one follows, the last player to play becomes the leader for the next round and may play any hand type to start a new round.

<span size="26">Passing the Lead</>
If a player plays their final card and no other player follows, the lead passes to their partner.

<span size="26">Deck Composition</>
The game uses two decks for a total of 108 cards, with each player receiving 27 cards at the start.
Cards matching the current round's "Level" are known as <FFE398>Level Cards</>. Level cards are higher than all other cards except for the Jokers.

<span size="26">Card Ranking</>
Big Joker → Small Joker → Level Card → A → K → Q → J → 10 → 9 → 8 → 7 → 6 → 5 → 4 → 3 → 2
The Heart-suit Level Card is the <FFE398>Wild Card</>, which can substitute for any card except Jokers to form a hand.

<span size="26">Leveling and Winning</>
Both teams start at the same level. In team play, the starting level defaults to 2; otherwise, it is determined randomly.
After a round, rankings are determined by the order in which players empty their hands: First, Second, Third, and Last. The team with the First-place player wins the round. The level increase is determined by the partner's rank, and the new level applies to the next round.
• First + Second: Level up 3
• First + Third: Level up 2
• First + Last: Level up 1

<span size="26">Must-Play A </>
If the winning team's current level is below A, and the increase would exceed A, the level will instead cap at A. If the team successfully levels up from A, they win the match, and both teams' levels reset to 2 for the next match.

<span size="26">Three Strikes at 2</>
If a team reaches Level A but fails to pass it for three consecutive rounds, their level drops back to 2 to restart.

  After completing all quests in the highest stage of your current major rank and claiming the rewards, the Breakthrough Quest will unlock. Complete this quest to promote your major rank and unlock new gameplay and progression experiences.

<span color="#ffe398">Rating Rules</>
  Progression ratings are divided into four levels: B, A, S, and SS. Rating standards are linked to the Wave Flow Realm; as your Wave Flow Realm increases, the requirements to achieve an SS rating will also increase.
  Meet the specified conditions for each progression type to earn an SS rating. The system will synthesize the completion status of all current progressions to determine the overall Resonance/Flow rating.

<span color="#ffe398">Gameplay Introduction</>
     Divine Machine Deduction has multiple difficulties. Each difficulty requires clearing the previous one and reaching the required Wave Flow Realm to unlock.
<span color="#ffe398">Basic Rules</>
     Players can advance with their Siege Minions to push enemy Defense towers. Destroy all Defense towers and the Enemy Crystal to win.
<span color="#ffe398">Gold Usage Rules</>
     In this mode, all team members receive an equal amount of gold after defeating enemies. When you have enough gold, click the purchase button on the left to spend it and select one ability from several random options as a reward.
<span color="#ffe398">Spirit Beast Rules</>
     In the Divine Machine Deduction arena, a Crimson Feral and an Azure Feral will spawn on the left and right platforms respectively.
     After defeating the corresponding Spirit Beast, the entire team gains Red or Blue Buffs, as well as a large amount of gold.
     Red Buff effect: Restores a certain amount of Health per second
     Blue Buff effect: Periodically charges your Ultimate
<span color="#ffe398">Reward Rules</>
     First-clear rewards are issued for each difficulty upon completion. First-clear rewards do not reset and can only be obtained once.

<span color="#ffe398">Journey Introduction</>
Increase your Level to advance your journey and gradually unlock new features and gameplay.
Upon reaching the specified level, you can claim corresponding rewards on the Journey screen. Each reward tier can only be claimed once.

<span color="#ffe398">Reward Content</>
  Complete Season Quests to earn Season Points, increase your Season Star Level, and unlock corresponding rewards; complete Peak Chapter Quests to earn Peak Points, increase your Peak Star Level, and unlock corresponding Peak rewards.
<span color="#ffe398">Recommended Experience</>
  Some new season-related quests provide higher Season Point rewards; prioritize these to quickly increase your Season Star Level.
<span color="#ffe398">Star Level Increase</>
  Accumulate Season Points to increase your Season Star Level. Each time you reach the required points, you gain 1 star(s). The maximum Season Star Level is 30 stars; upon reaching 30 stars, the Peak Chapters unlock, with a maximum Peak Star Level of 3 stars.
<span color="#ffe398">Chapter Unlocks</>
  The first five chapters will gradually open as the season progresses. Once the chapter opening time is reached and the unlock point requirement for the previous chapter is met, the next chapter will unlock.
<span color="#ffe398">Chapter Goals</>
  The first five chapters each have a target point goal. Reaching the target points completes the chapter; points exceeding the target do not count toward chapter progress or total season points, and remaining quests in the chapter become invalid.

<span color="#ffe398">Rank Display</>
  Complete quests in the Path of the King: Season to simultaneously increase your Season and current page rank.
<span color="#ffe398">Achievement Ranking</>
  Achievement ranking is the same as in the Achievement System.
<span color="#ffe398">Total Platinum Crystals</>
  Records the total number of Platinum Crystals your current account has obtained through any non-top-up methods.
<span color="#ffe398">Total Duration</>
  For every calendar day you log in, the total duration count increases by one.

<span color="#ffe398">Reward Content</>
  Grants a large amount of Origin Flow EXP for rapid leveling. 
<span color="#ffe398">Quest Categories</>
  Divided into limited and infinite cycle types; cycle quests can be completed infinitely. 
<span color="#ffe398">Refresh Rules</>
  Content and rewards refresh daily. 
<span color="#ffe398">Recommended Experience</>
  Some high-efficiency quests offer higher rewards to help reach daily goals quickly. Keep completing daily quests to open equipment chests. 
<span color="#ffe398">Bonus Rewards</>
  Each reward tier will be increased by a certain multiplier based on your activity from the previous two days. If yesterday's activity was insufficient to claim a reward tier, today's reward for that tier will receive an additional bonus of 100%. If activity from both yesterday and the day before was insufficient, today's reward will receive an additional bonus of 200%. If activity was insufficient for more than two days, the maximum additional bonus is 200%. 
<span color="#ffe398">Weekly Activity Chest</>
  Claiming the weekly chest requires accumulating enough activity. Once enough activity is accumulated, you can claim the rewards from the weekly chest the following week.

Organizations are a general term for multi-player groups, including two types: <Blue_Basic>Warbands</> and <Blue_Basic>Societies</>.

Organization Recruitment
After an organization is created, it must <Gold_Basic>recruit 5 members</> within the 48-hour response period, otherwise the <Gold_Basic>response will fail</> and the creation funds will be refunded.

Organization Management and Dissolution
If the highest-ranking manager of an organization does not log in within <Gold_Basic>30 days</>, management authority will be <Gold_Basic>transferred</> to other active members. If the organization's <Gold_Basic>Prosperity falls below the requirement</> or only the highest-ranking manager remains with 1 member and <Gold_Basic>deletes their account</>, the organization will be <Red_Basic>dissolved</>. Dissolving an organization does not refund the creation funds.

Warbands and Societies
Warbands are close-knit group organizations; each player can join only one Warband. Warbands have exclusive <Blue_Basic>Warband bases, warehouses, and Warband missions</>. Participating in missions accumulates experience and activity for the Warband, as well as contribution points for the player to earn rewards.
Societies are interest-based group organizations; players can join multiple Societies. Players participate in missions to accumulate experience and activity for the Society and earn Society activity rewards. There is a weekly limit for claiming activity rewards in a Society.

S2 Season Society Popularity and Experience Inheritance
After the S2 season update, the historical maximum popularity of a Society will be converted into the Society's experience points at a ratio of 1:1, and the Society level and upgrade rewards will be settled accordingly. Thereafter, organization popularity will be adjusted to <Gold_Basic>reset weekly</>.

Prosperity is a weekly assessment of the proportion of active members in the organization. It is determined by the ratio of the organization's total activity to its maximum capacity during the weekly settlement period, categorized into Low, Prosperous, and Flourishing.
Organizations with a Low prosperity rating for <Gold_LightBG>3 consecutive weeks</> will be <Red_LightBG>disbanded</>. Once disbanded, original items and rewards within the organization will no longer be accessible.

A moving radish... sounds pretty cute. When it hides in the soil, that must be its own little world, where it can't be seen or disturbed.

The Red Flame Cat, named for its reddish-yellow fur, looks like a flickering flame in the grass from a distance.
It is extremely curious about everything, small in size but bold in spirit. Even against creatures several times its size, it can hold its own with its agile and nimble movements.
It likes to rub its head against passersby's pant legs, and the cat hair it leaves behind is a badge of honor. Students are often late for class because they are busy playing with the little cat.

A Radish affected by cloud currents. It usually absorbs nutrients underground, with only its green leaves visible. When it senses danger, the Stealth Radish will burst from the soil and initiate an Attack.

Although the Jixia Canteen promotes its nutritional value, students aren't buying it. "This thing tastes terrible." Of course, the deeper reason is likely the rumor that these radishes still move when you put them in the pot.

The fluff on the back of the Gilded-Pattern Fox's neck shows flower-like patterns.
These patterns are mysterious and elegant, regarded as a symbol of nobility, which is why the Gilded-Pattern Fox is highly esteemed by many noble families.

Its cry is melodious and moving; some call it the "Thousand-Turn Cry of the Gilded Fox." Legend has it that it only cries nine times in its life, for unknown reasons.
To capture their voices, countless members of the Gongyu family wait day and night.
Such beautiful colors, soft fur, and a sweet song... It's a bit worrying. Beautiful things always attract the wrong kind of attention. Only in Jixia can these little cuties run free.
Flame-like colors, quite dazzling from afar. This guy, ahem, is just too clingy... always rubbing its fur all over me! Hey, who said I'm shy!

Ascend the tower of glory in Dainty Vale for a panoramic view of the entire valley.

The clear stream flowing along the town is the perfect place for a leisurely fish. The shimmering waves reflect the cold gleam of a hero's blade, and the babbling water echoes the rhythm of a martial artist's breathing; fishing here is a form of cultivation.

Mountain waterfalls cascade over the rocks, converging into a clear, shallow lake between the high clouds and cliffs. The wind rolls up fallen leaves, startling fish into leaping; the splashing silver arcs are like the sudden retraction of a blade on the sword-testing platform.
Sit together on the bench at Maple Ridge and enjoy the green mountains and red maples!

Cloudstep Cliff, where rosy mists drift. Kites perch and drag their feathers across the clouds. A lone swan leaves its shadow, its mournful cry circling. The withered spring is not yet dead, the old maple is not yet aged. When I left, I soared to the nine heavens. Now that I return, I miss you from afar.

A mountain flatland overgrown with reeds. Records state that the Casting Cloud Hut originated here before moving to Wulian Town for various reasons.
The location of the former mountain furnace of the Cloud-Casting Lodge, now only the Earth Fire Burning Ridge remains, smoldering amidst the surrounding greenery.
Cloud ships frequently travel between the Mount Guye Aership Station and the academy. Those seeking to improve their martial arts often arrive by ship, which is why many merchants gather here.
The essential path from the Jixia Mountains to the peaks of Mount Guye. As you climb from here, the clouds thicken and mountain mist begins to appear.
A massive bronze ship lies deep underground, vast as a mountain range. Its layered decks are covered in moss, yet its Mechcraft still functions as it once did.
A large-scale trial ground established by the Academy in the Iridescent Basin, serving as both the arena for the Void Dream Trial and the location of the Linglong Tower trials.
The arena of the Void Dream Performance, the Dainty Vale for student trials, and the world of wind and clouds where heroes chase their dreams.

To the north of Jixia lie lush mountains. Named Mount Guye, the clouds and mountain mist never disperse throughout the year. The vigorous cloud shadows stretch across the peaks, while the flowing clouds below blend into the mundane world.
Winding paths of pine and bamboo on Mount Guye; a martial artist walks alone in the wind, whether for fame or for righteousness.
Hidden within the bamboo sea, the Tianguang Workshop has built a strange market where one should not ask the origin of people or goods.
The high-altitude regions of Mount Guye are rarely visited; clouds gather at the summit, never dispersing throughout the year.
A cliff spectacle formed by massive cloud-accumulating stones. The final duel of the Martial Arts Tournament is held here; only the absolute best can ascend to the stage.
When the sunset hits the deep mountains, the mountain mist is gilded. Scholars call it desolate, while warriors praise its grandeur.
Littoral Towership Entrance. Looking out from afar, the magnificent towership is a major overlook.
A gathering place for merchants in the Prisma Pavilion, used for pre-match supply replenishment.

The reclusive sword sect, is it that? The source of the chaotic cloud weapons, is it that? The hero who reclaimed the divine sword, is it that? The trapped beast locked in the Lightless Cave, is it that? [br] [br] (Hint: <Blue_Basic>Take the elevator down</> to find White Ape Elder)
A massive shadow wandering in the west of the Serene Wilds, crushing everything in its path with overwhelming force. Few can escape from its presence unscathed.
The fearsome, slender Dreamslayer lurks in the shadows and dreams, ready to strike.[br][br](A Hunter's Tip: Explore Dreamy Grotto: Carefree Dreams.)
A giant lizard that manipulates Lightning, a mortal enemy of the Wreckflame Lizard. It is massive, faintly glowing, and often hides within lightning.
The unknown beast roars coming from the cliffs add a sense of mystery and terror to this long-forgotten ancient city.

To be a dashing hero like a friend was the first thing it remembered after gaining sentience. To keep that promise and guard the hero's sword was the last thing it remembered before losing its mind. The sunlight and starlight of a century in Jixia cannot reach the cave where the White Ape Elder wanders; yet, the Sword Space of the Divine Sword Sky holds the shattered past of A-Yu. In this mode, the combat rules are identical to Solo Duel, allowing players to utilize their mastered skills for combat.

In this mode, the victory conditions for Attack and Defense differ. The Attack side must escort the Station Ruins Sentry to the final checkpoint to win, while the Defense side must prevent the Station Ruins Sentry from reaching the final checkpoint before the timer runs out.
In this mode, the Station Ruins Sentry is the key to victory. The Station Ruins Sentry will advance when controlled by the Attack side and retreat when controlled by the Defense side.

The Three-Hero Duel is a 3 vs 3 gauntlet mode. Each team has 3 players who take turns dueling the opponent. The loser is out, and the winner continues to fight. The first team to defeat all 3 members of the opposing team wins!
In Solo Duel mode, the player's dodge count is reduced and stamina recovery speed is lowered. Undercurrent Excitation growth effects do not take effect.

Ruins Pursuit is a 4 vs 4 multiplayer mode. Select a Resonance to enter, work with your teammates to escort the Station Ruins Sentry to the destination or prevent the enemy from doing so to claim victory.

Checkpoints are key nodes on the patrol route of a Station Ruins Sentry. When a Station Ruins Sentry advances to a new checkpoint, it will stop for a short rest, and it will not cross the previous checkpoint when retreating.

The Surreal Dream Fiend is the embodiment of darkness in the dream. Now, its ambition has expanded, twisting everyone's dreams into a disaster.

[Three-Phase Illusion]: The Surreal Dream Fiend cycles between wolf, bear, and human forms, each with unique combat tactics.

[Nightmare Seizure]: When in bear or human form, it summons Nightmare Butterflies to snatch a player and fly toward a Nightmare Rift. Teammates must shoot down the butterflies in time, or a devastating explosion will be triggered upon falling into the rift.
Shipboard Crisis · Littoral Spirit Drive | Enhanced Strategy

Dreamslayer Overlord is a cold hunter who has fallen into the dream. He comes wrapped in darkness, vowing to drag this dream into total destruction.

[Deepest Nightmare]: Dreamslayer Overlord summons a deep darkness that devours everything. The bright area around the Nightmare Light Platform can provide Aegis to protect players from the continuous erosion of the darkness. Only by finding the two Nightmare Feather Guards that appear in the darkness, defeating them to seize the Nightmare Light, and successfully escorting it to the Nightmare Light Platform to light it up, can the darkness be dispelled and force him to appear.

The most unpredictable bounty hunter of the Bazaar's Sky-Light Workshop has finally shed his disguise to reveal his fangs, vowing to plunder the newly awakened Littoral Spirit Drive.

[Earth-Shattering Rock]: Black Claw uses his arm guards to gather rocks and hurl them into the arena. The rocks cause large-scale explosions upon landing. Players can guide the location of the falling rocks to leave a safe zone. The debris scattered after the explosion can be picked up by players.

[Rock-Gathering Armor Break]: Black Claw leaps into mid-air, his arm guards at full power, creating a strong suction force that pulls players toward him. Players must throw the debris at the weak points on his arm guards to interrupt his attack.

This ancient spirit tree, having lived for eight thousand years, has roots that spread to the shores of Tunyun Lake. It usually stretches its half-withered, half-flourishing branches, but once an intruder steps into its territory, it will raise its sturdy vines to launch a rain-like pursuit. 【Moonelia Exhale】: The Moonelia Sprout summons multiple vines; breaking them grants spherical shields of different colors. The flower bud then exhales multi-colored bubbles that fall slowly. If they hit the ground or a player, they create a toxic miasma zone. Only players with a matching shield color can safely pop the bubbles and restore a small amount of vitality. 【Weakness Strike】: Players must cooperate to eliminate the bubbles while fully focusing on destroying the weak vines on the field. If all vines are not cleared within the allotted time, the Moonelia Sprout will launch a screen-clearing destructive attack; otherwise, it will collapse into a faint due to power depletion.

This bronze giant structure, the Littoral Spirit Drive, maintains the towership's operation day and night. It carries the long-cherished wish of sending the tribe to the other side of the ocean, yet it has foreseen its own fate of eventually running aground.

[Turbine Resilient Charge]: The Littoral Spirit Drive ascends into mid-air, its turbine engines whipping up a Starlight Slice that tears through space, releasing four Lasers—up, down, left, and right—to connect to the scene's hub and invert the entire arena.

[Furnace Heaven's Punishment]: The engine furnace above the players' heads rains down fire, followed by multiple lava pillars that create scorching areas on the ground. At the same time, all members will be marked with a Laser warning; you must keep moving and avoid each other. Additionally, players can strategically use Lasers to shoot down burning floor tiles to avoid creating scorching areas.

Swordheart Echo: Chun's inner divine power surges out of control. A century of suppressed sorrow and rage transforms into a torrential downpour of swords, dragging the challenger into a death match.

[Draw Sword to Break Barrier] After the targeted charge, a sword array descends. The locked target must guide one to break the shield, while dodging the remaining swords; succeed four times to stun the boss, otherwise, the entire field is overwhelmed.

[Spring Umbrella Shelters from Rain] Strike the four umbrellas to open them; umbrellas not opened within the time limit will be absorbed to buff the boss. During the downpour, you must hide under an opened umbrella.
