The Littoral Spirit Drive turns the towership's final will into a suffocating, desperate blockade. Lightning weaves into a cage, and giant chests fall like a collapsing mountain.

[Cross-Light Prison]: The Littoral Spirit Drive's Laser Attack summons four light walls that separate players into different areas, severely limiting movement and regrouping.

[Sea-Covering Abyss]: The frequency of lava pillars and Lasers will increase once more, eventually generating giant chests that fall from the sky. You must move precisely to find a sliver of hope.

Embermane no longer underestimates its opponent and will unleash its true royal flames. The power of the sea of fire is enough to incinerate everything, compressing the prey's living space to the limit.

[Burning Purgatory]: The Damage of ground fire is significantly increased; even brief contact can be fatal.

[Desperate Pillar Dance]: The stone pillars rising on the field collapse faster, and the team must make the most precise movement decisions within an extremely tight timeframe.

Swordheart Echo: Qiu ascends to gather strength, using bloodline power to summon four blood-shadow clones. Connected by blood lines, they share life and breath, setting up a heart-slaying array.

[Blood Shadow Chain] The four blood shadows are connected and cannot be attacked; you must guard each side to pull them apart. The targeted player must lure the charge to break the lines and defeat the shadows one by one.

The erosion of the ancient texts is deep-rooted. While its power to manipulate text has not gained new lethal moves, it has become more refined and deadly.

[Eroded Scroll as Before]: The overall mechanics remain consistent with the normal challenge, with no additional changes, but the closing of the pages is more ruthless and allows for no delay.

Echo of the Sword Heart: Winter drags the battlefield into a long night of total silence. Only by igniting the spark of life in absolute death can one tear through this endless winter.

[Cycle of Seasons] The Ruins hang in the air, and three seasonal beacons appear; split into three teams to reach the beacons and interact to activate them. When all three pillars light up, color is restored.

[Passing the Torch] Darkness consumes the field and summons monsters; relight the three beacons to summon the fire of Health. Everyone must take turns sacrificing themselves to keep it burning, while others collect sparks to charge it. A fully lit field is the key to victory.

Pride of the Sword Heart flaps its wings to summon the wind, sealing the battlefield in a storm cage and crushing all challengers with ruthless hurricanes.

[Wind-Rending Charge] Those targeted should move away from the group to dodge the rectangular charge; shatter the Wind Eye Stone to generate a barrier and hide inside before the full-screen slash.

The Spirit-Drive's Mechcraft core is overloading, the onslaught of lava and lasers is multiplying, and the pressure from the giant bronze casket above makes the footing precarious.

[Lava Frenzy]: The frequency of falling lava pillars has increased significantly, causing more dense damage to the arena.

[Falling Giant Casket]: After the lava pillars end, a giant bronze casket will spawn above players, falling after a warning to deal Damage and cause the floor to collapse. Players must dodge, or they will easily fall into the abyss.

The whispers of the Zero Space have completely devoured all reason. Both the world within the book and the battlefield outside have fallen into chaos. The only way to counter the calamity within the book is to use the items found inside.

【Fragment Erosion Zone】: The glowing tomes on the field have become tougher and will intermittently release spreading fragments that cover the area, severely hindering movement and energy collection.

【Break and Throw】: Interactive tomes will appear at the start of the book world. The trapped must take them out and throw them at the Tome Binder, who has taken the form of a book, to break their stance and stun them, opening a path to survival both inside and outside the book world.

Black Claw pushes its traps to the limit, extending the threat of falling rocks indefinitely. Any negligence could lead to destruction.

[Ember Spread]: After the falling rocks explode, they leave behind burning ember zones that persist for a significantly longer time, putting the team's positioning to the test.

Swordheart Echo: Xia ascends, the power of the gods surging like uncontrollable summer thunder. With a giant thunder-blade, she carves a Judgment Array, forcing the challenger to complete a life-or-death formation before the thunder penalty descends.

[Thunder Array] The central giant blade releases thunder shockwaves; shatter falling blades to obtain array flags, and fill all eight array eyes to activate a protective shield against the falling thunder penalty.

This entity, mutated from a senior archivist of the Forbidden Chamber, has fused its body with ancient texts and suffered unspeakable corruption from opening a nameless tome from the Zero Space. 【Book-Bound Heart】: It traps a challenger within the pages, placing them in a constantly collapsing world of books. The trapped must use their agility to reach the portal before the pressure closes in. 【Literary Life-Extension】: Glowing classics appear on the battlefield. Other members must shatter them to obtain energy and feed it into the closing portal to delay its shutdown. If the portal seals completely, the trapped will be lost in the sea of ink forever.

The game's punishment has reached its limit. The Mahjong array and the crushing walls weave a death trap; any mistake will result in immediate erasure.

[Bone Tile Fall]: Before each Mahjong array move, a large area of Mahjong tiles will rain down from the sky. Players must position themselves in advance to dodge, and quickly adjust their position to slip into the gaps of the array after the barrage.

[Desperate Charge]: During the wall crush, the Firebringer will also launch frontal and rear charge attacks, significantly disrupting positioning; the shield-breaking threshold is increased. If not broken, the crush will instantly kill everyone.

The gambling tools engraved by Du Zhuan Yaoque are lifelike, with a four-core drive spitting out punitive hellfire, trapping intruders in a fiery chess game.

[Tile Mountain Siege]: Firebringer leaps off the field, and a large number of 'One-Tong' bullets are fired from all directions like shuffling cards, followed by four crumbling mahjong walls that slam down, building a mountain of tiles that blocks the path.

[Array Terror]: A full row of mahjong tiles descends continuously from a single direction, pushing forward after a delay, leaving only a single gap for one to pass through. Players must observe and dash into the gap several times to dodge.

[Shield Break & Wall Smash]: After the mechanism ends, Firebringer appears in the center of the field to charge up and cover itself with a Shield, while the two opposite walls slowly crush toward the center. You must perform Shield Reduction to shatter it before being crushed for the walls to dissipate, causing Firebringer to faint; if you fail to break the Shield in time, all members will suffer devastating crushing Damage.

[Cicada Song Shadow Bind] Deals continuous Damage and slows; shadows imprison teammates, be sure to shatter the sword shadows to save them before the full-screen slash.

If we don't finish our cups tonight, who else shall we invite to share the joy? See how one can enjoy themselves to the fullest here on Mount Guye.

Temperature: In this mode, the skills and environment of the Crimson Beast and Azure Beast will affect the player's temperature. If your temperature becomes imbalanced, you will be penalized by the corresponding temperature mechanic.
High Temperature: You will be knocked airborne by explosions and take massive damage, with reduced healing effects for a period of time.
Low Temperature: Your Stamina will be drained and you will take massive damage, with reduced Stamina recovery speed for a period of time.
Cooling or Heating: Players can regulate their temperature by destroying Ice Crystal pillars or Lava pillars. After destroying a pillar, players within the range will continuously cool down or heat up.

To guard the sword is not unjust, yet to guard the sword is not easy; one thought of a hero, one thought of an ape. For a hundred years, the "Sword Sect" was nothing more than an ape waiting for a friend to return. Its obsession turned into the Chaotic Cloud Flow, exploited by the Sky-Light Workshop... By investigating the various ruins left behind in Springbrook Plains, I found five bronze fragments and gradually learned the truth about the war in Springbrook Plains.

Arrived near the Emerald Meadows. The Skyrumble Falcon flapped its wings, bringing thunder and lightning, but fortunately, my power was superior.

Perhaps only by investigating the various ruins across Springbrook Plains can the truth be uncovered...

The runestone fragments were actually tokens of the Butterfly Envoy. Collect all the fragments to reassemble the runestone and restore the balance of Dream Energy. The <69D0FF>stone tablet</> provided by Qingze marks Dreamplunge Island in Dreamwhisper Lake; you can find more guidance beneath the Great Dream Totem to its northwest.

Qing Ze held up the fragment, and spoke of an old story. 

During the battle between the Dream Envoys and the Dreamslayer, the Nightmare Envoy disappeared and the Dream Runestone had shattered by accident, blurring the boundary between dream and reality. The Finedream Envoy struggled to hold the line at Dreamwhisper Lake alone. 

To put an end to Aerux Town's suffering, the lost fragments must be gathered at Dreamwhisper Lake and fully restored beneath the Dream Totem.
In an instant, a dream butterfly was released from the totem, fluttering upward and flying toward the site of the former ritual.
A feather slowly drifts down from the sky, its black and purple fibers intertwined. This feather of Botu fills me with an ominous premonition.

After collecting the three keys, you successfully entered the abandoned mine and defeated the deranged Master of Ingenuity in the deepest chamber. He carried a butterfly-wing-shaped rune fragment. Perhaps <69D0FF>Qingze</> on the second floor of the Aerux Inn will know what this is...

An unexpected guest appeared and tried to disrupt the ritual. After a Battle Frenzy, the Dreamslayer roared, circled overhead, then reluctantly retreated. As it left, a dark purple feather drifted down, carrying a sense of evil. The ritual was completed, but a quiet foreboding settled over you. You still haven't found the Finedream Envoy—Qing Ze says she should be here guarding the place and wouldn't be absent. That Dreamslayer Feather has given you troubling reasons to doubt what's really happening.

Captain Yang Ling of Team Dragonscale entrusted me with a mission to explore the trial site behind the three statues and retrieve the Bone Chime fragments. I overcame every challenge—hitting the targets in the bone-shattering formation, defeating the bronze Guards, and solving the dragon-tail altar puzzles—to collect the three fragments for Yang Ling. However, just as we thought we had succeeded, the sound of the chimes awakened the guardians of the Dragon's Graveyard, who launched an attack.

To protect the team, I fought the guards and emerged victorious. Yang Ling invited me to help open the heavy Mechcraft gate, and after navigating the underwater passage, we discovered the greatest secret of the Dragon's Graveyard: the dragon horn sealing ground.

Guided by the chime master Fu Cang, I awakened the lingering voice of the fallen dragon. It was mysterious and profound; though disturbed, it showed no displeasure, speaking instead of its longing for a dear friend and its care for humanity, before gifting me a precious dragon horn.
Faintly hearing the stirring of the dragon soul in the horn, who can blow it today?
The Return Journey Lantern shines, the dragon's roar rises again, and the Dragon Sentinel has finally let go of their obsession.

Zhirui mentioned that the Dragon Scale Squad, composed of naturalists, is preparing for archaeological exploration within <Jump>Area|81</>. Perhaps you can find related clues there.

<69D0FF>When the trial of the Void Dream is not active</>, the interior of the Dragon's Graveyard is open to the public. Head to the Dragon's Graveyard and speak with <69D0FF>Yangling</> of the Dragon Scale Squad; she will appreciate your help.

The Gongyu family lives up to its reputation; even ancient dragon horns are no match for them. After carving and polishing, the reed left behind by the Dragon Sentinel was embedded into the horn, becoming the legendary instrument—the Dragon Chant Horn.

Press your ear against the horn, and you can faintly hear the stirring of the dragon soul within, surging in your ears. When the horn sounds, the deafening dragon chant drifts across the wilderness, and the wind carries the chant into the past.

It is said that the dragon chant is the way the dragon race communicates, and legends say that warriors who allied with dragons in the past also used this sound to communicate with them. Today, I wonder who can blow it?

With the last Lamp of Return lit, the sky above Sunken Stele Pond darkened, and thunder rolled.

In the raging tempest, a towering figure began to take form... the Dragon Sentinel, guardian of this place. As lightning split the sky, he charged at me with a roar.

After a fierce battle, the Dragon Sentinel fell, but even in defeat, he held on, unswerving in his duty. "I shall not stop my vigil... I will hear again..." A delicate whistle piece fell from his grasp.

At Sunken Stele Pond, the Dragon Sentinel seemed to be waiting for something. When I challenged him again, he became distracted by the scent of the Dragonroar Horn. I handed it to him, and he blew it. The sound was earth-shaking, stirring deep memories.

Seeker Zhi Rui arrived, drawn by the sound, and together we witnessed the touching story of the Dragon Valley.

Years ago, during a fierce battle, the Dragonrider was gravely wounded, and the Dragon sacrificed itself to save him. Consumed by guilt and grief, the Sentinel remained in Dragon Valley, keeping vigil over the Dragon's remains for years.

As we lit the Lamp of Return and sounded the Dragonroar Horn, the Dragon Sentinel finally recalled their days fighting side by side and finally let go of his burden.
I awakened the lingering voice of the fallen dragon, and in its deep mystery, it gifted me a precious dragon horn.

The naturalist Zhirui is conducting research in Dragon Valley. Dragon remains, mysterious bronze Mechcraft, ancient lamps that won't light... What exactly happened before the dragon fell?

First, go to <Jump>Area|82</> to find Zhirui's <69D0FF>lost research log</>, and follow the clues to find the <69D0FF>five bronze wicks</>.
The collected wick of the Homecoming Lamp contains mysterious energy, the secrets of which remain unknown.
A Seeker in Dragon Valley is unraveling the secrets of dragons...
After being defeated, the Dragon Sentinel refuses to abandon its mission, standing its ground with a body that defies the ages.

As you walked through the quiet, ancient Sunken Stele Pond, the breeze by your ear carried a sad, old song—perhaps from a fallen dragon, perhaps just a wistful memory.

Nearby, you found Seeker Zhi Rui's research note, which lists places where dragon bones useful as lamp wicks can be found: Dragonheed Camp, the basement of the southwest ruins now held by Rebels, a pond to the east guarded by the Ruins Guards, a dense forest to the west, and remote southern ruins that require a special way to enter.

All these sites trace back to the same source—the great dragon buried in Dragon's Graveyard, whose lingering energy remains mysterious and continues to draw Seekers.

From Luban, I learned that the answer to the third riddle is his old laboratory from twelve years ago. I took the key he gave me and entered the Old Craftsman's Workshop alone. After dodging the security mechcraft, I discovered that Luban No. 5, who should have been left here, was nowhere to be found. Luban concluded that the person who restarted No. 5 was Yuan Rusong, and the key to the third riddle is in No. 5's hands. The top priority is to find No. 5. According to his memory, No. 5 used to like going to the <69D0FF> Iridescent Pond </>. No time to lose, let's set off.

After obtaining the second key, the Master's final riddle finally surfaced: I sleep in the wilderness, silent and still, nurturing the wonders of Mechcraft. I test choices, weigh gains and losses; I am a cage of taboos, and a crossroads to the truth.

Nurturing the wonders of Mechcraft... sounds like it has to do with "mechanisms." Since it involves Mechcraft, I might as well ask <69D0FF> Luban </> for advice.

Luban was just repairing the Exquisite Tower at the Path of Ingenious Talent: End. If I go now, I should be able to catch him.

The answer to the second riddle is none other than that tournament goose that often wanders around Honor Tower. I passed its strange and abstract test and thought I would pass the trial, but... this goose actually lost the key!

According to the clues, the key was taken by three rogue students wandering in Dainty Vale—

<69D0FF> Sichu </>: Often wanders near the <69D0FF> Beast Garden </> on the east side of the valley, occupying the Beast Garden that originally belonged to the academy.
<69D0FF> Youjie </>: Hiding in the <69D0FF> Peril Camp </> in the northwest mountains, a domineering fellow.
<69D0FF> Weichan </>: Hiding in the <69D0FF> Buried Might </> in the south, seemingly studying Mechcraft there.

In short, I have to find the key first, then take it back to <69D0FF> show that goose </>.
Beneath the deep pool in the Iridescent Basin, something from the past seems hidden.

The flyer also contains another riddle: I roam the arena, wings fluttering, gathering the tides of glory. I possess the Insight to observe the whole, reflecting gains and losses; I am the witness of the game and the beacon of the Legacy of wisdom.

There is a tiny note next to the word "wings" in the riddle, claiming it is a typo. But... is it possible that it wasn't a careless mistake, but the key to solving the riddle?

Perhaps... the answer refers to a <69D0FF>"rare beast"</> with <69D0FF>wings</> that appears on the <69D0FF>Honor Tower</>. I should go there and investigate.

I ran into a strange man named Yuan Rusong who claimed to be a member of the 'Secret Society'. He shoved a weird flyer into my hand, claiming that the Master left three unsolved riddles in the Iridescent Basin, and that whoever solves them will receive the 'Master's Gift'...
I didn't expect the third riddle to involve Luban No. 5...
Finally found a clue at the Event Goose...

Luban left with No. 5 first. When I came to my senses, I realized Yuan Rusong had appeared here at some point.

This seemingly casual "Secret Society member" is not simple. From that first flyer, his shadow has been behind all these arrangements. I just didn't expect... he is actually the current head of the Dream-Acting Mobile Team!

Now, the three keys have been collected. They turned into flowing light, converging into a unique invitation, guiding me to the <69D0FF> Honor Tower </>. Can I... really "see" the Master there?
The top of the Honor Tower is empty, with only the sound of the wind passing by...
Guided by the riddles, I challenged the Exquisite Tower...

The first riddle comes into view: I stand in the canyon, silent and wordless, echoing with the shouts of heroes. I hone courage, temper the will; I am a wall of watch, and a ladder to victory.

 "Wall of watch" points directly to the <69D0FF>six Linglong Towers</> standing in the canyon. Since that's the case, I might as well go and try to see what mysteries the legendary riddle holds.

I have completed the final purification of the end times, finished Li Bai's poems, and repelled the Thirteenth Young Master. Now, the <Blue_Basic>Complete Li Bai Poems</> and the <Blue_Basic>Divine Sword of the End</>, which record the truth of the hero's legend, must be brought back to the Casting Cloud Hut in Wulian Town and handed over to <Blue_Basic>Master Long Xi</>
<Blue_Basic>Head to the Reed Flower Fields in the northeast</> to find that <Blue_Basic>Glacial Behemoth</> and learn more.

"The little rabbit runs east, looking back to find no one returning home." Long Qi never returned to this home to visit his sister, who sleeps under the ice and snow. The time they spent apart was far greater than the time they spent together—a chasm called life and death. Even the most legendary Health of a swordsmith cannot compare to a cold, powerful weapon. But why was the divine sword polluted, and what price did the ancient Cloud-Casting Hut pay for purification? "Ten years of furnace fire drinking the edge, deep green blood and cool chivalry. The famous sword leaves the country with infinite hatred, snow covers the beautiful city weeping cold frost." The wind and snow have stopped; I must continue forward. The answer still lies within the other divine swords.

If everyone retreats, then the one holding the sword should not. In the Heart-Sword Space, I saw the young man's determination to be the Guardian of Mount Guye to the death. A century ago, Master Alata and the young man addressed each other as master and disciple; a century later, no one on Mount Guye mentions that she ever had a disciple. As the obsession within the frost dissipated, the young man walked away into the snowy night. A line of poetry by Li Bai appeared: Who would know that a man in the grass, has a Dragon Spring sword at his waist? I wish to take the sword at my waist, to slay the Loulan. <Blue_Basic>A cup of wine with a long sword, a man's heart in his palm.</> But what is the connection between the young man's vow to his master to protect Mount Guye and the loss of the divine sword? I fear only by finding the end of the world can we know.

The legend of the three divine swords of Mount Guye is shrouded in mystery. Ancient tales of these swords involve a name rumored to be a traitor of Mount Guye, a traitor long forgotten by time. Why were the divine swords lost, and where are they now?
<Blue_Basic>Head to the Cloud-Casting Hut in the nearby Wulian Town</> to find <Blue_Basic>Master Long Xi</> and learn more.

Many people are gathered near the notice board in Wulian Town. Two new notices have been posted: one is a <Blue_Basic>Bounty</> for the Zhuyunlu craftsman Nanhu Lai, and the other is a notice that the mountain <Blue_Basic>Douli Pavilion</> has been repaired. It is said that many people pursuing the bounty for Nanhu Lai are searching near <Jump>POI|2130210</>.

The three lost divine swords of Mount Guye are linked to the legend of a hero. The market broker Shisanhang gave you Li Bai's poems, claiming they hold the key to the location of the lost swords. To find them, you must follow the sword intent pointed out in the poems.
Go to the nearby <Blue_Basic>Zhuyun Pavilion in Wulian Town</> and find <Blue_Basic>Master Long Xi</> for more information.
Go to the <Blue_Basic>Zhuyun Ruins</> in <Blue_Basic>Dihua Valley</> to the northeast and find that <Blue_Basic>ice beast</> for more information.
Go to the <Blue_Basic>Void Market: Sword Casting Heart</> in the west and find a way to <Blue_Basic>enter the underground</> to find information related to <Blue_Basic>Li Bai's poems</>.

The moon sets in the west, the night ends, dawn breaks, and old grudges are cleared. The sword that Nan Hu Lai owed Lu Cang has finally been returned to Yao's hands. But when the sound of the bamboo flute rose again, he ran into the forest without hesitation, toward the bright moon in his heart that he had longed for. The three heroes of the past reunited at Lychee Tower, and a copy of "Longing" quietly appeared on the book stall outside.

I ran into the market broker Shisanlang. For some reason, he voluntarily gave me a scroll of Li Bai's poetry. When the scroll was unfurled, sword light burst forth and flew in four different directions: the Cloud-Casting Hut, the Market, the Reed Marshes, and one other place that was hard to identify. After the sword light vanished, lines of Li Bai's poetry slowly appeared on the scroll. The beginning of the scroll reads: <Blue_Basic> Who would know that a man among the weeds has a Longquan sword at his waist? </> This scroll seems to record the story of a hero, but who is this hero, and what is his connection to the three lost divine swords? It seems only by finding the three lost divine swords can the hero's story on the scroll be revealed.

I do not know my old name, I only wish to sever my life. Duan Pingsheng was once a craftsman at the Cloud-Forging Hut who studied under Nan Hulai, and it was her sense of loyalty that led to that past incident of "exterminating" the thieves. After speaking, she hands you a <Blue_Basic>broken bamboo flute</> with characters carved into it.

Snow falls silently on the mountain; if there is a fault, correct it. Shanshui Yidao thanks you for your righteous help. He climbed the pavilion because of his past with Nanhulai. Burdened by guilt, he drifted through the world and entrusted you with a <Blue_Basic> broken bamboo flute </> with characters carved on it.

Three broken flutes gather, the bright moon shines again.
Based on the blurred carvings on the broken flutes, you piece together a location name "<Jump> Area|188 </>". It is a valley bamboo forest in the Dihua Interstice area, which seems to be a perfect place for an ambush...
Find the whereabouts of the Three Divine Swords

A bounty notice, twenty years of lingering resentment. A bounty for <Blue_Basic>Nan Hulai</> is posted on the bulletin board at the town entrance, sparking heated discussion. Beside it, <Blue_Basic>a woman dressed in Zhuyunlu attire</> seems very anxious about it. It is said that many bounty hunters are searching near <Jump>POI|2130210</>.

Regardless, I am the only one who witnessed the truth. Although the divine sword has been purified, the mission and the price paid by the Zhuyun Pavilion over the centuries are unimaginable. I successfully persuaded the Master, and she decided to let everyone know that the former traitor, Cansheng, was a misunderstood hero. The entire Mount Guye was shaken by the truth, and perhaps in the near future, more heroes like Cansheng will emerge. The strife over the divine sword surrounding Li Bai's poems has also ceased.

The resonance triggered by the Cloud-Passing Ruler has opened the Atonement Rock at Sunset Hill, which seals the <Blue_Basic>Doomsday Evil Sword</>.
Only by unraveling the secret of the Atonement Rock can you find the Doomsday.
There is no time to lose; find a way to <Blue_Basic>unravel the secret of the Atonement Rock</>.
Go to the Frost-Sealed Forbidden Land with Long Xi

<Blue_Basic>The Corrupted Frost Sword Heart</> cannot elicit a response from the Cloud-Transmitting Ruler. Long Xi believes it is caused by the corruption and has decided to go to the Forbidden Frost Grounds to purify the frost and fulfill the century-old wish of the Cloud-Casting Hut. I need to go and help her.

Through a twist of fate, Master Longxi came to trust me and shared the story of how the three divine swords were lost twice. Centuries ago, the three swords were stolen by a traitor who defected to the Zhaoge army that was besieging the mountains, only to be recovered later by righteous heroes. Regrettably, when the ancestors of the Zhuyun Pavilion held a ritual to purify the corrupted swords, a disaster occurred. Since then, only the Frost sword remains in the Zhuyun Pavilion, and even it is unstable due to the loss of its sword heart. According to Longxi, the other two swords are also heavily corrupted by energy. If we keep an eye out for anomalies rumored around Mount Guye, we might find new clues.

A sword strike brings thunder, mad words rebuke the world. The mad swordsman went insane recalling his past with Nan Hu Lai. After calming down, he recounted a past event of "exterminating" thieves for the sake of justice, then leaped from the Douli Pavilion, leaving behind only a <Blue_Basic>broken bamboo flute</> with inscriptions.

As the doomsday was purified and I returned to the Po Jun form, the last line of the Li Bai poem in my hand gradually emerged. It read: Who would know the man in the grass, has a Dragon Spring sword at his waist? I wish to take the sword at my waist, to slay the Lou Lan. A long sword and a cup of wine, a man's true heart. <Blue_Basic>Even if I die, my heroic spirit remains, not ashamed to be a hero of the world.</> It turns out <Blue_Basic>Can Sheng</> had come years ago to fulfill his vow as a Guardian of Mount Guye, bringing the three divine swords to assassinate the Zhaoge generals besieging the mountain. Though he had a plan to perish together with the enemy, he did not expect the three divine swords to be tainted on the battlefield, which not only caused White Ape Elder great suffering but also brought a century of deadlock to Zhuyun Pavilion.

Witnessed by the Obsidian Flame Training Hall, the twin sword hearts caused the Cloud-Passing Ruler to emit a strange light, flying toward Sunset Hill. Legend has it that there is an ancient ruin on Sunset Hill called <Blue_Basic> Atonement Rock </>, said to be where a traitor who betrayed Mount Guye long ago went to repent. No one has ever seen that sinner. Since the Cloud-Passing Ruler points to Atonement Rock, it means the last lost divine sword—End of the World—is sealed there. Why is End of the World both a divine sword and rumored to be an evil one? I fear only by entering its Heart-Sword Space can the truth be revealed.

Recently, the weapons sold by the Sky-Light Workshop on Mount Guye resemble the legendary Firmament. Investigations by the Cloud-Casting Hut have revealed an unknown conspiracy in an <Blue_Basic> underground workshop </> near the <Blue_Basic> bamboo path outside the market </>. Perhaps there are clues to the <Blue_Basic> divine sword Firmament </> there.

This sword is named Skyvault. Today, its story has become a legend, scattered like dust and smoke in the Whispering Grove Underground. What I saw and heard in the market was not a hero's tale of vengeance, nor a story of a famous blade's brilliance, but merely a promise that a naive little monkey tried its best to keep. Following the path of Li Bai, I remembered it. Finally, the chaotic clouds of the Skyvault sword have completely dissipated. The White Ape Elder will not leave the Lightless Cave, because the person it is waiting for has not yet returned. Or perhaps, because the sword is still here... that person has been here all along?

Everlasting longing breaks the heart; the beauty is like a flower beyond the clouds. Above is the vast blue sky, below are the ripples of green water. The road is long and the soul flies in sorrow; dreams cannot reach the difficult mountain passes.

How is your heart? Standing alone at the Douli Pavilion. The mountain <Jump>POI|2130210</> has been restored; those with a sword heart in Bewilderment may ascend the pavilion for reflection. It is said that someone is already standing atop the Douli Pavilion, and you may follow local tradition to discuss your heart through martial arts. It is said that many who seek the bounty are searching near <Jump>POI|2130210</>.
Whether it's a battlefield or a shelter, everything becomes a relic in the blink of an eye.
I look up at the magnificent Central Pillar before me. Will the vanished heroes appear before my eyes again?

The once-majestic underground city now lies in ruins, its splendor long lost to ancient wars. Within the desolate hall, the remnants of gigantic beast claws suggest that Everspring managed to lure the monster in. It seems that reigniting the Illuminator is the key to unveiling the deeper secrets of the Underhall.

Find the <69D0FF>Volcanic Stone Key</> in the Shelter.
With a final cry of unwillingness and curses before death, the disaster beast was finally completely destroyed.
It took me a lot of trouble to get the Burning Mountain Keystone and open the Light-Riding Platform in the Stone Extraction Hall...

Everspring, whose consciousness was being gradually consumed by the Shadow Calamity Beast, fled to the most secret chamber of the Central Pillar in The Underhall to avoid becoming the beast's next host, vowing to seal it forever with his own body. He buried the chamber's Keystone and left a final message on the main pillar, strictly forbidding anyone from following him to open the chamber... Help the Academy advance team resolve the crisis, go to the <69D0FF> underground of the Central Pillar </> to obtain the <69D0FF> Keystone </>, and use it to enter the Central Pillar.

Climbing up, what meets my eyes are broken walls and ruins. On the collapsed stone statues are terrifying claw marks emitting strange energy fluctuations. Everspring and the Calamity Beasts have fought here many times, and Everspring's situation is precarious... I placed the Burning Mountain Keystone I found along the way into the Light-Driving Platform. A huge waterfall of light illuminated almost the entire Shelter, shooting straight toward the center of The Underhall. The past buried by time has finally been unveiled, but as for the full picture, I still need to activate the other two Light-Driving Platforms...

The Meeting Hall area can only be accessed from the surface entrance. You can find more clues in the Trial Ruins of the Aerfall Highlands... Head to the East Aerfall Highlands to find the entrance to the <69D0FF>Meeting Hall</> and activate the <69D0FF>Light-Driving Platform</> inside.

It is unimaginable that such a magnificent city was hidden beneath Jixia, with bronze structures built with superb craftsmanship as far as the eye can see... After shaking off the Mechcraft Guards, I found an ancient war order among the ruins. The handwriting has faded, but "War is imminent" and "Requisitioning this place as a Shelter" are still clear. This ruin was once a place of refuge. Walking deeper, I saw deep claw marks on the stone walls. A note picked up among the wooden frames recreated the panic of past treasure hunters. They didn't seem to find any treasure, but were instead terrified for their lives by the giant claw marks. Whether it was a battlefield or a shelter, in the blink of an eye, it has all become a thing of the past. The Burning Mountain Keystone in my hand has a primitive design; it might be the key to uncovering the secrets of this place.

As the light cascades from the three Light-Guiding Platforms converged, I finally reached the Central Pillar. There, I met the academy's elite investigation squad. Their leader, Gu Lai, was astonished that I had opened the path single-handedly. They had encountered many difficulties here and needed help... From the inscriptions here, I learned that Everspring had come here alone, recalled all requests for support, and warned others not to enter. Perhaps his goal was to seal the calamity beast with his own life, resting here forever, free from the flames of war... With the advance team's reminder, I solved the war-game puzzle in the underground chamber. Clutching the Keystone, I looked up at the magnificent Central Pillar. Will the vanished hero appear before my eyes again?

The Stone Extraction Hall is accessible only through a ground-level entrance. Visit the war-ravaged Springbrook Plains to find out how to enter the <69D0FF>Stone Extraction Hall</> and activate the <69D0FF>Illuminator</> at the top.

I finally saw Everspring. His physical body still exists, but his mind has been occupied by the Shadow Calamity Beast. He ranted arrogantly; although it was Everspring's face before me, I felt as if I were looking at the Calamity Beast of the past. I gripped my sword tightly, knowing this battle was inevitable, and perhaps there was no other choice. Everspring still retained a trace of his remaining consciousness, and taking advantage of the moment the beast was weakened by me, he begged me to defeat it... Accompanied by his dying resentment and curses, the Calamity Beast was finally completely destroyed. As he lay dying, Everspring thanked me while muttering about his old friends in the squad, about the flowers of Springbrook Plains, and about Fengluo, before passing away peacefully...

As for Everspring, whether she has been completely consumed by the Calamity Beast or still retains a shred of consciousness, the answer can only be revealed by entering the Central Pillar. I fear a fierce battle is inevitable... Enter the main pillar space and defeat Everspring.

The massive claw marks in the Meeting Hall reveal the ferocity of the battle. It wasn't just the armor that shattered, but Everspring's very soul. It seems his spirit was eroded by the Shadow Calamity Beast during their fight. Perhaps this is why he stayed underground and never returned. Everspring came here to seal the beast, only to end up sealed himself. But faced with the beast's bizarre powers, there seemed to be no better choice. It appears the struggle between Everspring and the beast is far from over...

<69D0FF>Once you find the Burning Mountain Keystone</>, you can use it to activate the Light-Riding Platforms within The Underhall. You must activate all three platforms to enter the Central Pillar. Activate the <69D0FF>Light-Riding Platform at the top of the Shelter</>.
The massive claw marks in the Meeting Hall reveal the ferocity of the battle.
Everspring has fought the disaster beast many times here, and Everspring's situation is precarious...

Following Everspring's tracks, I arrived at another area within The Underhall called the Stone Extraction Hall. It was filled with Mechcraft for mining firestones and the Automata operating them... The Calamity Beast was no match for human ingenuity after all; Everspring's plan was executed smoothly, and the beast was severely damaged by the Stone Extraction Hall's drills. However, Everspring had underestimated the beast's tenacious Health. Its counterattack left Everspring gravely wounded. The hero, having barely escaped, had to press on deeper into The Underhall... Guided by the Automata, I went through much trouble to obtain the Fire Mountain Keystone and activate the Light-Riding Platform in the Stone Extraction Hall...
Minka sent a message saying that you'll need to trouble yourself once more regarding the Iron Puncher...

You saved an injured Nianfang Beast and learned from a veterinarian named Kui that it may have been wounded by the widely rumored Water Monkey. Following the clues, you found the Water Monkey's habitat, met the naturalist Chen Cang, and learned that the so-called Water Monkey is actually a magical creature from Jixia called a Ritual Fish. While investigating why they were wandering there, you discovered a poaching camp disguised as a clinic. It turned out that Kui was the mastermind behind it all, using his title as a veterinarian to poach magical creatures. After defeating Kui, Chen Cang planned to organize ecological compensation and temporarily relocated the Ritual Fish to the Serene Wilds Pool...

After the Dream Performance finals, a message arrived from the Academic Affairs Committee inviting you to gather at an unfamiliar location. Although the reason wasn't stated, it's worth checking out... Hint: After meeting the conditions, go to [Interest Circle] - [Partners], read and reply to the message sent by [Academic Affairs Committee Group Chat] to unlock this quest.
In the remote mountains not far from the Bazaar, bounty hunters have blocked the mountain road, seemingly searching for something...

Mount Guye values martial arts, but why would someone hire people to beat them up?
You try to help and end up in trouble, being told you're interfering with their training. What kind of situation is that?
Forget it, the world is vast, and everyone has their own way of practicing. As an outsider on Mount Guye, all you can do is respect, understand, and wish them well...
Below the Cloudstep Arena, in the clear water pool, a swordsman is searching anxiously...

Mount Guye values martial arts, but why would someone hire people to beat them up?
You try to help and end up in trouble, being told you're interfering with their training. What kind of situation is that?
Forget it, the world is vast, and everyone has their own way of practicing. As an outsider on Mount Guye, all you can do is respect, understand, and wish them well...

In the abandoned martial arts hall of Zhuyunlu, you pursue a youth humming a blacksmith's ballad, seemingly excited for the upcoming Hundred Weapons Feast... But the ledgers have gathered dust for twenty years, and only faint ink remains on the dilapidated stone walls. When the truly lost girl trembles and says she "never saw anyone," you finally understand—the youth is merely a lingering spirit abandoned by the Golden Age...
From the craftsman, you learned that the monster wandering near Wulian Town was spotted in the valley to the northwest...
Seeing your words is like meeting you

Under the lone maple tree, in a secluded cabin, strange smoke drifts endlessly. You push the door open and see an emaciated old woman stubbornly brewing a "secret medicine."
She sold her belongings, exhausted her savings, and even used her own blood as an ingredient—what exactly is she trying to save? And what hidden past will that faded cloth strip marked "Life-Shortening" reveal?
Fiery red maples have drifted through centuries of spring and autumn; where will they fall now...

At the entrance to the Bazaar, you are stopped by bounty hunters. Just as you are distressed about not having a token to enter, a ragged little girl calls out to you. She offers to trade a token if you help her retrieve a candy basket stolen by 'bandits.' However, when you clash with the 'bandits,' you realize things are not as the girl described...
The stolen Iron Puncher, the distressed Minka, why is the little girl lying? And what does this have to do with the Sky-Light Workshop and Thirteen?

Cui Ran's passion was misled by Wu Jiu, who convinced him that the 'Fire Dragon Cannon' could protect the academy. However, as its creator, Xing Mang knows better than anyone the dangers it hides. Wu Jiu continues to incite Cui Ran, and behind his words, there seems to be an unknown secret... Time is running out. You have agreed to meet Xing Mang at the 'seaside' and must act quickly to prevent the tragedy from repeating...

Tie Chongzi's whereabouts are unknown. Minka sent word that she can no longer hide it from her master. You recall Tian Youyou saying that Tie Chongzi was taken to the Thirteenth Master, so you volunteer to go to Tian Guang Workshop to help Minka find him. You sneak in, but you never expected that inside the workshop, you would find not only Tie Chongzi, but also clues to the mysterious Thirteenth Master's origins... The maple leaves on Mount Guye cover the past, but they cannot cover a young girl's hatred of life and death.
Cui Ran's stubbornness and Wu Jiu's cunning are escalating the crisis. You and Xing Mang have agreed to meet at the 'seaside' to prevent the tragedy from repeating...

A misunderstanding led you to meet the martial artist Hu Wuhuo, who had just arrived at Mount Guye. To help him find traces left behind by his idol, you visited several seniors in Wulian Town, gradually piecing together the absurd experiences of "Fist-fighter Huzi" on Mount Guye. And when the echo of Huzi's "First Fist to Shock Guye" rang out across the cliffs once more, the martial artists, previously dejected by the cancellation of the Martial Arts Tournament, finally regained their spirits.
Why is someone fighting up ahead? That person is getting beaten up... Should we go help?

One day after the finals incident, you suddenly received a message from the Academic Affairs Committee summoning you to a remote location. Unexpectedly, you stumbled upon a dinner party the Master had prepared there in advance. Sitting alone at the table, past memories gradually surfaced...

Chen the accountant was marked for death for secretly canceling the usurious debts of the impoverished. You stepped in to help, saving his life with a spirit herb when he was critically wounded. It was only when he entrusted you with a maple leaf to take home that you realized—he was Granny Chen's son. A single act of kindness, echoing back in the most unexpected way.
Regrettably, when you revisited the place, the lone maple had withered, the cottage was empty, and only the red clouds in the sky remained. Just like a heart of kindness that never changes through the generations, reflecting upon the world.

The Bazaar's freight station is severely understaffed, so you helped the courier deliver three mysterious packages to different shops. Along the way, you saw the unique atmosphere of the Bazaar: a persistent puppeteer, a loving pair of fortune-telling master and apprentice, and some eccentric people obsessed with floral dreams. Finally, at a mysterious herb stall, you encountered Lychill, who had come to seek medicine and information. From her, you learned some news about a mysterious eccentric doctor—Dr Bian...
Best Sparring Partner: Reunion in the Reeds

The Bazaar is noisy, and a small, thin figure is surrounded by a crowd.
Meeting Tian Youyou again, this little girl has dragged you into trouble once more. After finally managing to get away, you intended to ask her what was going on, but in her home, you saw the 'secret' she had been hiding... And all of this actually originated from an 'accident' caused by Thirteen three years ago.
The Bazaar is treacherous and human hearts are unpredictable; don't let kindness lead you into trouble.
Maple Syrup Debt - Hoping Bitterness Turns Sweet
By the mountain road in Wulian Town, two elderly men are looking around, seemingly frightened by the hidden dangers ahead and afraid to continue. Will you go and help them?

The Academic Discipline Department denied your request to enter South Dragon Valley, pointing out that since the Gray Eagle Squad entered the south and were unfortunately killed, there has never been such a thing as a "pass." The Gray Eagle Squad? A pass? Killed? This is different from what that "reliable senior" said... If there's no hidden agenda, then things are looking bad.

To determine if the Cloud-Mist Weapon was forged by Minka herself, you follow a merchant to a remote spot in the woods and meet the legendary "Minka." This unscrupulous merchant, who uses a false pretense to swindle people, insists quite righteously that her materials were obtained from the backyard of Minka's workshop. Later, when Minka suddenly appears to confront her, it casts further doubt on the authenticity of the Cloud-Mist Weapon. Whether this object is real or fake, and who is telling the truth, is a matter of much debate among onlookers...

Dusk gathers, and the misty rain is vast. Amidst the desolate ruins of the Cloud-Casting Cottage, you encounter a severely wounded knight. Leaning against the broken walls, his robes soaked in blood, his gaze remains fixed on an ancient longsword. The cold wind can scatter his breath, but it cannot extinguish the obsession in his eyes. The endless rain dampens your clothes. An unfulfilled wish, a lingering obsession—with the sword tassel he hands over, it falls heavily into your palm...
After learning the truth hidden behind the Three Divine Swords, Master Long Xi has invited you to the Chess Pavilion to play chess and exchange thoughts.
Best Sparring Partner: Meeting at the Broken Bridge
With the rain falling incessantly outside the desolate ruins of the Zhuyun Cottage, a severely wounded swordsman asks for your help...
A woman with drunken eyes sits in the Douli Pavilion, drawing gasps from the watching children. Is she also here to comprehend the Sword Heart?
At a small stall in Wulian Town, a merchant is shouting that his goods come from the hands of "Minka." Go and find out if these goods are real or fake, and how they ended up in the merchant's hands.

After the divine sword incident sparked by Li Bai's poetry concluded, looking back at the entire affair spanning hundreds of years, one must wonder: who schemed for whom, who felt aggrieved for whom, and who stirred up the chaos—and for what purpose? The mystery is deep, and there are key elements you still cannot grasp. Now, the Master Long Xi has invited you to the Chess Pavilion to enjoy tea and discuss strategy. Perhaps this casual chat with the Master will help you uncover the motivations of everyone involved.
In Wulian Town, a craftsman from the Cloud-Casting Hut seems to be looking for a lost child...

You bumped into a disheveled scholar near the ruins of Dragon Valley and learned that he was conducting research on dragon remains. However, due to incomplete data, his junior held a different opinion, forcing him to investigate personally. If you are interested, you might as well check the ancient stone tablets in the ruins; you might just uncover the truth of history. After much exploration, you found the inscription and the junior. The two met and argued, and in the end, the junior was right, the senior smiled bitterly, and the next step is to go to South Dragon Valley to investigate... Although it is said that one should seek truth through practice, it is not easy for a senior who is always being questioned.

You retrieved the gourd for the drunken old man, but he kept muttering about fixing his Ni Armor and returning to the plum blossom stakes... Yet the armor's spirit had long since faded. You followed him as he stumbled after phantom sounds, eventually witnessing him in the ruins—using his own body as a frame and his sleeves as scales—perform his "final dance." The embers fall, but the torch has been passed.
Hard to distinguish true from false
Outside the Bazaar, just as you are worried about not having a token to enter, a little girl calls out to you...
Arguments can be heard on the streets of the Bazaar. You go closer to look, and it's actually Tian Youyou stealing someone's things...

I saw Xu Ye again, but he was being chased and beaten. Could this be some kind of martial arts training? Turns out, Xu Ye had stolen household money to practice martial arts to save face, but his money bag went missing, leading to a group of bounty hunters chasing him. And the missing money bag? His wife had arranged it all to teach him a lesson... Practice martial arts all you want, but don't mess with the "martial arts master" at home.
The post station is piled high with cargo, and several people have blocked the delivery person at her stall, urging her to hand over their packages. Go see if you can help her out of this situation.
A faded cloth strip with suspicious text leads you to a secluded hut under the maple tree. What kind of past is hidden here? And where will the drifting maple leaves return to?

The Neon Kite was incomplete, and the swordsman could not grasp the Alata sword intent. You followed the blood-stained feathers to find the injured Neon Kite, fishing and tending to its wounds, only to be rewarded with a spirit herb. This chance encounter, born of kindness, brought the swordsman to a sudden realization. The Alata sword intent was never in the form, but in the benevolence of helping others. The swordsman finally mastered the final strike, while that spirit herb still awaits its fated moment.
Maple Syrup Debt - Song Payment Ledger

After Duan Pingsheng's eyes cleared, she told you a story from the past. She was once a spirited young craftsman who, in order to defend her master Nan Hulai's work, organized a "righteous siege" against the bounty hunter Lu Cang, only to realize she had made a grave mistake and had been wandering the world ever since. Now she has returned because of the bounty on Nan Hulai. The road is long and the soul flies in sorrow; dreams cannot reach the difficult mountain passes. Duan Pingsheng handed you a broken flute. Is this the bamboo flute that Lu Cang once had?
Wait for Zhu Qi to Heal the Armadillo Rat
Defeat the Commotion of the Armadillo Rat.
Minka attempted to escape in the chaos, but unexpectedly, with a loud bang, a giant hammer descended from the sky, and the real Minka blocked the way.
As you recite the words on the wall, more voices join in, harmonizing. When you turn around, the scene before you has transformed into something brand new...

As Long Xi touched it, the flow on the broken sword surged again. It turned out that this was a Cloud-Forged weapon—Liu Yun—forged by the ancestors of Zhuyun Pavilion based on the legendary Gan Jiang's Cloud-Dream casting method.

Wuyan uses magic to haunt Dabai. Meanwhile, you and Nivie are ambushed by the returning Botu, but Dabai suddenly appears and repels him. Nivie is overjoyed to see Dabai, but the berserk Dabai attacks you both. At Nivie's call, Dabai briefly regains consciousness and flees. Nivie follows, but you are blocked by falling rocks.

You follow the gate-crashing students to meet their "boss," only to find Nivie. Just as you are surprised, Da Bai appears—it turns out Da Bai is the "boss." Da Bai arrives aggressively, but Nivie hints that you and Da Bai know each other. Da Bai drops his guard and uncontrollably shrinks, telling you to talk amongst yourselves while he goes to take a nap.

Faced with Qin Fei's sudden departure, you expressed concern for Su Luo. She, however, understood Qin Fei's decision and tsundere-ly declared she would find and scold him. It seems their fate is far from over...
Hard to distinguish true from false

Old Gourd looked around, as if he saw the grand scene of the Hundred Weapon Banquet once again. His aged hands put the Ni Helmet back on; the only audience for his final dance was the ruins and you...

The unconscious Nivie enters a dream, where her father tells her the story of "The Great Adventurer and the Gem of Happiness." In the story, the protagonist, a "Traveler," migrates from a cold homeland to a warm place due to a natural disaster, yearning for happiness, much like the journey Nivie and Dabai once took. However, Nivie does not know the ending of this story.
Climbing the pavilion, one can overlook the entire Dragon Valley. As that magnificent sight came into view, Xie Mu finally understood the scenery his friend had seen...

Nivie woke up to find Dabai extremely weak. With his remaining strength, Dabai told the end of the fairy tale—the gem the traveler sought could not bear to see her continue to suffer, so it turned into a sky full of snow, giving the traveler a home. Unable to bear the thought of Dabai fading away, Nivie, with the help of her companions, used her own flow to revive him.
After installing the Spirit Drive Core, the copper-armored Mechcraft in the stasis pod awakened...

No. 7 falls from the bridge, but Mr. Luban manages to save him in the nick of time. While Luban is still shaken, the innocent No. 7 shows no fear and begins pondering how one might overcome gravity...
Puyu's Attack was blocked by a sudden barrier. The flowing quenched snow upon it made Minka realize that her senior sister had been protecting her all along...
Over a hundred years ago, Alata saved Grandma's ancestors, and caring for the old tree, making it redder than the sunset on Mount Guye, was the promise the ancestors made to Alata.

During the quenching process, an accident occurred. An abnormal cloud flow swept toward Minka, and in the rush, Longxi blocked it with his body, and you were immediately swallowed by the cloud flow...
As you focus on reviewing the documents, Jade Core ambushes you from behind. Xiao Jia steps forward and takes the fatal blow for you. At this moment, the remnant soul of Gong Zhi quietly emerges...
Just as the tower ship was about to be destroyed by the out-of-control Shadow, a Mystery Man arrived and prevented the disaster...

Days passed by, with almost no change: She was accustomed to rising in the morning, meditating on the cliff's edge, and focusing her mind. At noon, she would dance with her sword against the air. In the afternoon, she would go for walks throughout the cave, and from afar, one could hear the noisy sounds of the Little Saepes. Returning in the evening, she would flip through a few pages of sword manuals and meditate again. ... A few days ago, Alata went to visit that Saepes King. After she returned, I felt something about her had changed. But the next day, her routine was the same as always, making me think for a moment that I had been mistaken. However, at noon today, Alata suddenly came before us. "Please, everyone, follow me to a place," she said with a slight nod and a bow. This was our first face-to-face conversation. For so long, we had maintained a tacit understanding of not speaking, and I don't know what changed her mind. Regardless, she had the willingness to communicate with the outside world, which was a good change. So I nodded in agreement. In the afternoon, we followed her to the Bud Garden to witness an old Saepes turn into a tree. The little deer was there too. The old Saepes had trekked from the distant cliff's edge; it walked slowly, and we were in no hurry, sitting among the sprouts, quietly watching the final journey of a living being. I don't know where a light breeze blew from, carrying a white petal. Alata reached out and caught it. She gathered the petal in her palm and suddenly said, "Once, I had a few good friends." We remained silent, listening quietly. "One of them really liked this kind of flower. At that time..." She paused here, and I looked up to see her eyes were slightly red. But the next second, she shook her head and sighed, "It's all in the past." The petal slipped into her sleeve, and the sadness of that moment vanished without a trace. In the time that followed, she said no more. Between heaven and earth, there was only the sound of the old Saepes' footsteps dragging across the grass, making a rustling noise. I don't know how long it took, but it finally arrived at the Bud Garden, breathing with difficulty, and bent down slightly. The little deer raised its head and touched it with its nose. The old Saepes let out a long sigh; everything it had experienced in its Lifelong journey dissipated into the air at this moment, becoming an echo in the quiet valley. Alata watched it and nodded in tribute. Heaven and earth remained the same. After the wind stopped, a Saepes tree stood in the Bud Garden.

It has been several weeks since we arrived at Aerux Hollow. Having stayed in this isolated place for so long, I have almost forgotten what a cruel slaughterhouse lies beyond this hollow at this very moment. She has been sleeping the whole time. Over these days, we have gradually pieced together her story from our individual memories. If our judgment is correct, she must be that decorated general—Alata. I enrolled early and once saw her from afar. That was perhaps her most spirited moment—the Master announced they were the final victors, and the Grand Duke infused her with power. The power of the Sanctified was so dazzling; when she spread her wings, everyone gasped in awe. Later, the affairs of the Hundred Herbs family became increasingly busy, and she went to the battlefield with those others. I never saw her again. Only in the victory reports from the front line could I occasionally catch a glimpse of her achievements. I never expected she would end up like this. The majesty of the Sanctified has faded from her features, and her body is curled up like an infant's, appearing so fragile in this vast hollow. It was only then that I realized the general I once looked up to was just as ordinary as any other living being in this world. Since that is the case, let us look after her. My feelings as I look at her are the same as when I look at any wounded person—I wish for her recovery and for her to wake up soon.

After the events at the Bud Garden, the situation at Alata gradually stabilized. We informed the Master of everything that happened during this time, and the Master sent word that we could withdraw. On the day of our departure, Alata saw us to the entrance of the grotto. 'Until we meet again,' I said. Alata did not answer, only wishing us a safe journey.

These days, more and more wounded are being sent back from the front lines. Our squad was originally on standby at the academy, but as the war intensified, we were sent to the front because there wasn't enough medical support. My companion vomited many times... I can't blame her; seeing that scene for the first time, a physiological reaction is perfectly normal. I often have nightmares myself. In my dreams, they are begging, 'It's so cold, can you light a bonfire, can you give me a coat...' I want to light a spark, but it's pitch black there, and there's nothing. I remember those faces. During the day, we were too incompetent to save them, and at night, we couldn't even fulfill that small wish for them. I keep dreaming of them, and gradually I can't tell day from night. Sometimes I even wonder, is what I see at night the truth, and the day is the nightmare? Perhaps, I am sick too. The Master found us and wanted to transfer us away from the front lines. 'I have a more important task for you,' he said. So we withdrew from the front and came to Aerux Hollow. Here, we met... her.

The thing I feared most has happened.

The war is over, but the victory brought no joy to anyone. The departed cannot reach tomorrow, and the days of old are gone forever. All of this hangs like a haze over Jixia, refusing to dissipate. We were busy treating the wounded, unable to catch our breath for days.
Master found us and sent us back to the Aerux Hollow.
Because of this, I saw Alata again.

Fortunately, she was conscious this time, though the situation was not optimistic.
Perhaps the loss of her friend dealt her a heavy blow, and the power of the divine markings erupted again, eroding her already scarred body.
Seeing us, she struggled to stand and thank us, hoping we would return to care for those who needed it more.

"This is the task Master gave us," I insisted. "The war is over, don't worry about the outside world, just focus on recovering."
Alata smiled bitterly at this.
"The war is over..." she whispered. "Yes..."

She didn't insist further, lying back down and picking up a leaf to cover her eyes.
No one knew what she was thinking, and no one asked.
Having witnessed so many partings, I have long understood that there are many causes and effects in this world that others cannot interfere with. Where she came from to the Aerux Hollow, and where she will go from here—only she can answer that question.

Written by Bai Xiao
This is to record the affairs of the Bai family:
My grandfather took my pregnant grandmother to hide in the Zhuyun Pavilion, seeking only to forge the Cuoyun weapon. However, on the day of the disaster at the pavilion, he died protecting the craftsmen, and my grandmother, wounded, fled with her unborn child. My grandfather's remains were never found; the descendants of the Bai family, when paying respects, only face west toward the Zhuyun Pavilion, offering clear dew as a tribute to send their distant grief.

My father spent twenty years in hiding, identifying through clues that the Master of the Ruins was the Long Qi of that year. To verify his identity, he followed the demon to Chang'an to find the strange doctor. On the night before he left, he forced the Youyun Sword, forged by my grandfather, into my hand.
—I refused to take it! For this sword to leave his side was a sign of eternal parting.
Yet, the sword... ended up in my palm after all.

Outside the medicine shop in Chang'an, my father witnessed the strange doctor carving flesh and grafting bone for the demon; that wretch had already become half-demon! In his panic, his tracks were exposed. My father fled for three thousand miles, only to be intercepted and killed on the path of Mount Guye. Dying, he left a blood-stained letter to be entrusted to a friend, which only reached my hands ten years later.
"My child... do not seek revenge..."
These few words were like a knife to the heart!

Clutching the Youyun Sword, the path of the jianghu for me... is nothing but a bloody road.
But how can mortal iron slay an immortal body? This journey ends either with the enemy's head falling, or the Bai family line ending!

On the night I reached the outskirts of Chang'an, my old wounds burst open.
In my delirium, I felt my father holding my wrist to teach me swordsmanship—the sensation was so real... so real that when I woke, I grasped only the moonlight leaking through the ruined temple.

Restless and unable to sleep, I tore off a piece of my robe and, dipping it in blood, sketched the hillside where I practiced swordsmanship as a child...
The way the blood seeped into the fabric's weave looked so much like the tree shadows sweeping across the Youyun sword tassel that year.
I suddenly understood my father's sigh back then: "Xiao'er... you must leave yourself a path home."

Every time I stroke this blood-stained map, I hear my father's voice cutting through the air:
"What are you afraid of? When the Youyun is unsheathed, it shall cleave mountains and sever seas!"
Under the tree, he delivered a "Cloud-Breaking" strike. When I parried, the web of my thumb split, but I saw the burning starlight in his eyes.
—And now, this overflowing hatred is my mountain and my sea.

When I finally saw Long Qi, the world in my eyes was stained red!
The Youyun Sword struck straight for his throat! This "Cloud-Breaking" style was taught by my father himself; once it cut through light and mist, today it drinks blood and severs souls!

But his sword was faster.
Fast as a ghost stealing a soul, steady as a mountain anchoring a river. The killing moves I had realized in my life were, to him, nothing more than an ant trying to shake a tree.

Suddenly, a chill at my ribs; the blade had pierced through bone.
As the pain exploded, I heard my father's old words echoing in my ears:
"A swordsman does not fear a strong enemy; he fears the hesitation in his own heart."
—So that was it... my hand was shaking when I swung the sword.

Grandfather, Father... Xiao'er has failed the Bai family's three-foot blade!
After a lifetime of seeking revenge, I end up exposed in the wilderness like a stray dog... Is this fate laughable?

The blood is running out. Writing this note seems to have used up my last strength.
But I still want to crawl back to the Zhuyun Pavilion, crawl back to that hillside from my childhood...
The warmth of my father holding my hand to teach me swordsmanship, the mottled tree shadows falling on the Youyun...
They are all drifting further and further away...

Hold on...
At least... I must die... on the road home...

In this fifth unit, we will finally discuss the legends of dream monsters. Dream monsters are generally divided into two categories: those that have become monsters due to the influence of dream energy, and those that are born from dreams, acting as the original inhabitants. First, let's talk about the first type. At the very beginning, a question arises: do monsters dream? The answer is likely yes. It is said that a hunter once conducted in-depth research on this. The generally accepted explanation for why wild monsters transform into dream monsters is that they live in dream regions and are exposed to dream energy, gradually evolving the characteristics of Dream Butterflies. The hunter discovered that in this process, the monsters themselves become dreamers and have dreams. Curious, he intervened in their dreams using certain methods. The first was a Nightmare Wolvine. Upon entering the dream, the hunter found himself in a vast grassland. The predecessor of the Nightmare Wolvine was a Wolvine, a creature of the earth that enjoyed running, hunting, and fighting. In the world of monsters, desires are simple. It was deeply immersed in the dream, enjoying pure joy, even though its appearance became cold and eerie, and its ghostly blue eyes were almost completely blind. The second was a Nightshadow Falcon. Influenced by the Dream Butterfly, its feathers became colorful and it was granted hallucinogenic abilities. It was originally a Swiftbolt Falcon that could no longer fly due to a wing injury. In the dream, it soared through the sky, proudly spreading its crest. The third was a Nightmare Lizard, a small lizard covered in brilliant scales, originally a Tailed Lizardling. In its dream, it experienced what it was like to be a dragon, no longer limited by its own strength, hiding in the environment and waiting for the right moment to attack; it became the true king of the dense forest. The various dream monsters recorded by the hunter are the subject of countless urban legends. People who accidentally wander into the Illusionary Dream Realm in the dead of night describe their terrifying appearance in unison. Nowadays, dream monsters are becoming known, but whether this hunter—or her entire study—is real remains to be seen. It is more like a legend, weaving a beautiful dream for the monsters, and the question of whether monsters can also be dreamers remains unanswered. Beyond the species infected by dream energy, the next category to introduce is the second type: monsters born from dreams, the Eerie Dreamtangle and the Eerie Dreamcage. The Eerie Dreamtangle has a huge, strange umbrella-shaped body with four thick, long tentacles. When it encounters prey, it traps them and feeds on their dreams. The other, the Eerie Dreamcage, is shaped like a cage and shoots dream energy at prey, causing them to fall into a dream. Speaking of these two monsters, one must mention a dream race—the Botu. The Botu is a strange, bird-like creature that once triggered a dream riot, severely wounding the Dreamweavers and occupying the Palace of Butterflies. The breeding of both types of Eerie Dreamthorns is related to the Botu. In the Illusionary Dream Realm, the Botu controls the Eerie Dreamthorns to block people's paths.

"Mindfulness Meditation" does not take much time, and it can eliminate physical and mental fatigue, restoring energy. As one of many mental healing methods, it is arguably the one most recommended by healers who Meditate.

It is said that the three Sword Masters guard Mount Guye, and none under heaven dare to trespass. Yet, the trees desire stillness, but the wind will not cease; how can the world remain at peace for long?
At that time, there was a kingdom called Zhaoge. Its ruler, ambitious and ruthless, conquered all directions. Wherever his iron hooves trod, cities fell and lives were lost, and the world suffered under his tyranny.
It is told that Zhaoge once attacked a city with high, thick walls and a garrison of one hundred thousand. The Zhaoge general led his army to surround it. On the first day, the city gates were shattered like dry wood; on the second day, the defenders were slaughtered like livestock. In mere days, the city was taken.
Victorious time and again, the Zhaoge ruler grew arrogant and sought to unify the world. Suddenly, he recalled the legend of Mount Guye: "He who obtains the Divine Swords shall rule the world." A mad obsession took hold—if he could possess the swords of Mount Guye, why worry about the world not belonging to him alone?
The Zhaoge general was ordered to lead his army toward Mount Guye. Banners blotted out the sun, and war drums shook the heavens. He ordered his troops to surround the mountain, while he led his personal guard to shout toward the peaks: "Sword Masters, hear this! Zhaoge has arrived to claim your swords for our great cause. Submit and be granted titles and rank; refuse, and Mount Guye shall fall!"
Silence reigned within the mountain; no one answered. The brute then ordered his men to seize an old man, tie him to a flagpole, and hold a blade to his throat.
"Within three counts, if the Sword Masters do not appear, this old man dies first, and Mount Guye shall be razed!"
Before the count of three was finished, a crystal-clear, razor-sharp ice spike struck the executioner's wrist. More ice spikes followed, severing the ropes. The old man fled back to Mount Guye. Soldiers tried to pursue, but were stopped by the Zhaoge general. Everyone looked up to see the three Sword Masters had emerged.
The Zhaoge general still attempted to negotiate, but the three heroes stepped forth with their Divine Swords. The Frost Sword Master summoned ice; a sudden chill, like a white dragon rising from the abyss, surged toward the enemy general, coating him in frost and slowing his movements. The Firmament Sword Master followed, his sword energy tearing through the air like a rift, shattering trees and rocks, striking straight at the general's throat. The attack was so sudden that even the formidable Zhaoge general, who had slain countless heroes, barely managed to block it.
Enraged, the enemy general swung his halberd and ordered the capture of the Sword Masters. Tens of thousands of elite troops surged like a tide, a forest of blades and a rain of arrows. Unlike common bandits, the Zhaoge elites were well-trained. Even with the Mount Guye swordsmen covering the three heroes, it was a desperate battle, especially with the Zhaoge general leading the charge himself.
The three heroes unleashed their powers. The Frost Sword Master swung his blade, filling the sky with cold to freeze the vanguard; the Firmament Sword Master danced with his sword, rays of light scattering to deflect arrows; the End-Times Sword Master struck, a flash of blood-red thunder aiming for the general's head. The enemy general roared, sweeping his massive halberd to meet the Firmament sword energy. A gale rose, dust filled the air, and a streak of blood-red lightning pierced the haze. Blood-red blade light flashed, the sounds of battle grew intense, and the dust, stained red, finally settled. The enemy general stood tall, his armor shattered, but his fighting spirit remained undimmed.
The people of Mount Guye retreated to the mountain gate, holding the enemy at bay, but they could only defend, not repel. Zhaoge surrounded them without attacking, cutting off their supplies. After ten days of siege, food ran low. A thunderous roar echoed: "Surrender the Divine Swords, and you shall be spared!" The Mount Guye heroes swore never to yield. The Frost Sword Master declared: "Better to be a shattered jade than a whole tile!" The Firmament Sword Master agreed, while the End-Times Sword Master remained silent as ever.
That night, with the moon hidden and stars sparse, a dark figure darted past, moving with extraordinary agility, unlike any ordinary person. The sentry, alert, shouted: "Who goes there!"
The swordsman did not answer, but struck back with a sword—it was the Firmament sword energy. Everyone was shocked.
Who is this person? Are they friend or foe? Listen to the next installment to find out!

Long Nian was caught off guard, the sword energy backlashed, instantly freezing her in black ice. She could not move, only her eyes filled with tears as she called out her friend's name.
Seeing this, Long Qi was furious and chased out of the mountain gate with the Firmament sword. But with two swords missing, the cloud-flow ice wall dissipated. The Chaoge army saw their chance, war drums thundered, and the entire army advanced. The Demon-kind swordsman turned and swung his two swords at Long Qi. The Frost sword's energy was like a viper's tongue; wherever it touched, plants were encased in black ice. The End-times sword's light was like a hungry wolf; wherever it swept, sand and stone were filled with blood mist. Long Qi struggled to defend, his shoulders and legs wounded, his robes stained with blood.
To break the siege, Long Qi channeled the Firmament sword's energy directly into his dantian, becoming one with the sword—if the sword lives, he lives; if the sword dies, he dies. In an instant, the wind and clouds changed color, beast fur burst through his skin, and his body grew more than twice its size, transforming into a monster like an ape. His face was unrecognizable, but his pair of angry eyes remained fixed on the traitor.
He saw the ape-creature swinging the sword wildly, no longer using refined techniques, only the intent to kill. Where the sword passed, rocks shattered; when the two swords clashed, the sky changed color. The traitor ignored their past friendship, and even as Long Nian called out from afar, he coldly raised his sword, each strike aimed at Long Qi's throat.
The Chaoge soldiers saw the two tigers fighting and wanted to reap the benefits. The Chaoge commander ordered the archers to fire, but the collision of the Divine Weapons unleashed thousands of sword energies. The blue and red light swept across the battlefield, and wherever it passed, the heads of men and horses fell like grass. In an instant, the battlefield was littered with corpses, and the blood turned the yellow earth into mud. The hateful traitor was distracted for a moment and was run through the chest by Long Qi's sword, blood splashing three feet as he staggered and fell.
Long Qi turned, about to speak, but saw that the people of Mount Guye had reached the mountain gate. His former peers saw his beastly face and fangs, his terrifying form, and all retreated in fear, while children cried and hid. Long Qi touched his face and knew he had lost his human appearance. He let out a sound that was half-ape roar and half-wail, overcome with shame. He dropped the Firmament sword and leaped into the deep ravine. From then on, Long Qi was never seen on Mount Guye again.
The Divine Weapons were stained with blood, and evil currents suddenly arose. The Firmament sword's blue light dimmed, the Frost sword's white glow seeped with blood, and the End-times sword's black energy soared to the sky. The three swords resonated, and evil currents overflowed.
Suddenly, the sound of ice cracking was heard; it was Long Nian breaking free from the black ice. But the cold had invaded her meridians, damaging her foundation. She stumbled to the three swords and wept, clutching them. Her tears fell onto the swords, turning into a clear stream that washed away the evil energy. But while the sword's evil is easy to remove, the heart's wounds are hard to heal. Long Nian sighed to the sky: "My brother has fled, my friend has become an enemy; what use are these Divine Weapons?" With that, she exhausted her life's cultivation, turned her body into a stream of light, and poured it into the three swords.
The swords shone with seven colors, the light shot into the sky, and then dissipated between heaven and earth. From then on, Long Qi disappeared, the traitor was finally purged, Long Nian perished, and the three swords were nowhere to be found.
Later, woodcutters rumored that they had seen a hairy-faced figure deep in the ravine, howling at the moon, the sound mournful. Others said the three swords did not disappear but scattered across the world, waiting for a fated person to reunite them. Still others, staying overnight on Mount Guye, heard ape calls from the deep mountains, sometimes mournful and miserable, sometimes filled with lingering resentment, as if telling that forgotten past.
The secret story of Zhuyun Hut ends here. Only in the deep mountains on summer nights, the ape calls echo, mournful and miserable, or filled with lingering resentment—only the mountain wind knows.
