By the end of the day, Minka had cleared three trials. We sat on that mountain peak, and the sunset was blinding. She, squinting, insisted on pointing toward the sunset and telling me that was Chang'an, and that the little girl would soon be able to return there with her father. I really wanted to pull her back and make her look behind her—she still had over thirty trials left to go. Forget it, I understand her a little. She was about the same age as that little girl when she came to the workshop. Her father was short on money for a Cloud-Severing weapon and said he was going home to get it. Sigh, that excuse was too flimsy. She sat on a small stool at the market entrance, craning her neck for three months, never even catching a glimpse of her father. The child didn't cry or make a scene; she just went to the workshop entrance, picked up a Mask, and started working as a Mercenary. But this order isn't worth it. If it's for that little girl, then I can only say that Minka still hasn't seen through things after all these years, still holding onto some foolish hope.

"Qingping, you're finally back!"
"What's wrong? Everyone looks so dejected. Which deity came to attack Zhuyun Pavilion this time?"
"If only a deity were protecting our Zhuyun Pavilion! Qingping, please think of a way, all our orders have been canceled!"
"Canceled? Why? Didn't they have to wait months just to get an order from us? How could they cancel so easily?"
"Those on the waiting list canceled too. The most ridiculous one is Hero Xu; he came in a panic this morning to cancel his order!"
"Wasn't Hero Xu's order due for delivery the day after tomorrow? Didn't he say why?"
"No matter how we asked, he wouldn't say. We kept pressing him, and he finally stammered out a name—Lu Cang."
"Lu Cang?? So she still hasn't given up!"
"Does Senior Sister Qingping know this person? Is she another martial arts fanatic chasing after our Master Nan Hulai?"
"Not at all. Lu Cang isn't just some simple martial arts fanatic—she's a bounty hunter."
"Ah?? People from the Tianguang Workshop dare to loiter at the entrance of Zhuyun Pavilion!"
"A few days ago, a woman in white came to the gate of Zhuyun Pavilion and demanded to see Master by name. Seeing her address Master so disrespectfully, I stopped her and asked her purpose. She only said she came to seek Master Nan Hulai's Cloud-Mist Weapon. Who comes to Zhuyun Pavilion if not to get the Cloud-Mist Weapon forged by my Master? I asked where she came from and if anyone had recommended her. That's when I found out she's actually a bounty hunter!"
"But Senior Sister Qingping, usually bounty hunters act sneakily. How did she tell you the truth directly?"
"I don't know either. The craftsmen who heard her introduce herself were all shocked. Who has ever seen such an open bounty hunter? Of course, I didn't give her a good look and tried to drive her away, but... I couldn't beat her. While we were arguing at the gate, Master came out."
"Ah? Senior Sister Qingping has the most solid foundation in our Zhuyun Pavilion. If even you couldn't beat her, what use was it for Master to come out?"
"I thought Lu Cang would make things difficult for my Master, but to my surprise, she bowed respectfully to him and stated her request for the sword directly. Although she was blunt, she had no intention of using force. I was puzzled at the time, but seeing her in white, I remembered what the elders told me: there is a type of bounty hunter in the Tianguang Workshop who wears white and usually does 'chivalrous' deeds to make connections. It's a common tactic of the Tianguang Workshop. Lu Cang must be that kind of bounty hunter."
"But no matter how polite Lu Cang is, Master Nan Hulai wouldn't agree to her, right?"
"That's natural. My Master is gentle, but he wouldn't accept a commission from such a villain. He told Lu Cang directly that Zhuyun Pavilion has rules: those who obtain the Cloud-Mist Weapon must have bones like pine and joints like bamboo—hey, you all memorized this since you were kids, don't make me quiz you—only like pine and bamboo can one prove a sword heart. The Tianguang Workshop has always acted despicably; where would they get a sword heart?"
"Hehe, those are the rules set by the old master, how could we forget? Don't worry, Senior Sister! But Lu Cang won't give up, right? Otherwise, we wouldn't have had so many cancellations today."
"Indeed, Lu Cang didn't care. She asked Master to name his price and conditions, and she would fulfill them. Master only said the Cloud-Mist Weapon is priceless, and she, Lu Cang, couldn't even meet the condition of a sword heart, and told her to leave early. But Lu Cang just wouldn't leave... Sigh, my Master has seen it all. Martial arts fanatics howling under his window day and night to beg for a Cloud-Mist Weapon is nothing new, but what if there's a cold-blooded killer squatting down there who is stubborn and won't shed a tear even when facing the coffin?"
"That's true. Most bounty hunters are sneaky and dark, but top-tier bounty hunters are said to be killers! C-could it be that our customers were..."
"I don't think so. If she wanted to act, she would have done it that day. But it's not the killer seeking the sword that's scary, it's the killer targeting the whole family. After Lu Cang persisted for half a day and Master refused to see her, she coldly left a message that she would come back to seek the sword, and then left. But that night, I don't know if it was outside the town or on the rafters of Zhuyun Pavilion, the sound of a flute kept echoing..."
"So the flute music that night was Lu Cang? We all heard it! Senior Sister, you have to admit, it was actually quite nice..."
"But think about it, after experiencing this during the day, I don't know what Master thought, but I was terrified! You don't know, when Lu Cang stared at the Cloud-Mist Weapon and my Master, her eyes were straight, just like an eagle spotting its prey, ready to dive into a mountain of blades and a sea of fire to capture it, never stopping until death..."
"Look how scared you are, Senior Sister. Your expression is no different from the customers who came to cancel today. If she dares to come again, I will definitely meet her myself!"
"No, you are no match for her. She is a bounty hunter who eats people without spitting out the bones. I have to go ask Master for instructions. I assume he is still in seclusion at the forge and doesn't know what's happening outside. Letting this Lu Cang continue to be presumptuous is not a solution. This is simply a huge trouble for Master, a huge trouble for Zhuyun Pavilion!"
"What good solution could Master Nan Hulai have?"
"My Master told me that if anyone ever forces him to forge a Cloud-Mist Weapon, he will tell them to pluck the moon from the sky!"

【Interest】Theme badges are divided into Home Builder, Guide's Light, Admiration, Light & Shadow, Kindred Spirits, Storyteller, Leisure, and Combat Spirit, totaling 8 types, each containing 5 levels of interest badges. [br] To unlock 1 Level 1 interest theme badge, you need to accumulate 200 points of the corresponding interest EXP; [br] To unlock 1 Level 2 interest theme badge, you need to accumulate 600 points of the corresponding interest EXP; [br] To unlock 1 Level 3 interest theme badge, you need to accumulate 1600 points of the corresponding interest EXP; [br] To unlock 1 Level 4 interest theme badge, you need to accumulate 4000 points of the corresponding interest EXP; [br] To unlock 1 Level 5 interest theme badge, you need to accumulate 8200 points of the corresponding interest EXP. [br][br] 【Resonance】 theme badges are divided into Most Precious Person, Star Rush Child, Friend of Time, Hun-Tian Wingman, Frost Plum Knight, School Doctor's Assistant, Thousand Caves Guardian, Heart No. 7, Final Battle, Last Line of Defense, You Are Like Hearthfire, Welcome Miss, Guardian Rabbit, and Poetry & Wine Friends, totaling 14 types, each containing 1 hero-related interest badges. [br] To unlock each 1 Resonance theme badge, you need to accumulate 3000 points of the corresponding interest EXP. [br][br] As the season updates, Interest Circle theme badges will continue to be updated, so stay tuned~

Linglong Tower attack module, periodically fires <ffdda4>[Missiles]</> at threatening targets within range.
An ordinary object, its value is hardly enough to bring joy, but at least it can serve as another mark of a long journey.

A marvelous Mechcraft woven from cloud silk, lightweight and flexible, capable of hovering in mid-air.
It can both nourish the fields and guide travelers on their journey.
Though pressed by wind-eroded rocks, the light within the box remains clearly visible. Use a plunging Attack to destroy the rubble, and the treasure chest will see the light of day again.

Mechcraft technology and magic arts are cleverly combined to create an Invisible Path that helps students find hidden passages. Where there seems to be no way forward, hidden stone slabs will be revealed.

Used to power the bronze Mechcraft in the Littoral Towership, found on some special transport Mechcraft.
The towership area is rich in copper ore, and the Sanctified used local materials to create Spirit Drive Cores and various Mechcraft.
Connect the spirit pivot to solve the puzzle. Connect the lines to guide the energy to the destination to complete the puzzle.

Where the light points, there are wonders.
Once activated, it will point to a specific location. Follow the device's guidance to activate them in order to reveal hidden treasure chests.

A new generation of brewing Mechcraft improved by Luban, which turns Ji-Fox Wheat into the Harvest Fields specialty, Harvest Brew.
He improved the complicated brewing process of the past, increasing efficiency and success rates. Now, you only need to step on the pedal to maintain the Mechcraft's power, then hit the targets on the left and right to ensure both temperature and humidity meet the standards. However, if any of the power, temperature, or humidity levels drop to zero, the brewing fails.
Use a Frozen Fruit to break the monster's Stealth state in the Littoral Abyss.

A light-weaving machine containing magic power, storing puzzles hidden within light and shadow.
Rotate the projection to piece the sigil together and complete the puzzle.

Located above the Mechcraft Lab, it powers the entire research facility and serves as the mechcraft hub to open the path to the flying ship. It is now abandoned and requires a Spirit-Driven Core to be reactivated.

Wherever life goes, there is an echo.
Touch the lingering shadows of the flow, and the Bracer can reconstruct images to recreate scenes of the past.
Finding the wine bottle tests your eyesight; if you have trouble identifying it, use Metaflow Sensing to detect its location.
Complete <ffdda4>trials</> set up by Master Zhuangzi at Dreamwhisper Lake to earn rich rewards.
A special Mechcraft that changes form based on weight. Step on it to trigger the linkage mechanism and activate the device.
The Cloud-Pulling Rope can be synchronized with the Dream Butterfly. Follow the Dream Butterfly's guidance to roam the land of dreams together.

An ancient mechcraft lift left over from the previous era. Though old, it is still operational, connecting Enlightenment Plaza to the eastern cliff of the Jixia Mountains. You must find the hidden switch in the Roaring Tiger Training Hall to activate this lift.
During the war, the Sanctified in Dragon Valley built a Mechcraft device that gathered energy from dragon bones. Take its faintly glowing core to light a Lamp of Return.
Ding-a-ling—listen, that's the sound of treasure sparkling. Come and see what incredible things naughty Menki has found for you this time!
Once you find the wine bottle, you can lead it to the wine table to place it properly.

Only when touched by the ripples of power can the brilliance of the Dream-Floating Stone bloom.
Use skills to Attack and awaken the long-slumbering Dream-Floating Stone to release the dream. As the stone platform rises, the stairs will appear.

In the cracks of the Dreamscape, mirages born of obsession remain. Pass through <ffdda4>Dream Rifts</> to travel instantly to distant places, or even fall into dreams still lingering in the <ffdda4>Dreamscape</>.
Lake light flickers, battle intent rings. Defeat the guards of the Pearlized Lake Trial Array to obtain rewards.
Dream thorns have trapped the body of the River Spirit, but they cannot bind its heart that yearns for freedom. If you can find a way to help, the River Spirit will offer a reward.
Board the Cloud Skiff and start a journey through the clouds. Ride the Cloud Skiff to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Jixia from high above and reach all corners of Jixia.

Look at the mountains and rivers beneath your feet like a painting, and listen to the wind whistling like a song— This journey to Lingxiao is better shared than enjoyed alone. Why not invite a companion to enjoy the beauty of the birds flying together?
When the Mechcraft activates, the Cloudsilk Orbs take flight on the wind, scattering everywhere. Before they vanish into the breeze, round them all up and tuck them away.

A mysterious Mechcraft is attached to the treasure chest, and magic energy surges like a dark tide. When approaching the chest, you must jump nimbly to dodge the oscillating magic energy Attack. Once close to the chest, destroy the mechanism hub to open it.
<ffdda4>[Energy Core]</> is one of the Linglong Tower's Mechcrafts. Find a way to destroy the <ffdda4>[Energy Core]</> to open the Linglong Tower gate and complete the trial.
Collect Aerux Dewdrops to activate the Aerux Bridge and connect the path to explore the Aerux Hollow.

Step on the platform and use the Cloud Energy to activate the Mechcraft; the lightweight wings gifted by that genius boy will unfold for you. Feel the tremor of the gears meshing and soar into the clouds in the rising airflow.
Rockfall traps that players can shoot down. Once shot down, they will crash to the ground, dealing significant Damage to enemies in the area.
You can teleport to the Central Pillar via the light.
The most unassuming yet charming object. Of course, the true appeal lies in what's inside. The more ornate the chest, the more precious the treasure within usually is.
Magical creatures occasionally seen in Jixia that love a good game of tag. Try to keep up with them to earn a reward for this chase.
The withered vines have endured the ages, long since knotted like iron. Swords cannot sever them; only a raging fire can Negate them.
Guide the light of the art, initiate the seal. Touch the Mechcraft switch, observe the trajectory of the light, and activate the corresponding Mechcraft in order to break the seal.

A target-shaped Mechcraft that switches states when hit by an Attack.
Craftsmen drew inspiration from it to create all sorts of intricate puzzles. Solve them to receive generous rewards.
Some cloud silk will slowly settle and condense into crystals of various sizes. These crystals are sturdy and reliable, and are considered precious materials by many.

An ancient tree stump containing cloud flow, still shielding the secret treasure of the wood core from the elements.
Burn or split the stump to reveal the treasure chest.
Treasures are buried deep in the earth, and only maps record their location. Find the burial site and use the Bracer to sense them so the treasure can reappear in the world.
Use a Frozen Fruit to break the monster's Shield in the Littoral Abyss.

Cloud-Piercing Chips, gathering clouds for use.
Jixia students can consume Cloud-Piercing Chips to activate mountain Mechcraft, or use them at exchange mechanisms to claim rewards.
Barriers that cannot be destroyed by ordinary force can only be negated by Cloud Energy. Insert a Cloud Energy Chip into the Cloud Energy Mechcraft to disable the magic barrier.
A piece of Mechcraft that can sensitively sense flames, it should be a relic from the Primordial era.
The cloud currents on Mount Guye are dense. Where they converge, they form vortices with powerful lift. If used correctly, one can leap into the air from them.
Watch out for those fragile creations; a single strike might be enough to make them crumble instantly.
All Illuminators in the Underhall have been activated. The light has been reactivated.
In the <ffdda4>Illusive Realm</>, <ffdda4>Dream Wood</> releases Dream Energy from its leaves and branches, which removes any Dream Enchantment.

This kite, which should have been flying peacefully, has become a rampaging mech-beast due to a malfunction in its core gears. No one can predict if it will soar into the sky or crash into your back in the next second...
Help Du Qin recover the runaway Mechcraft kites in Northton. Once finished, you can exchange them for rewards with her in Aerux Town.

Challengers who step on the clouds will receive the gift of daring to touch the sky. Avoid the interference of Mechcraft, overcome heavy obstacles, and the person who reaches the finish line the fastest is the winner.

Light the Return Lamp with a Mechcraft wick to awaken vows of the past. It was once a landmark for the Sanctified, and now it waits for new travelers at the corner of Dragon Valley. Do not fear the long night, for this glimmer will guide your way.
A condensate containing rich magic power; upon intense impact, the power within will instantly erupt.
Soar like a shadow, tread upon the air. The Mechcraft platform hides a grappling hook; touch the platform to activate it.
In the <ffdda4>Dream Realm</>, there are sobering <ffdda4>Dream-Dissolving Buds</>. Consuming a <ffdda4>Dream-Dissolving Bud</> provides continuous resistance to the effects of the lingering dream.
The Bronze Heavy Cannon can deal high Stance reduction and knock down the Bronze Fish.

No treasure is gained without facing danger. You must crouch and sneak, carefully approaching by using the blind spots of the Mechcraft's vision, and remain still when the detection vision approaches. After approaching the treasure chest, break the Mechcraft hub to open it.

The <ffdda4> [Phase Deflector] </> developed by the School of Mechcraft can reflect the <ffdda4> [Missiles] </> fired by the Exquisite Tower. Attack the deflector to adjust its orientation and change the missile's flight trajectory.
Tiny River Spirits that occasionally appear in Jixia, emitting a dim, fluorescent glow. Touching them grants a wisp of healing power.

Lush grass is an excellent natural Veiled hiding place.
Every patch of unexplored greenery may hide a deadly ambush.
What seems like an ordinary Mechcraft structure hides precise mechanical principles. Observe the nearby clues carefully, and you will find the secret to activating the mechanism.

This ore is too hard to be moved by ordinary means.
Only rapid temperature changes in a short period can make it brittle enough to shatter.
Use the Mechcraft pedals to move the bronze columns and merge them.
When Aersilk mixes with Jixia springs, a unique phenomenon occurs. Bathing in this mixture leaves one feeling rejuvenated, completely rested, and filled with boundless energy.
A token left behind by a deity in legend, condensing the power to perceive the world. It usually floats high up; collect it to use for potential stimulation.
In East Aerfall Highlands stand eight Sentinel pillars. Each pillar has a trial that requires restoring three bronze spheres using Mechcraft.
Remains of a broken dream. Menki will like them.
A device powered by Divine Imprint, linking with other Mechcraft devices for operational coordination.

To win in a small space, one must borrow the power of nature and skillfully control change.
Activate to raise moving platforms, then use your abilities to reach the finish line and claim the final reward.

The stone formation has stood silent for ages, hiding mysteries within.
Rotate the stone pillars and align them to their proper positions to awaken the dormant ancient formation.
The truth often lies beyond sight. Try to take a leap of faith based on your memory and determination; those paths obscured by demonic energy will reveal themselves beneath your feet.

A young River Spirit with a sprout on its head and a naive expression.
Touch it gently to show friendliness, and you will receive a gift from nature.
Turn on the three Energy Hubs to activate the Stone Extractor.
Use the Volcanic Stone Keys to activate the Illuminators in the three areas around the Underhall.
The Bronze Heavy Cannon's shield can block damage at critical moments.

The ancient stele appears sturdy, but its interior has long been eroded by time.
Any sacrilegious touch will invite its retaliation.
Magical creatures occasionally seen in Jixia that love a good game of tag. Try to keep up with them to earn a reward for this chase.

The stele is shattered, its true words lost to the dust.
Collect the fragments and reassemble the stele, then use your Bracer to make a rubbing of the complete inscription. The rubbings can be exchanged for rewards at regional shops.
The Shadow Rift will continuously summon Dreamtangle. Hold the interaction key for a moment to close the Shadow Rift.

<ffdda4> [Transfer Prisms] </> that can store and conduct energy, appearing in pairs of the same shape. <ffdda4> [Missiles] </> fired from the Linglong Tower can be transmitted between prisms of the same shape.

A device used to solve puzzles, capable of opening sealed Mechcraft.
Defeat the Guard or solve the puzzle to open the sealed Mechcraft.
Pay attention to the color of the light in the Mechcraft; it changes according to the state of the mechanism.
A gate locked by layers of intricate Mechcraft. Only by finding the one and only key can you undo the confinement.
The ancient inscription holds clues to a hidden location. Follow the clues and use your Bracer to sense the hidden chest.
A self-operating Mechcraft lift that requires no effort from passengers.

At the end of the arc lies a mysterious gift.
Aim, charge, throw—hit the ring in the center of the Mechcraft to claim your reward.
A Mechcraft elevator with precise floor selection. Simply select the floor, and the cabin will flexibly ascend or descend along different rails.

The suspended, glowing Mechcraft core carries the resonance of geniuses and the confrontation of Fate. Clear the Platform Trial, stand on the central circular pedal, and interact with the core. Once the light flows, the platform will activate.
The Shield against the frost impact has been deployed. Stay close behind the Shield to avoid Damage.

Used for the manufacture of Divine Pattern Mechcraft. By switching the input Divine Pattern charts and behavioral modes, you can construct Mechcraft and test their behavior sequences and performance.
It also includes the design and production of biomimetic Mechcraft, such as the turtle-shaped Xuan Guard and crab-shaped Copper Shell, all of which are exquisite Mechcraft crafted by the Sanctified based on biological prototypes.
Watch for and avoid the negative flow of frost, then find an opportunity to shatter the core.

In the Whispering Grove Underground, pipes are dense and filled with flowing gas mixed with chaotic cloud currents. It will erode the vitality of anyone who gets too close, so be careful to avoid contact.
Place the Dream-Energy-infused Dream Orb into the Dream Washer to power the large construct.

A timid River Spirit hiding in sturdy Vine. If you approach rashly, it will build a shield for itself using the flow of nature. Perhaps stay further away, and while it's off guard, throw something at it...
Mount Guye is rich in fine wine, with bottles scattered across the wilderness. You might want to search around the various wine tables.

The Mechcraft claw, usually sturdy, always goes limp at the critical moment— But who can resist the temptation of a cute doll and not try their luck again? Fortunately, as a craftsman, one can always craft a Croaky Coin to try again!
According to records, this statue is the device maintaining the seal. Try using the bracelet to sense the correct position of the seal statue.

Used for performance testing of Mechcraft in the Mechcraft Lab. It hangs above the lab daily and descends upon starting a test, releasing test Mechcraft warriors.
The test includes multiple rounds of assessment, covering fire resistance, cold resistance, and mobility, serving as a comprehensive performance verification for Mechcraft.
A Mechcraft device capable of sensing light. Adjust the beam angle and use its refractive Trait to direct the light into the sensor for unexpected rewards.
Time passes, yet the glow on the stone wall has not faded in the slightest. Try pushing the stone wall engraved with divine patterns to activate the power hidden within.

The strange dream patterns left by the Dreamweaver on the rocks of the Dreamland seem to contain the profound mysteries of the Way of Dreams. Adjusting your view at designated locations to piece these patterns together is a trial on the path to understanding the Way of Dreams.
Once the columns are combined, use the Mechcraft beam to align them and activate the gate to the Azure Flame Hall.

The Dream-Energy spacetime has generated large areas of <ffdda4> Dream Realms </>. Entering this area will continuously apply the <ffdda4> Dream Enchantment </> debuff. The <ffdda4> Dream Enchantment </> effect traps players in an illusion, continuously reducing their <ffdda4> Max Health </> while simultaneously increasing their <ffdda4> Attack </> and <ffdda4> Life Steal </>.

After days of fierce battle, we finally struck down the enemy’s giant. Here we raised its arm in remembrance of our victory, as the horn of counterattack sounded that very day.

I have hidden a treasure at the <69D0FF>wrist of the Giant Hand Ruins</>. Let those who come after seek them, should fortune guide their steps.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Sunken Stele Pondside

The enemy's sudden attack has left us outnumbered, and defeat seems imminent... Yet, I have no intention of fleeing. I only wish to perish alongside my comrades.

I've hidden treasures <69D0FF>beneath the stele in the Glory Woods</>. Those with fate on their side may find them.

Today's defeat lies not in our valor, but in the cruel turn of fate's wheel. As a commander, I refuse to cling to life while my broken body may yet buy moments against the enemy tide.

My treasure rests <69D0FF>beneath the southern falls of Frostcloud Town</>, awaiting those destined to claim it.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Southwest of the Mausoleum

Only those of exceptional talent can pass the Path of Trials. If you're weary, take a short break here.



I've hidden treasures <69D0FF>in the cave behind the waterfall on the cliff</>. Those with fate on their side may find them.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: Outside Old Citadel

The military order arrived suddenly; I fear I may never return. I buried my treasures <69D0FF>beneath the coastal cliff</>, hidden by Sea Coral Waterfall.

May those who come after me share this dawn view of the East Sea.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: East of Mirror Lake

War is looming. We are taking refuge here, but there could be unforeseen dangers. I have tucked away our lifelong savings, to be kept for future needs.

I hid the treasures <69D0FF>by the Bronze Tablet underwater near the Meeting Hall</>. Those with fate on their side may find them.

The war is raging on. I have been ordered to guard the path to Seclusion City from here. I must be as resolute as iron and handle things with care. Only then I can fulfill my duty and fend off the enemies.

I hid the treasures <69D0FF>in the military camp north of Dusklight Pavilion</>. Those with fate on their side may discover them.
Mysterious Stone Tablet: North of Mirror Lake

The enemy is approaching, but our soldiers remain to Stand Firm. It's too early to call this our final stand. After all, beyond the Crosswind Bridge, there is still a glimmer of hope of survival in the east of Aerfall.
I hid the treasure at the <69D0FF>southern end of the Crosswind Bridge</>. Those with fate on their side may find it.

My wounds won't stop bleeding, and I'm losing my strength. I fear it's too late for me to be saved...

From outside the mountains, aren't you? Mount Guye is full of cloud currents; are you getting used to it here?
I'm telling you, this ailment shouldn't be ignored. If you drag it out, you won't be able to practice properly.
Not bad. Mount Guye is surrounded by cloud currents all year round, but the concentration of these currents varies greatly between the peak and the base.
It's fine here in Wulian Town, but the fog gets very thick at the mountainside. Outsiders always have some kind of reaction when they arrive.
Cloudstep Cliff is the most dangerous; those who are physically weak won't survive the climb.
Do visiting warriors often feel unwell?

I'm telling you all not to push yourselves. Rest when you need to; there's no shame in it.
Oh, right, a few students from the Baicao family are staying on the mountain too. They spend every day learning soothing techniques from our local doctors, haha.
Are the locals also affected by the Cloud-Flow?
We locals have grown up on this mountain since we were kids; we're long used to it.
The ten-year-old kids in town run up to the High Sky Cloud Cliff to play all by themselves. They always come back perfectly fine, full of energy.
What are those little stones placed in the clinic?
That's called a Cumulus Stone. Don't let its plain look fool you; it holds cloud currents inside.
I collected some smaller ones to keep in the shop for travelers to lean on while practicing their breathing exercises.
Adapting to the environment slowly is much better than forcing it.
Fine, then take care. If you don't feel well on the road, come back and find me.
A small mountain tavern for martial training, featuring fresh seasonal ingredients, nourishing food, and even a ramen performance!
See if there's anything you'd like to eat, I'll get you something hot.
Right, the doctors at Mount Guye have always advocated for food therapy, so I picked up a few recipes.
The ingredients are fresh picks from the mountains this morning—refreshing and nourishing.
Eating it often is good for your health, and it tastes great too. You'll know once you try it.

Alright, remember to stop by next time you pass through. I'll save a bowl of noodles for you.
Tap with the small hammer, strike with the big hammer! Lift high, place steady! To find the Cloud-Forged weapon, come to the Cloud-Casting Hut! The clanging rings far and wide!
See if there's anything here you can use?

Not only is the blade sharp, but holding it also helps focus the mind and spirit.
The three divine swords passed down through generations in the hut are the pinnacle of masterpieces among the Cloud-Mist weapons.
I'm not bragging, this is one of a kind in the world.
Where do forging materials come from?
Naturally, it's the Cloud-Gathering Stone from Mount Guye. The entire region of Wulian Town was a massive vein of Cloud-Gathering Stone in the early days.
After two hundred years of digging, only that raw stone in front of the hut remains.
I touch it every day before I start work, as a keepsake.
How can I obtain Cuoyun Soldiers?
That depends on the craftsman's mood. Some are willing to do it for free if they meet a hero they get along with.
But if the person seeking a sword has ulterior motives, they won't be able to buy one, even if they offer a mountain of gold and silver.
Many old craftsmen will set up trials, and only after passing them will they agree to talk about sword forging.
How is business at the Casting Cloud Pavilion?
Don't even mention it. Ever since Tianguang Workshop took over the market, they've been selling cheap, knock-off Cloud-Forged weapons all day, ruining the proper forging trade.
Their weapons are no good. They're far worse than Cuoyun weapons. We call them 'Luan-Yun weapons.'
But those warriors don't know quality, let alone distinguish the real from the fake; even many fellow craftsmen couldn't resist the temptation and quietly packed up and left.
But let me tell you, fake is fake, and true craftsmanship cannot be faked.
Take care! Come find me, Long Ge, if you need anything!
I specialize in handmade toys, wooden weapons, and trinkets—I've got it all!
Come in and take a look when you're free, pick something you like to take home.
Sigh, these are just little toys modeled after famous weapons. The kids in town use them to play around; it doesn't matter if they get bumped or scratched.
I just remembered how Master Alata once subdued a mountain with a single sword, so I made a batch to let the kids live out their hero fantasies.
Why do you like making toys?

But now the Master has vanished without a trace, and I can't even find a shadow of him.
I just focus on tinkering with these little things, thinking that as long as the children hold them, the memory in their hearts will remain.
That old rascal Nanhu Zhang runs over here every few days to pick out a bunch of things to coax the kids.
But looking at him, he doesn't seem like an ordinary person.
Take care, come back when you're free.

Feel free to ask about any item you like. Take your pick, the price is negotiable.
It wasn't like this before... Back when the Martial Arts Tournament was still held, the Mountain Market was so crowded you couldn't even move.
But now the tournament keeps getting postponed, and there are fewer warriors coming and going. My business... it's down to less than thirty percent. It's worrying.
To be honest, over at the Market's Skyward District, they built a chamber of commerce based on the Cloud-Mist weapons, and many old neighbors have moved there.
I'm not leaving. In my heart, I feel that making quick money like that isn't the right path.
But in this situation... I don't know how much longer we can hold on.
Right... take care, traveler. If you need anything else, remember to come back and see us.

Ask about anything that catches your eye; as long as you have Flowing Color Stones, we can make a deal!
Leyou is my senior! We have similar personalities; we both love wandering around and collecting good things.
My senior specifically asked me to come help open the new shop so we can save up Flowing Color Stones together.
How do I get Flowing Color Stones?

It is said that many Iridescent Stones are hidden in the secret lair of the River Spirit. Explore and discover to your heart's content!
Take care! Remember to come find me to trade if you pick up any Flowing Color Stones!
Old man, besides Alata's "one person guards one mountain," I often hear people in town mention the Nanhu family.
Oh, that family? They aren't very skilled in martial arts.
What? Poor martial arts? But people say the Nanhu family are the elders of Wulian Town.
Fists and kicks alone won't convince anyone. The true skill of the Nanhu family lies in their mastery of martial arts classics.
Except for that kid Nanhu Zhang... Hmm, I'm an old woman now, how could Ah Zhang still be a kid?
Sigh, when is the Martial Arts Tournament actually starting...
Hmm, the most important thing when you're out there is to keep a steady head! We can definitely do this!
I wonder how things are at the academy... Why hasn't Xiaofei replied to my messages?
Still won't admit defeat? You're pretty good at standing on one leg!
Whoever touches the ground with both feet first is... a Little Saepes!
With people coming and going, there are more and more new faces, but not all of them are friendly... The world is changing.
Everyone's looking down here, what's actually down there?
Master! Please teach me! I came to Mount Guye to learn the supreme martial way!

I heard those Longya, Longya, and Longya people were all... by Minka... sigh!
Shh! Don't talk nonsense! Minka is teaching them a real way to make money; other people are dying to get in!
This, this, if I had known, I would have taken a name like Longya too!
Stay your step, Hero. Are you here to accept the bounty on this board?
There are quite a few people gathered here, I'm just here to take a look. Are you the one who issued this bounty?

To inherit the technique without ever meeting the master...

I'm also at a loss. No one has ever heard of him having any enemies, and he's been missing for twenty years...
You look like a kind soul, and you weren't gossiping about the Ghost-Faced Sword mentioned in the bounty notice like the others. I can tell you're a person of chivalry and kindness.

My friend, drink the wine, do not stop the cup.
The world's top swords are currently evenly matched.
Nothing is as satisfying as the sword under heaven!
It seems you have made a decision.
Some karmic debts must be settled.
Once my sword heart is clear, Li Bai will return the sword.
The day is not far off; I look forward to the Sword Immortal's strike.
Do you not see, the waters of the Yellow River descend from the heavens, rushing to the sea, never to return.
Do you not see, in the high hall, the bright mirror laments the white hair, morning like black silk, evening turned to snow—
One should enjoy life to the fullest, and never let the golden goblet face the moon empty.
With a sword, with wine... how refreshing...
Loyal heart entrusted to the Nine Springs, the will to wield the sword is as firm as a rock.
Swords clash, and their battle spirit is at its peak.
This battle—life or death, no matter.
The divine patterns are in my bones. This final battle is to fulfill my promise, and also... to keep my sword heart from falling.
The divine patterns are in my bones; medicine is of no use.
This final battle is to honor the pact, and also... to keep my sword heart from falling.
My heart remains set on the blade...
Just waiting for the Sword Immortal's strike!
Alata, are you truly determined to do this?
I am willing... consider it you returning that sword strike to me!
Then as you wish... my friend.
A swordsman wields the sword for their heart.
Your sword skills are perfect and you have no equal, so why is your resolve wavering?
I have always kept a sword in my heart, for my dear friend, for Jixia...
Some things are more important than one's own life. In that case, what does it matter if one is destroyed in the process?
And I'm a swordsman. And what I can do is to draw my sword.
The sword in the heart cannot be broken...
Some things are more important than myself... You understand that best!
Li Bai, no need to hold back!
Not enough, not enough, come again!
Not enough, not enough, not enough!
This should be our last duel, no need to hold back.
Alright, then let's give it a try!
The bright moon strikes, a fine sword.
Then let's try this sword again—
The sword rises to the blue sky... and can reach the nine springs!
Life and death are but a moment; let us finish this cup of wine.
The long wind can be crossed.
Part the seas and sever the waves; spilled water can be gathered!
The sword rises with the wind, unbreakable.
What do you think of this strike?
If only I had the Heaven-Leaning Sword—to cross the sea and slay the long whale!
The lone sword is like a wild goose—parting the nine heavens.
What a move to split the heavens!
What do you think of this strike?
If only I had the Heaven-Leaning Sword, to cross the sea and slay the long whale!
A pity—I am a step ahead.
Sword feathers startle the wind—treading on the flying goose!
Light as a startled swan, graceful as a swimming dragon.
Rising with the wind, straight into the Great Wilderness flow. How do you explain this?
Let the long sword fly across!
Long time no see, you have improved a lot.
I am not who I was back then. I wonder—what about you!
The river flows into the great wilderness!
Alata has been waiting in the cave for a long time. The two draw their swords, just as they did back then.
Alata! Li Bai has come to return your sword!
Since you are returning the sword, let's take a look at it first.
The Divine Pattern erosion is intensifying, but Alata still insists on fighting.

Ziya, who was waiting for a reply from Alata, only received a suicide note. Vesper, who was traveling with him, sensed something was wrong with Ziya but could not dissuade him. The masked man's plan continues...
I'm afraid Alata cannot attend the Grand Tutor's invitation.
Mindful of the years of guidance from the Master and the Grand Duke, Alata swears never to betray Jixia in this lifetime, a vow that has not changed in a hundred years.
Now that grace and duty are hard to reconcile, I must forsake grace for duty and use my final strength to protect the peace of Jixia.
Over two hundred years have passed, and the dead are gone. I hope you do not get lost in the miasma, Taigong. Please take care of yourself.
Righteousness is moving, but the living can find peace and let go. The dead can no longer speak, and only the Grand Duke can restore everything for them.
...I know. You don't need to say more.
They... will definitely all return to my side.
You returned because Jixia was unjust, to restore the former glory of the Sanctified. How did it end up like this...
It's you. What are you trying to use my master for?
Isn't this his own wish? I just helped out a little.
Instead of questioning me here, you should worry about yourself. As a disciple, you don't even know his true purpose.
The day he fully merges with the <001>Sanctified</>, when the true Sanctified returns, where will you go then?
My relationship with Master... is not for you to sow discord in! I will keep my eyes on you!
But what can an ant change?
As per Alata's last wishes, Li Bai returned to Wulian Town to handle her funeral arrangements. Meanwhile, you returned to the academy with the Glazed Heart and finally awakened your companions...
I once swore to fight to the death for Jixia alongside my friends. This heart has remained unchanged for a hundred years; today is no different from the past.
——A heart of loyalty entrusted to the afterlife, a heart dedicated to the sword as firm as a rock.
All matters are concluded, and the past has faded away. Now that the birds have returned to their nests, Alata... can finally reunite with old friends.
Loyal heart entrusted to the Nine Springs, the will to wield the sword is as firm as a rock...
To only get these two lines after all these years, you are indeed not skilled in this, but you have fulfilled your promise.
After a century, to reach this end, I suppose I have no regrets in this life.
My friend Li Bai, if you see this letter, it is our farewell.
My end is near, but my mind is made up. My heart still belongs to Jixia, and my life's martial arts collection can be given entirely to Mount Guye.
This life has reached its ultimacy; I have no regrets in death and am ready for eternal rest.
The vow of the sword has been fulfilled. As for the poem I promised you, I've only managed to finish half of it after all these years. I hope you understand.
But my mind is made up.
This heart still belongs to Jixia.
A lifetime of Musashi's skill can be given entirely to Guye.
This life has reached its ultimacy.
I have no regrets even if I die.
The vow of the sword has been fulfilled.
I only got half a poem after all these years.
All matters are concluded, and the past has faded away.
Now that the birds have returned to their nests, Alata... can finally reunite with old friends.
Li Bai hands you the Glazed Heart that Alata left behind, and he will stay on Mount Guye for the time being.
How are you? Master Alata, she...
It seems you were prepared all along.
This was left by Alata. Take it back to the academy.

For a century, she has been using the power of the cloud flow on Mount Guye to provide Suppression against the backlash and erosion of her old wounds, which is the only reason she has barely managed to retain her sanity.
But later... she knew the divine patterns had entered her bones and were beyond saving, so she refined the purest cloud flow energy into her own Glazed Heart, holding on until I arrived.
Until her death, her heart was always for Jixia.
This is her choice, and it is the last thing she can do for Jixia Academy.
I have one more thing to finish. You all go back first. Once it's settled, I'll meet you at the academy.
I'd love to see if Alata shows up after I wreck this stage!
I'll rip your mouths off and fix them for you!
Go on... It's time for a change in management here at Mount Guye!
Since you insist on a sword duel, very well. If you can draw your sword from its scabbard, I'll count it as your win! The 'Heavenly Drunkenness' will be yours!
That was a good strike, but your sword heart remains unsteady.
You have doubts in your heart. Why?
Su Lie died unjustly, and the world is unfair. My sword cannot settle this... Even with a sword in hand, what can I do?
Enough competing, come with me to a place.
Ha! The Great Peng rises with the wind, soaring ninety thousand miles up!
Li Bai has come to seek guidance.
The tower is a hundred feet high, one could pluck...
Keep this up, and things might get out of hand.
How big? Could it be bigger than the attack on Jixia?
There are many people from the academy here, be careful not to get beaten up.
Is that guy Hu Wanli even reliable?
Alright, let's get a few words out before the Aerwatch shows up.
I knew those rats at Enlightenment Studio were up to no good!
Not investigating the murderer, but instead managing the sale of illegal weapons here?
Is there no sense of reason left!
No clues to reveal their identity...
When is the next one leaving? Can you give me a straight answer?
There weren't this many troubles in previous years!
Someone else was attacked, and it was someone from the Tianguang Workshop!
You should be careful when going out lately...
The Mount Guye sky is about to witness a change!
Li Bai once came to Mount Guye. At that time, he was lost and confused because of his close friend Su Lie...
Once we enter the mountains, we'll be close to where she lives in seclusion. Wulian Town has changed quite a bit over the years.
By the way, what did you come here for last time?
It was for a pot of wine. I heard from the Master that wine is the best way to dispel sorrow, and at that time... my heart was lost.
I thought the world's greatest sword immortal never felt lost.
As long as one is human, there will be unsolvable worries and dilemmas...
What happened to you back then?
What happened to you back then?
At that time, I was in a deep slump due to the events at Suiyue City and my dear friend Su Lie...
That... General Su, who was rumored to have been framed for treason during the border market riots, and for whom you drew your sword and broke into the Daming Palace?
Right, he and I parted ways in Chang'an, and then...
In previous Martial Arts Tournaments, Master Alata would announce the opening from below, and then—
A grandmaster? Suppressing a mountain with a single sword? Bah!
Why is it from Tianguang Workshop again!

A group of people from the Tianguang Workshop are causing trouble. Citing recent attacks on Mount Guye, they are publicly questioning the mountain's Grandmaster, Alata, and threatening to disrupt the Martial Arts Tournament.
What, our people from the Tian-Guang Workshop were hurt and our goods smashed, and we can't even come to demand an explanation?
Every debt has a debtor, every wrong has a perpetrator—what are you shouting about here!
If the town can't provide investigation results, then we have no choice but to come to this Martial Arts Tournament and ask the person in charge!
The tournament is about to begin, where is Alata?
What are you arguing about here!
A girl from the Cloud-Casting Lodge... and a student from Jixia? Tsk, this is no place for kids, mind your own business.
You're causing trouble here and disrupting the order of the assembly; what right do you have to refuse to be handled!
What, isn't Mount Guye chaotic enough as it is?
People have been getting attacked in town for days now. Why hasn't Grandmaster Alata, who supposedly guards the mountain single-handedly, come forward to address this?
Master Alata has her own reasons for what she does. It's not your place to criticize her!
She has her own reasons... I think as a Grandmaster, she simply doesn't care whether we little people live or die!
Jixia Academy has been attacked, travel to Mount Guye is restricted, everyone in Wulian Town is living in fear, and the Martial Arts Tournament is in chaos...
If Alata won't handle it, the Tian-Guang Workshop will! I think this Mount Guye... is due for a change!

The people brought by Tianguang Workshop started fighting with the crowd at the arena, and you and Minka were forced to join the fray. In the chaos, a bamboo stalk flew out and repelled everyone. The Sword Immortal Li Bai has appeared.
You all might as well wait a little longer.
The time has not yet come.

Li Bai appeared and stabilized the situation. Old Zhang, the representative of Wulian Town, explained the situation of the Martial Arts Tournament to the people. The people from Tianguang Workshop left while grumbling.
This martial arts grand event only happens once every few years, it wouldn't look good if things got rowdy. I hope you all can do me a favor and stay calm.
If you don't wish to wait, would you like to have a chat with my sword instead?
Azure Lotus Sword... Li Bai, the Sword Immortal Li Bai!
What Elder Zhang is about to say should help answer your questions. Why not listen first before discussing anything else?

Thank you all for coming from afar. The preparations for the conference are not yet complete, and the specific date for the opening ceremony will be notified separately. We ask for your understanding.

As for the recent injury incidents, the town will definitely investigate thoroughly and give everyone an explanation. If you have any inconvenience while staying in the town, we will help you solve it.
When it comes down to it, it's just an excuse for Alata not to show up! Old man, it's not that easy to fool us...
Wait if you want, I'm done! Tianguang Workshop has its own ways of finding the truth!
Sword Immortal! Have you returned to participate in the Martial Arts Tournament? I... I have always admired you so much—
There have been frequent attacks lately... With the Sword Immortal here, the culprit surely won't dare to strike again!
I don't know where Grandmaster Alata has gone lately, but thank goodness you're back! You must help the town!
Rest assured, everyone. Now that I, Li Bai, am aware of this, I will not stand idly by.

Then I thank the Sword Immortal on everyone's behalf. However, I ask that you all take care of your safety in the coming days and do not venture deep into the mountains. If there are any developments, I will notify you immediately.
Minka introduced your intentions to the people in the town. Li Bai claimed to be helping on behalf of Zhuge Liang and intends to take you and Minka directly to Alata's residence to find the medicine.
So Senior Zhuge didn't just find me as a guide; he even sought out the Sword Immortal Li Bai...
This matter is of great importance, and Zhuge Liang has to stay at the academy, unable to get away. That's why he came to me to help him keep an eye on things.

Furthermore, the Master once guided me through my confusion, and to me, his kindness is as heavy as a mountain. Now that something has happened to him, and I am here at Jixia, how can I stand idly by?
Yeah, even the Master himself was severely injured. It's up to us to get the academy back on its feet!
Right, so contributing to Jixia Academy is also something I must do for him... It is my duty.
Let's go. Since we're looking for Alata to find medicine, I'll take you directly to her mountain dwelling.
Uncle, he is a representative from Jixia Academy. To resolve the Cloud Silkworm issue as soon as possible, he has come specifically to visit Master Alata and seek a secret medicine.
Uncle, she is a representative from Jixia Academy. To resolve the Cloud Silkworm issue as soon as possible, she has come specifically to visit Master Alata and seek a secret medicine.
Thank you for coming all this way. So much has happened in town lately that we can't spare anyone to reinforce the academy. It's just... sigh.
And as for Master Alata... the town has sent people to visit many times in the past few days, but we have never been able to see her. I wonder if the Sword Immortal knows where the Master has gone?
I only just arrived at Mount Guye myself and haven't met Alata yet. However, we have an appointment, and she is a woman of her word; she will not break it.
It's just that the academy's crisis is imminent, and I have been entrusted to take them to find Alata for medicine first.
After helping the academy find the secret medicine, I will discuss the town's attack with her. In any case, I will definitely help get to the bottom of this.
We are deeply grateful that the Sword Immortal cares for Wulian Town and has stepped forward to help stabilize the people. The town will also step up the investigation.
Although these are extraordinary times and both Mount Guye and the Academy are unsettled, I hope your trip is worthwhile regardless.
You meet Minka, who is dealing with a dispute. As a local guide, she plans to take you to the Martial Arts Tournament in Wulian Town to find Alata for medicine.
Sister, everything is ready for the investigation. Can I go handle the academy matters now?
Thank you for coming all the way from the Academy. Please forgive Minka if there has been any lack of hospitality.
How are you feeling now? I was a bit worried when I heard the senior was sending you here. We might have to run around quite a bit over the next few days...
I'm fine, but my teammates are still unconscious...
I'm fine, but my teammates are still unconscious...
Ever since the incident at the academy, we all wanted to help, so I took the task the moment I heard about it.
Our <001> Zhuyun Pavilion</> has some connections on Mount Guye, and I know quite a few people. I will definitely help you get the secret medicine, so don't carry everything on your own shoulders.
Don't be so polite, just show the same spirit you had when you fought our team in the match!
Master Alata is a recluse, so it's not easy to find her at ordinary times, but the <001> Martial Arts Contest </> is coming up, which is a great opportunity. Come with me!
Why hide it? The movement records of Zhuyun Cottage for the last three days are all here. Is your business really that shameful?
Don't worry, I've got him covered. Come on, let's go.
Don't worry, I've got her covered. Come on, let's go.
Are you saying that I can find clues about the secret medicine at the Martial Arts Tournament?
Are you saying that I can find clues about the secret medicine at the Martial Arts Tournament?
Correct! Master Alata will attend the opening ceremony, which is the perfect chance to ask her for medicine.
Things have been a real mess around here lately, with several incidents of people getting hurt.
We're just waiting for her to show up and keep all these factions in check... Let's hope there are no more complications!
They say the Sword Immortal Li Bai is elegant and detached from the world, but he seems more like a local than I am.
I've spent a long time here before, so I naturally got familiar with it.
It's much livelier around here than before. Oh? These old chess tables are still here.
I don't know where the person Senior Zhuge arranged from Chang'an is.
I don't know where the person Senior Zhuge arranged from Chang'an is.
You board the cloud ship and head to Mount Guye.

Famous across the continent for the art of tempering the body through cloud-flow forging.
With heroes from all sides gathering and complex factions, it has quite the martial arts atmosphere.
Jixia is in turmoil now, hearts are treacherous, and there will surely be no shortage of schemes in the shadows.
I only hope we can discern the situation, work together, and ultimately achieve our goal.
Northwest of Jixia, the Mount Guye range, where the people value martial arts.
The town needs to give us an explanation!

You have arrived at the deepest part of Aerux Hollow. Master Alata is inside, but a powerful Divine Rune force blocks the way. Li Bai asks you to stay here while he goes to meet his old friend alone; he will certainly get to the bottom of the secret medicine matter.
Such powerful Divine Rune energy is surging out...
Such powerful Divine Rune energy is surging out...
Ah, no way, I can't get close at all.
Alata... You are still as inhospitable as ever.
What do we do now? Just barge in?
No, I can go alone. Jixia will still need you in the future; there's no need to risk your lives here.
This is a bit of a presumptuous request, but if Alata's body and mind have already been eroded, I believe she would not wish to be seen by the world.
It has come to this; between her and me, there must be an end... I hope for your understanding.
I will get to the bottom of this secret medicine business.
Why is it... so strange in here?
There are traces of Divine Pattern erosion everywhere.
There are traces of Divine Pattern erosion everywhere.

Then I'll leave it to you.

The Divine Pattern erosion is affecting the ecosystem and endangering the survival of the wood fence.
Aerux Hollow was meant to be the home of the Little Saepes...
Aerux Hollow was meant to be the home of the Little Saepes...
I heard this is Muli's hometown. It's my first time here,
