But now... let's go, this is the final leg of the journey.
Come, let me experience that legendary sword strike that once illuminated the Daming Palace!
Drunkenness fades, sword intent surges, ha—
A swordsman wields the sword for their heart.
Your sword skills are perfect and you have no equal, so why is your resolve wavering?
The Green Lotus Sword is rumored to be peerless in the world, but it should be more than just this. Come again!
Not yet satisfied, come, let us test our blades again!
Do you not see... the waters of the Yellow River descend from the heavens!
Fine poem. Now, sword, let's try again!
The river flows into the great wilderness!
The sword gleam is scorching, yet it has form without heart. Come again!

Hu Wanli returned to report to the Master of the Tianguang Workshop. After reading the secret letter, the Master stated that this letter was enough to convict Alata, and they should prepare to properly "welcome" Li Bai and his group.
So... was it really Alata who hurt someone?
It's fine, you did a good job with this errand. This thin sheet of paper is enough to convict Alata.
Who on Mount Guye could have guessed—that the person Alata went to see was actually him...
Hmm... it was supposed to be a great time for the Workshop Master to collect legendary weapons, with the Master missing and Alata in chaos, but then Li Bai had to show up. What bad luck.
When the Sword Immortal strikes, who can stop him? It's fine, we'll follow his lead.
With this letter in hand, we can certainly challenge him. Make the arrangements; let's give them a proper "welcome".
Sometimes, the human heart is sharper than a sword.
I, I only saw a flash of sword light, and then my brothers all fell. There is truly no other proof... and I failed to bring back the Zaiyuan Sword. Please forgive me, Workshop Master!
...There's some residual flow here. I'll see if I can replicate it.
...There's some residual flow here. I'll see if I can replicate it.
It seems Zhuge Liang was right; your control over the flow will be a key asset on this journey.
If we can replicate it, we'll have even more clues...

The flow on the Abyss Sword is wild and perverse, unlike what Li Bai remembers. You notice that the environment in Wiltspring Cave has changed significantly, and the jars that originally held the Aerux secret medicine are empty...
Why is the flow on the Abyss Sword so wild and perverse... it's completely different from what I remember.
The Abyss Sword... it was the world's premier Cloud-Severing weapon, but in this state, I can barely recognize it.
Is this a problem with the sword, or... a problem with the person?
The Abyss Sword cannot be left here like this. I'll take it for now.
A swordsman should never be without their sword... She abandoned it, there must be a hidden reason.
What on earth happened in this Wiltspring Cave... to make it end up like this?
This place was once lush with water and grass, and the clouds flowed thick. I once joked with Alata that such a scenic spot hardly suited the name Wiltspring Cave.
This giant tree has been growing for over a hundred years, with cloud flows circling its branches and leaves in a constant cycle of life...
Now, it has become a piece of rotten wood. What a pity.
Looking at the texture of this Aerux... it should have produced high-grade essence, but it's all dried up now.
I remember that Alata used the Aerux essence from this place to brew a secret medicine to treat old wounds.
But now... the Aerux is exhausted, what about that secret medicine?
But now... the Aerux is exhausted, what about that secret medicine?
As for whether there are any other secret medicines left, I can only ask Alata.
Where on earth did Master Alata go...
There's a path there. Let's go check it out.
There's a path there. Let's go check it out.
It doesn't matter, it won't affect me for a while.

After subduing Hu Wanli, he regained some of his senses and evasively claimed that he had been attacked by Alata, and that her Sword of the Abyss was an evil blade. Before you could finish questioning him, Hu Wanli fled in the chaos, leaving you to focus your attention on the Sword of the Abyss.
I... where am I? My head hurts so much...
How is the Abyss Sword in your hands? Speak!
Fine, fine, I'll talk... Because many brothers from the Tian-Guang Workshop have been attacked recently, the Workshop Master sent us to see Alata to demand an explanation...
Who would have thought, I just came in and hadn't even had a chance to speak before she attacked me...
Open your eyes and look carefully! Where is there any sign of Master Alata here? Trying to frame me, are you!
Could this sword wound be fake? By the time I managed to crawl up, she was long gone, leaving only this sword on the ground...
Alata hurt someone for no reason, and her sword is corrupting minds. I'm going to report this to the Workshop Master right now. This isn't over!
Don't chase him. He's being evasive and isn't trustworthy.
True. We might as well ask Master Alata directly... Is Master Alata here? Li Bai and Minka from the Casting Cloud Pavilion request an audience!
She is not here, otherwise she wouldn't have stood by and watched Hu Wanli wreak havoc in Wiltspring Cave.
What on earth happened... they didn't even take their sword?
There's... a very strange flow on the sword. I'll go take a look.
There's... a very strange flow on the sword. I'll go take a look.
That sword... there's something wrong with that sword!
I wanted to borrow it for a try, but I lost my senses the moment I touched it! This sword, this sword must be problematic!
What's going on? Is he really that strong?
Subdue him first, then we'll get the truth.
Li Bai... Li Bai! I won't let you get away with this!
With the Zaiyuan Sword... none of you are a match for me!
This power... why does it feel somewhat similar to the Divine Runes?
This power... why does it feel somewhat similar to the Divine Runes?
You and Minka were still fascinated by the duel between Li Bai and Alata when a burst of shouting and fighting came from Wiltspring Cave.
The sword, naturally, has been retrieved.
That is exactly why I have an appointment with her. When I return to Mount Guye, we shall spar again to repay the favor.
Wiltspring Cave... let's go check it out!
As for what happened later... wait until we see Alata, and she can tell you herself.
Wow, a duel between the Qinglian Sword and the Zaiyuan Sword. Just thinking about it is exciting. Can we also... hmm?
Hu Wanli! The bounty hunter who caused trouble earlier!
Why is Alata's sword with you?
It's you... Li Bai, you've come at the right time. I'm going to wash away my shame!
There are sword-energy cloud currents here; they should give us a boost.
Mount Guye has plenty more wonders and treasures like this!
Indeed, the scenery of Mount Guye is unique. Once things are settled, I can take you around.
Exactly, I'll take you for a good tour when the time comes!
Bounty hunters... they've all passed out.
Bounty hunters... they've all passed out.
Sword wounds on the back, messy footprints... they were trying to escape this place.
Whoever dares to block my path—dies!
Look here... there's writing carved on the bamboo slip.
Let's go, Wiltspring Cave is just past that stone tablet.
Causing trouble here... you're really blind.
Why are people from Tianguang Workshop here?
Why are people from Tianguang Workshop here?
Brothers, let's fight them to the end.
Boss, we're no match for them!
Don't fight... Stop fighting! Alata hasn't shown up yet, we're just here to take a look!
We're leaving right now, we're leaving, okay!
If we catch you again... just you wait!
Let's go, Wiltspring Cave is just past that stone tablet.
The ink is still wet; the Master must have left not long ago.
The ink is still wet; the Master must have left not long ago.
Are we just a step behind? Or did we arrive too late...
The place where the Master lived... so many sword marks.
So chaotic; the sword-bearer's mind is troubled.
These jars are all empty too.
These jars are all empty too.
The Aerux essence has dried up; there will be no more secret medicine here.
Alata receives a secret letter. After reading it, her expression is complex, but after a moment of hesitation, she decides to keep the appointment mentioned in the letter.
The grace of adoption and rebirth, Alata would never dare forget... Since you wrote to invite me, I shall attend.
If you still cherish old memories, then why that day... did you not cherish an old friend!
Even if the past cannot be admonished, can the future... truly be pursued?
It's just that things have changed... time is running out.
He is almost at Mount Guye. I should... go keep my appointment.
The Abyss Sword... leave it here for now to prevent it from causing further chaos. This should hold things over for a few more days.

After some discussion, you concluded that finding the secret letter would allow you to locate Master Alata. The letter is most likely at the Tianguang Workshop's lair—the Market. You decided to split up: Li Bai will go scout for information, and you will meet Minka at the Market.
She doesn't look like she's in a good state.
She doesn't look like she's in a good state.
She has an old injury. Could it be acting up again... We need to find her as soon as possible.
As the afterimage showed, Alata must have gone to keep an appointment. The letter should contain the time and place.
Nothing here... The letter isn't here, the trail has gone cold.
Could it be Hu Wanli and his group from the Sky Light Workshop?
Could it be Hu Wanli and his group from the Sky Light Workshop?
The ones who arrived at Wiltspring Cave before us...
It's that bunch from the Tianguang Workshop.
It's that bunch from the Tianguang Workshop.
They are indeed the most suspicious... It looks like we need to take a trip to the market.
Let me think... how about we split up? Li Bai is too famous, and tall trees catch the wind. It won't be convenient for us to move around the market together.
The two of us will go scout it out first. If the letter is truly in the hands of Tianguang Workshop, I'll call you then.
I grew up around weapons, after all. I know a thing or two about how things work in the martial world.
I'll go scout the way first. You get some rest, wait for my news, and we'll meet at the market!
...Alata, who is it that you are going to meet?
A market hidden in the bamboo sea in the mountains, and also the lair of the Sky-Light Workshop. As long as you have money, you can buy any contraband there.
The Sky-Light Workshop has been entrenched in the ruins for years, raising assassins, forging evil weapons, and engaging in smuggling. They've used this to extend their reach further and further.
Yeah, I heard they've even started appearing in the Chang'an Ghost Market now. Not to be underestimated.
Tianguang Workshop has the advantage of home ground. If we want to get back Master Alata's letter, I'm afraid we really can't just rush in like that.
Then I can go and scout for traces of Alata... but the market is a den of tigers and dragons, will you two be alright?
You see the stone tablet engraved with "The World... One Sword." Minka asks about the story after the day of the drunken revelry, and Li Bai tells it all.
World... One Sword. Why is a character missing?
World... One Sword. Why is a character missing?
This is a masterpiece by the Sword Immortal, right?
I was indeed drunk that day, and a bit too reckless after the wine. Later... I consulted with Alata, and we removed the 'Di' character.
We did have a sword duel later. As for the winner, it was decided by a single strike.
One sword? You won with just one sword?
They say there's no first in literature and no second in martial arts. Actually, I don't think there's any need to change that! So, what happened next?
The Azure Lotus Sword is famous across the four seas, and the Zaiyuan Sword has guarded the mountain for a century; have the two never settled who is superior?
Before the Wiltspring Cave that day, my sword was not fast enough.

After the recollection, Minka mentioned that the current Li Bai is different from his legendary image, appearing more composed. Li Bai replied: After years of wandering the world with my sword, my state of mind has naturally changed.
So that's how you first met... You were doodling on someone's doorstep; it's a wonder Master Alata was willing to spar with you calmly at all.
So, how did you two become such close friends later on?
So, how did you two become such close friends later on?
She is not annoyed by this, but because she is true to her nature, she only spars with those who have a sword in their heart.
A sword is either in its scabbard or on the anvil. What does it mean to have a sword in one's heart...
It's hard to put into words, let's just call it... a feeling.
Speaking of feelings... I feel like you are a bit, how should I put it, different from the legendary Green Lotus Sword Immortal.
Hmm... the blade of grass you usually have in your mouth is gone! And you're acting so calm and collected—nothing like the wild, unrestrained Sword Immortal from the legends.
After years of walking the world with a sword, one's state of mind naturally changes. As for the rumors and legends, I'm still a step behind.
Besides, this mission is a matter of life and death; I cannot afford to be careless and ruin things.
Alright, Wiltspring Cave is just ahead. Keep up!
How much longer do we have to wait here?
It's so cramped, a bigger guy might not even be able to squeeze through...
Wait a second, let them pass first.
Wait a second, let them pass first.
The fog is getting thicker, have you noticed?
Seems like... there's still a very strong current nearby.
Seems like... there's still a very strong current nearby.
The exit... is on the other side? How are we supposed to cross this huge pool of toxic wastewater...
Perfect! Let's go, we can jump onto the pipe opening across from us!
But be careful, if you get this water on you, you'll lose a layer of skin—!!!
Finally, a chance to warm up... Ah, take it easy, don't make too much of a scene!
Is this dump even worth sending someone to repair...

Judging by the direction of the pipes, is the mechanism connected to a waterwheel? This makes it convenient to drain the accumulated wastewater during the weapon forging process... and it can also be manually controlled by Mechcraft.
The design is quite clever... but why is the turntable control Mechcraft still this old structure? The machine is old enough to be my grandfather.
Minka? Which way should we go?
Minka? Which way should we go?
Huh? Oh, sorry, I got lost in thought.
I see. As long as I use the turntable Mechcraft to move the waterwheel under the flow, the door will open.
I'll clear the rubble off the Mechcraft, can you open it at the same time?
……The first eleven swords have found their owners. You all have a keen eye for talent!
I shall reveal the final, grandest item...
Let's first give a round of applause for our special guest—
The Mechcraft mechanism here is back in place!
The Mechcraft mechanism here is back in place!
Once you've put everything away, get to patrolling!
It has been a century since we last met. Now that I have returned, I have gained something.
It has been a century since we last met. Now that I have returned, I have gained something.
Let's meet at the old spot to discuss <001>Sanctified Revival</>.
Let's meet at the old spot to discuss <001>Sanctified Revival</>.
Minka is preparing to take you to the restaurant where you agreed to meet the intelligence broker.
This is the lair of the Tianguang Workshop.
Divine weapons, artifacts, elixirs... even hired hands and all sorts of services.
It is said that as long as you have enough money, you can find things here that even Jixia and Chang'an cannot buy.
The auction is being held at that restaurant. The information broker I arranged to meet is there too, so let's head over directly.
You found the underground storage room disguised as a wine cellar and plan to break in directly with Minka.
How is it? Did you find the place?
I followed them to a wine cellar. Their people were going in and out, so that must be the warehouse where they keep the treasures.
I followed them to a wine cellar. Their people were going in and out, so that must be the warehouse where they keep the treasures.
I've already contacted <001> Li Bai </>. Let's check near the cellar you mentioned first, then meet up with him after we get the letter.
But how do we get down? They've tightened security, and it's not convenient to make too much noise...
But how do we get down? They've tightened security, and it's not convenient to make too much noise...
As long as we don't let them make a sound, it won't attract anyone's attention!
Let's work together. You go up first and <001>quietly</> strike up a conversation to distract them. I'll <001>quietly</> knock them out, and then we'll <001>quietly</> head down.
Alright, that's one way to do it.
Alright, that's one way to do it.
Secret or no secret, you're acting all mysterious...
Move it! Don't forget what the boss told us!
A cargo rail? Is this what they use to transport goods?
It's about to move, come quick, come quick!
By the way, don't you think our journey has been quite smooth so far?
Yeah... the water rising just in time, the empty guard room, it all went too smoothly...
Yeah... the water rising just in time, the empty guard room, it all went too smoothly...
Could it be that they knew we were coming, got scared, and fled?
Hmm, that shouldn't be the reason. Never mind, let's just be careful!
Such an important place should be heavily guarded, why is there no one here?
Such an important place should be heavily guarded, why is there no one here?
Forget it, never mind for now. Finding the letter is more important, let's keep moving forward!
Ahead... uh, is the door sealed?
These bastards... they'd probably hollow out all of Mount Guye to use as their own backyard if they could!
I hear something up ahead! Let's go check it out.
I found the storeroom, but I can't get in... If we force our way in, the patrolling guards might go up and report it.
Need to find another way in...
Need to find another way in...
How about we just keep walking inside and see? If it really doesn't work, then...
Alright, so you know me that well now.
Judging by the large furnace in the middle and the scattered tools, this must be an abandoned workshop of the Heavenlight Workshop... Ah, found it!
These abandoned pipes connect with the mountain fissures. Maybe we can find a way to get behind the warehouse and figure out how to get in.
The storeroom is right in front of us. There must be a way in. Let's go find a path.
The storeroom is right in front of us. There must be a way in. Let's go find a path.
Raise the hammer and break in!
Raise the hammer and break in!
Why is no one here? Were they all reassigned to patrol outside?
Why is no one here? Were they all reassigned to patrol outside?
I don't know... Is that a cargo pipe ahead? Let's go this way.
Minka? She must be here for the auction... Call the brothers over!
Don't make a move! These two are Li Bai's people.
Seems like they're going to Shisanlang's room...
That person is stirring up trouble again, as expected. I'll go report this!
Look at the mess the Tianguang Workshop has made!
I'll handle this, you guys go!
Li Bai, you've come just in time!

Longxi, Old Zhang, and others arrived at the market to get to the bottom of the Alata incident. Li Bai stood against the crowd, staking her own reputation and the Qinglian Sword on Alata—she is pure of heart and will never change. Afterward, Li Bai wants to take you somewhere; once there, you will understand Alata's past.
Then I'm afraid we must ask the Sword Immortal to explain this matter to us clearly.
Sword Immortal... is what you say true? Alata and that Ziya...
Sis... why are you here too?

A letter came from Tianguang Workshop regarding a major matter involving the entire Mount Guye. As a master craftsman, I naturally had to come and see, but I didn't expect... it would be related to Master Alata.
Ziya's intrusion into Jixia has caused a stir known to all. If Master Alata were to defect... I fear the people of Mount Guye—no, of Jixia—will be plunged into misery in an instant.
Sword Immortal, did Master Alata really... collude with Ziya and betray Jixia?
The Sword Immortal is so convinced; I suppose he only says so because of his deep relationship with Master Alata, but...
There is no 'just'—this is my answer.
This matter is full of doubts. The so-called secret letter and the Sword in the Abyss can only serve as circumstantial evidence. Alata has not appeared, so it is impossible to verify anything.
But I know her character well; she would never do such a thing. So, I will definitely uncover the truth and clear her name.
What you say makes sense, and we find it hard to believe that Master Alata would act this way.

Master Alata... has guarded Mount Guye for a century, protecting all living things, teaching martial arts, and passing down classics. It is the great fortune of Mount Guye, and we have never forgotten these kindnesses.
But this matter has far-reaching consequences... I implore the Sword Immortal to investigate it thoroughly, for the sake of Mount Guye and Master Alata...
I understand. I know the worries in your hearts, so...
Li Bai of Suiyue City, I pledge my Green Lotus Sword as a guarantee for Alata—her heart is pure and loyal, and will never change.
And regardless of what the truth is, once I have investigated it, I will announce it to everyone.
This is my wish. Please keep the Green Lotus Sword for me for a while, Elder Zhang.
Let's go, follow me to a place. According to the letter, Alata should be there.
Yes, but Alata has her own persistence and hidden troubles. You will understand everything about the past once you arrive.
And you all should know better than anyone how Alata truly treats Mount Guye. Would she really abandon Mount Guye?
If there is a misjudgment... I, Li Bai, will bear the consequences alone.
Stay... all of you, must stay.
Are those the dark guards from the Tianguang Workshop?
……He is not easy to deal with, be careful.
I can hold on, you be careful too!
(grunts while being dragged into nightmare) *breath efforts*
Ouch, ouch, ouch... Phew, I'm fine. Let's keep moving.
Not that way, go above, follow me!
If I just smash it on there, won't it collapse...
Still need to solve the Mechcraft puzzle...
They seem to be wary of us...
They seem to be wary of us...
I've made a spectacle of myself before you two.
Go back and think about it. Show them out.
It's truly pitiful to beg for medicine for your sister, but the price isn't enough.
Oh? You have quite a sharp eye.
Watch for my signal when the time comes. Let's go, let's go in and meet him.
By the way, this must be your first time in a place like this, so let me give you a few words of advice before we go in.

A gray market like the Bazaar is a mixed bag where people have no trust in each other. It's common for people to attack at the slightest disagreement. The person we are meeting later is a dangerous, cutthroat character.
He looks as plain as a loach, but he's actually incredibly slick and well-connected. He's in league with many factions, and there's a lot of intelligence only he can get his hands on.
Finding that letter is our priority right now, so let's try to keep our tempers in check... Alright, I'll try to keep mine in check. In any case, it's best not to fall out with him!
What's going on? Someone's rushing out!
Something happened at the Feast of Rare Treasures?
Bounty hunter... What is the bounty hunter trying to do!
Li Bai, is that Li Bai?
Hide quickly, let them make a scene...
It's a mess, a total mess!
Get your tokens ready, and don't drag your feet!
Don't worry about it, just focus on your own business.
Whew... they shouldn't be able to catch up now.
Good thing Li Bai arrived in time...
Good thing Li Bai arrived in time...
Come on, let's wait for him outside. The exit is at...
After quietly knocking out the guard, you enter the underground.
Wait, wait, wait. This is our private wine cellar; no outsiders allowed.
The time for the Feast of Rare Treasures has changed...
The Workshop Master ordered us to inform everyone. What, didn't Shisanglang tell you?
The Workshop Master ordered us to inform everyone. What, didn't Shisanglang tell you?
I'm just here to pick up the goods.
It's a deal that was just made. Strange, didn't Shisanlang tell you?
It's a deal that was just made. Strange, didn't Shisanlang tell you?
Hmm? You look a bit familiar. Don't move! Come any closer and we'll call for help!
I've been wanting to get tough with them for a long time!
Come on, let's head down before the next shift arrives.
Continue keeping a close eye on the Sword Immortal's movements.
I've turned down all subsequent guests; I have other arrangements.
Taking these backroads is a hassle, but at least there's no Safeguard here.
Feels easier than sneaking into the Forbidden Chamber before.
Feels easier than sneaking into the Forbidden Chamber before.
I've heard of that! Back when you and Novar—ah!
It's okay, we're about to get the letter, and we're not far from finding the secret medicine to cure them.
Hmm, I hope everything goes smoothly from here.
Hmm, I hope everything goes smoothly from here.
How about we knock out the Guard and go straight down?
Wouldn't that make too much noise?
Wouldn't that make too much noise?
Then, you <001>sneak</> up and start a conversation, I'll <001>sneak</> in and knock them out, and then we'll <001>sneak</> down?
Alright, that's one way to do it.
Alright, that's one way to do it.
Let's find a hidden spot to track Shisanlang with the Emerald Cicada first.
Let's find a hidden spot to track Shisanlang with the Emerald Cicada first.

Minka discusses the next step of the plan with you. She will attract the attention of the Tianguang Workshop at the restaurant, while you are responsible for controlling the flying Mechcraft in the shadows to track Shisanlang and find the location of the secret letter.
They're really asking for the moon! If they didn't have the item, I'd call Li Bai and the three of us would wipe out the market entirely.
Were you bluffing them just now?
I'm not buying it! But since I said that just now, he'll definitely go back to report it.
So, we have a chance to find the location of the letter?
So, we have a chance to find the location of the letter?
That's right, the Tian-Guang Workshop must have a <001>secret warehouse</> in the market. Let's see where Shisan-lang goes to report back; the letter might be there.
Let's sneak in directly, grab the letter, and run!
You say this is Tianguang Workshop territory, so there are likely people watching us nearby.
You say this is Tianguang Workshop territory, so there are likely people watching us nearby.
So I prepared this—a scouting Mechcraft I picked up earlier, the <001>Jade Damselfly</>. It can fly in the air to scout targets.
I'll pretend to contact Li Bai in a moment to intentionally draw their attention. You hide in the corner and use this to track Shisanlang to see where he goes.
Alright, let's meet up later then.
Alright, let's meet up later then.
You aren't actually planning to buy it, are you?
The path ends here. We're going up!
The information broker Shisanlang made an offer to you and Minka; to get that secret letter, you must trade it for Alata's In-Abyss Sword. Minka agreed to his terms immediately.
Let me introduce you: Shisanlang, an intelligence broker who knows everything in the market. And as for the one beside me... your intel should have arrived by now, right?
After all, not just anyone can represent Jixia Academy to visit Mount Guye, travel with a Sword Immortal, and stir up half the town. One must naturally keep a close eye on such a person.
For you two to lower yourselves to visit a small merchant like me, you must be looking for something, right?
Let me get straight to the point. The people from the Sky-Light Workshop broke into the Wiltspring Cave and took <001> Letter </>. We want the whereabouts and intelligence regarding that letter.

This is tricky. This letter is a major auction item at tonight's Grand Treasures Banquet, and the Workshop Master has personally inquired about it. I can't just sell the intelligence to others on my own.
What if Jixia Academy and the Cloud-Casting Hut come to ask?
Since the Young Master sincerely wants it, why don't I act as a middleman and bridge the gap? How about the two of you make an offer to buy this letter directly?
Are you setting a price for stolen goods?
You certainly know how to make money...

After all, this is a secret letter from Master Alata, which is incredibly precious. Actually, you two aren't the only ones who came to ask me for the price... it's just that the price from Tian-Guang Pavilion happens to be something you can afford.
Oh? Are you asking for divine weapons or treasures in exchange again?
Alata's letter must be exchanged for her sword.
The Abyss Sword... just an old sword. What's so special about it? We have several better ones at the Zhuyun Cottage.
No, it must be that Zaiyuan Sword.
By the way, my family has been forging weapons for generations, so I know a thing or two about them. Could you pass a suggestion to your workshop master for me?
Everyone is eyeing tonight's auction. If you want to snatch it away, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to call it stealing from the tiger's mouth, right?
I'm afraid there isn't much time left for you two to consider.
It's okay, no need to think about it anymore, let's do it.
But, I wonder if the chivalrous Sword Immortal would agree to give up an old friend's sword?
You don't need to worry, my word is final on this!
The price is negotiable, but we can't break the rule of inspecting the goods before the trade, can we?
After all, only the people at Tian-Guang Pavilion handled that letter. If I paid such a high price for a forged one, it would be quite lacking in 'sincerity'.
Sword in one hand, letter in the other, right here in this private room. How about it?
Young Master is truly a straightforward person. Once you bring the Zaiyuan Sword, shall I take you personally to collect the letter and inspect the goods?
It's a deal. Let's go, we need to contact Li Bai.
Not just anyone can wield certain swords. You'd best be careful—if your virtue doesn't match your station, the divine weapon may turn on its master.
But those of us in this line of work walk the world relying on our courage, don't we...
You two, I won't see you out.
I told you not to meddle, so don't!
Did you forget what the boss told us!
Go on patrol, all of you.
Do your own job and don't meddle in other people's business.
Anyway, I've got the letter. Let's go meet up with Li Bai first!
Don't alert the enemy, go around the back.
Can't get through this way... have to go around.
Can't get through this way... have to go around.
As I thought... Minka's words have put them on guard.
As I thought... Minka's words have put them on guard.
Don't be careless, that letter is enough to cost you all your lives.
What on earth was written in that letter to make them take it so seriously...
What on earth was written in that letter to make them take it so seriously...
The warehouse the Workshop Master specifically mentioned has already been—
She actually contacted Li Bai? That's fine.
Should I arrange for more people to go down and patrol?
Tell the brothers to watch their backs when changing shifts, and don't let anyone spot them.
Go on, and keep safe that <001> secret that could overturn all of Mount Guye </>.
Hu Wanli really got off easy! What's his deal, anyway?
I heard they came from Chang'an...
There used to be a prestigious job!
Aren't you just a lackey for the workshop master now!
Many businesses before were aimed at Alata, if this were to...
Then I see that Mount Guye is truly about to change!
The town is chaotic these days; who knows which way the wind is blowing.
That's not the price we agreed on last time!
This is all I could get. No room for negotiation.
This is the weapon your workshop master specifically requested. Whether you buy it or not is up to you.
What a big setup today! What kind of treasure are they selling?
It is said that thing could overturn the order of Mount Guye...
So mysterious? Could it be something from Alata?
No, is that young master of the Casting Cloud Pavilion sick in the head?
She's circled five times already, what on earth is she doing...
Come over and keep an eye on things, that girl went to contact Li Bai!

You and Minka headed up and arrived at the auction. Thirteen used the Zaiyuan Sword as a pretext to press the issue, spreading the theory that the chaos at Mount Guye was related to Master Alata. Minka, disgusted, left with you.
Welcome, Young Master of the Cloud-Forging Hut, and the rising star of Jixia Academy—
What's going on, Shisanlang? What are you trying to do?
No need to be nervous, you two. I just need a small, trivial favor from you.
I dare to ask you both to witness... the strongest and most renowned weapon of Mount Guye, the Cloud-Errant Blade.
The most prestigious one... could it be... the Zaiyuan Sword?
Empty? What's going on, Thirteen, are you messing with us?
Please, everyone, calm down. There is someone here who knows the whereabouts of the Abyss Sword.
Would you two be willing to tell everyone where the Abyss Sword... is at this moment?
What business is Master Alata's sword of yours? Stop prying around here.
The Zaiyuan Sword has nothing to do with you.
Exactly. Not to mention we don't know, even if we did, why should we tell you?
Is it really that simple? I doubt it.
The matter involving the Zaiyuan Sword is a... catastrophe that threatens everyone here, and even the entirety of Mount Guye.
Am I right, Young Master Minka?
...I don't know what you're talking about. We have other business to attend to, so we'll be leaving now.
What do you mean, trying to stop us by force?
Let's go! If anyone wants to stop us, let them try if they have the guts!
I just wanted to ask the two of you for clarification. After all, the source of the Abyss Sword and today's chaos at Mount Guye are inseparable, and you know a lot about this, don't you?
What? Shisanlang, do you mean the chaos at Mount Guye is related to Master Alata?
For that, I'll have to ask our two distinguished guests to explain.
Don't think that just because you are on Tian-Guang Workshop's territory, you can push us around. My hammer is not for reasoning!
Boss! I have a guest to meet, open a table for me!
Let's find a hidden spot to track Shisanlang with the Emerald Cicada first.
Let's find a hidden spot to track Shisanlang with the Emerald Cicada first.
As expected, there are agents from the Sky-Light Workshop watching us.
Just acting bold because they're on their own turf...
It's a bit chaotic here, so stay close to me. Don't get snatched away halfway.
All factions and walks of life often choose Longyun Wind Pavilion to discuss business.
It looks grand, but it's also a den of iniquity. An ordinary person might barely make it out alive...
Wait, wait, wait! What are you doing!
Before the light of day. Here, your pass token.
So you are the honored guests for the Feast of Treasures. Please, this way—
You and Minka met at the entrance of the market. She had arranged to meet an intelligence broker, intending to get the secret letter directly.
Let him continue with his business for now. We'll contact him after we find the letter. Let's go!
The underground market ahead is the Ruins Bazaar.
Tianguang Workshop has released news that they are going to auction a <001> 'secret treasure of a big shot' </>... This must be that secret letter from Master Alata.
I've arranged to meet a well-known intelligence broker at the market. I'll try to find out the whereabouts of the secret letter before the auction begins.
Aren't you going to buy it at the auction?
...Should we just go in now without waiting for Li Bai?
...Should we just go in now without waiting for Li Bai?
Rather than being a sucker, we'd be better off using a simpler method. Once we find out where the letter is, we'll just—<001> break in, grab the letter, and slip out </>!
Great minds think alike! I've already thought it through. Once we find the location of the letter, we'll go with a three-step plan—<001>break in, get the letter, and slip out</>.
Buddy, don't blame me. You were the one who tampered with the cargo first.
Look whose turf this is. You really think you can get away with that?
Bullshit, someone framed me... Who, who hired you?
You guys are dirty! Keep going, if you have the guts, kill me in front of everyone!
No one has come to pick up the goods yet... It's over, it's all stuck in my hands!
Fragments of the Ancient Chang'an Weapon Manual? What a great find!

Shisanlang, Hu Wanli, and others took the residents of Wulian Town hostage and surrounded them, demanding an explanation from Li Bai—was Master Alata truly a disciple of Ziya who had defected from Mount Guye? The crowd was full of suspicion, all waiting for the Sword Immortal's reply...
Is this... the Sword Immortal? And that next to him must be the young master of the Cloud-Forging Pavilion, plus someone from Jixia Academy...
The bounty hunter is here too, what happened?
Hypocrites, what exactly are you trying to do?
Since the Sword Immortal says so, I will stop beating around the bush. Master Alata's Zaiyuan Sword is in your hands now, isn't it?
And what if it is? A sword of an old friend, I shall keep it safe for a while—
Then, are you also covering up for your old friend who hurt someone?
There are some things that I simply cannot bear to see the people of Mount Guye kept in the dark about any longer.
As you all know, Mount Guye has been in turmoil lately, and many have been attacked... In the Tianguang Workshop alone, there are no fewer than a dozen injured.
And yet Alata remains indifferent... Why?
The reason is simple: the culprit behind these many tragedies—is none other than she herself!
Young Master Minka and the representative from Jixia seem to have just obtained a secret letter left by Alata. They must know a lot of inside information, so why not enlighten everyone?
Master Alata is actually Ziya's disciple! Ziya has returned, so that means Master Alata...
Alata has naturally betrayed Jixia and defected to Ziya!
So what if Master Alata is Ziya's disciple? She's also a disciple of the Master! What does that even prove?

It's just that the Vermilion Bird Gate is wide enough for you to retreat, but the market only has this one road. There are many people here who have nothing to do with this matter. Li Bai, do you still dare to draw your sword?
As for why I am so certain...
She is indeed a disciple of the Master, but after what Ziya did, she is still willing to meet with him... It's not hard to see where her loyalties lie, is it?
According to reliable intelligence from Tian-Guang Workshop... during the recent Jixia turmoil, Fuzi fell at the hands of Ziya!
What? The Master, he... Won't Jixia be finished? And what about Mount Guye!
This is top-secret intelligence we obtained with great difficulty, and since Alata is the Master's disciple, he would only know about this sooner!
Knowing the Master is dead, yet still willing to go see Ziya—if this isn't betrayal, then what is it?
Nonsense! There's no confirmed news about the Master... not even within the Academy. Tian Guang Workshop is all the way at Mount Guye, yet you claim to have reliable intel just by flapping your lips?
And everything you've said is just your own speculation. Do you have any proof?!
We truly have no further evidence of Hu Wanli's injuries, but as the Minka young master said—isn't the Zaiyuan Sword she left behind evidence enough?
It's okay, I happen to know a bit about this. This is the legendary Divine Pattern power of Ziya, the God-Sealer.
But why would Divine Rune power appear in the Wiltspring Cave, and even on her Zaiyuan Sword?
What other reason could there be? Our dear Grandmaster Alata and Ziya have been in cahoots all along!
Well, Sword Immortal, can what I said be true?
Evidence? The wounds on my body are proof enough!
These wounds of mine are all thanks to Alata! She ambushed us in Wiltspring Cave.
You lack the chivalry of a Sword Immortal; I'd like to see how you plan to break this deadlock!
But when I told Li Bai and the others who arrived, they insisted I made it all up. It's clear they are in league with Alata...
When we arrived at the scene, there was nothing there, only you swinging the Zanyuan Sword at thin air!
Exactly. When we arrived at the scene, there was nothing there, just you swinging the Zaiyuan Sword at thin air!
Exactly, that Zaiyuan Sword of hers is truly sinister. I just touched it by accident and lost my mind, attacking others completely out of control!

"Tales and Legends of the Fourth School"
This book is a collection of legends and ghost stories about the "Fourth School" that I, Zhuge Liang, learned about while investigating as a student of Jixia.

<69D0FF>Zhuge Liang's Note: This is a forgery that falsely uses my name, but it is written interestingly enough to be a casual read for when you have some spare time.</>

First, Immortality
There is a legend in a village on the eastern side of the Jixia mountains. Many years ago, on the day when the sun was at its highest, a pair of brothers went up the mountain to pick fruit. When they reached a high point, a beam of intense light descended from the sky onto the older brother, who then vanished. For years after, no one found any trace of him.

Many years later, when the younger brother, now with a head full of white hair, went up the mountain, he saw a person who was glowing all over.

After returning to the village, he told the villagers about this, insisting that it was his brother, who still looked as young as he did when he first went missing.

Second, The Stubborn Stone
Many years ago, a stranger drifted into Jixia. To survive, he worked for the town's stonemason. After a few years, his skills had matured, and he often went to the distant mountains to quarry stone for the stonemasons.

One day, he heard a stone speaking, asking to be taken home. The stranger found it hard to believe, so he told the other quarrymen about it.

But no one else could hear it, and they dismissed it as the stranger's imagination. They used the stone as ordinary building material, and it was eventually used to build a house.

Not long after, the residents of the house would always hear a strange sound, like someone talking.
"Go... home".

"In ancient times, there was a great tree called Chun, which took eight thousand years for spring and eight thousand years for autumn; such is a great age." 
Moonelia Sprout grips the earth beneath it, spreading its roots to the shores of Tunyun Lake. 
Most of the time, it is docile and honest, stretching its half-withered, half-flourishing branches and casting light that flickers between bright and dim. 
However, the moment anyone wanders into its territory, it immediately raises its sturdy vines, launching a rain-like pursuit against the intruder. 

The students of the Hundred Herbs family responsible for its care observed from afar and discovered that the Moonelia Sprout seems to be moving its plant body at an extremely slow speed along its gnarled, deep roots. 
"A mortal's life is but a fleeting moment to it. Though the journey is long, it continues... Perhaps it is searching for its homeland."

Chapter One: Dress Code	
Before inviting a Leafy Slumberstone to dance with you, you must wear appropriate attire. To a Leafy Slumberstone, its dance partner should wear a grass skirt woven from fresh grass blades, with the upper body adorned with ancient Vine. The Leafy Slumberstone particularly favors a partner who chooses branches and leaves from the Guisui Tree to weave the skirt; Zhiyun Wood is also a fine choice. It would be even better if you could pair it with swaying skirt leaves as a decorative hem. However, remember not to choose Split-Fruit Wood, or you will trigger a tempestuous battle instead of completing an elegant dance. For headwear, a hat carved from Cloud-Ball Stone is best; do not choose dull-colored rock materials, as this will make the Leafy Slumberstone feel quite drowsy.

Chapter Two: Basic Etiquette	
Many people do not understand the etiquette for inviting a Leafy Slumberstone to dance, often resulting in them becoming the creature's beloved pillow rather than its dance partner. First, disturbing a resting Leafy Slumberstone by shouting to wake it up for a dance is absolutely unacceptable. The correct way is to find a sleeping Leafy Slumberstone in the wild, then use a branch of Zhanchi Wood to sweep across its hard head. According to the practical experience of the renowned ranger Hu Qianqian, after continuously clearing the moss from its head about one thousand two hundred times, the Leafy Slumberstone will be successfully awakened. If it does not stand up and roar angrily at you, then congratulations, the invitation to dance has been successfully accepted. Conversely, you should leave as soon as possible, otherwise you will have to wait for a passing ranger to rescue you from its embrace.

Chapter Three: Dance Rhythm	
A Leafy Slumberstone in a dancing state will not move. As its recognized dance partner, you should sit upright in front of it, gently swaying your stone-carved hat, with your arms naturally stretched and swinging like a freely growing wild grass. If the Leafy Slumberstone's gaze follows your movements, it means it has begun to dance with you. At this point, the choice of dance steps depends on how you twist your neck; try not to shake your shoulders. Additionally, never lower your head. If your stone-carved hat falls off, you should leave immediately; otherwise, do not change your posture at all and wait for the Leafy Slumberstone to close its eyes again.

Settlement scores are based on your ranking within your team, whether you doubled down, and the rank difference between the two sides.
• There is no rank difference limit for parties; solo matchmaking prioritizes players of similar skill.
• Doubling Multiplier: Determined by both your opponents' and your own doubling status. Teammate doubling does not affect your multiplier.
• Win/Loss Multiplier: Depends on player ranking combinations. The highest multiplier is awarded when the winning team takes first and second place; other combinations yield lower multipliers.
• Rank Difference Multiplier: Reflects the rank gap between sides. A difference of 2 ranks or more results in 2x, a difference of 1 ranks results in 1.5x, and a difference of less than 1 ranks results in 1x.
